content: 纵览中国｜美国德克萨斯州Katy市｜2026年11月11日 美国海军退伍军人、美国邮政服务（USPS）职业雇员、公共管理硕士（MPA）候选人秦伟平（Weiping “George” Qin）于2026年11月11日美国退伍军人节正式宣布参选美国德克萨斯州Katy独立学区（Katy Independent School District，简称Katy ISD）董事会第六选区（Position 6），计划参加2027年5月1日举行的学区董事会选举。 秦伟平通过其官方X（原Twitter）、Facebook及Substack等平台发布中英文正式竞选公告，并同步公布竞选团队新闻通稿及五大教育政策方向。他提出以 SMART Education Agenda（SMART教育纲领） 为核心的竞选框架，涵盖学生学业成就、学生支持、教师招聘与留任、财政管理，以及学区透明度和社区信任等议题。 秦伟平选择在退伍军人节宣布参选，将个人的海军服役经历与继续服务社会、参与地方教育公共事务的意愿联系起来。其竞选口号为： “Served Our Country. Defending Our Classrooms.” 中文表述为： “军旅报国，教育为民。” 此次公告标志着秦伟平此前持续进行的竞选筹备工作进入正式公开阶段，也使其个人经历、教育理念和地方公共治理主张开始集中呈现于公众面前。 一、退伍军人节宣布参选：公共服务从军旅延伸到社区 秦伟平在竞选公告中表示，公共服务不会随着军旅生涯的结束而终止，而是可以继续体现在对家庭、社区和下一代的责任与承诺之中。 据竞选团队提供的个人资料，秦伟平曾在美国海军服役，服役期间获得海军与海军陆战队成就奖章（Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal）以及军队杰出志愿服务奖章（Military Outstanding Volunteer Service Medal），以表彰其服役表现和志愿服务贡献。 在美国海军服役期间，他曾在舰艇供应部门工作，参与海军舰艇后勤保障任务，并取得航空作战专业资格（Enlisted Aviation Warfare Specialist，EAWS）和水面作战专业资格（Enlisted Surface Warfare Specialist，ESWS）。 这些经历构成了其个人介绍中关于军事训练、团队协作和公共服务的重要部分。 结束军旅服役后，秦伟平继续加入美国邮政服务系统（United States Postal Service，USPS），从事公共服务工作。 据竞选团队提供的资料，他曾在Katy邮局担任城市邮递员助理（City Carrier Assistant，CCA），负责邮件投递和当地社区服务。目前，他是USPS正式职业雇员，在Fulshear邮局担任邮政业务职员（Clerk）。 从海军后勤保障到邮政系统的日常运营，两段工作经历虽然属于不同领域，但都与公共服务和服务对象的实际需求密切相关。 秦伟平在竞选声明中表示，希望将海军服役期间形成的纪律意识、团队合作精神和责任担当，以及在联邦公共服务岗位上积累的工作经验，带入地方教育公共事务。 二、三个Katy ISD学生的父亲：从家长身份关注公共教育 除了军事和公共服务经历，秦伟平的另一个身份是Katy社区居民，也是三名正在Katy ISD就读学生的父亲。 对于当地家庭而言，学校教育质量、教师队伍稳定性、校园安全、特殊教育资源和学区财政安排，都是与日常生活密切相关的公共事务。 作为学生家长，秦伟平表示，他不仅关注自己孩子的教育环境，也希望学区能够关注整个社区不同家庭、不同学习需求以及不同学生群体的实际情况。 他的竞选公告强调，学区应该倾听家长意见，尊重教师和学校工作人员，合理使用纳税人的资金，并通过透明度和公共问责机制建立社区信任。 从其公开提出的政策方向来看，秦伟平希望将家长的实际体验与学区治理层面的讨论联系起来，使学生发展、教师支持和公共财政管理成为相互关联的议题。 三、从学生会主席到设立奖学金：教育经历与校园领导实践 秦伟平的教育背景和校园领导经历，也是此次竞选团队新闻通稿重点介绍的内容。 据竞选团队提供的履历资料，秦伟平曾就读于马里兰州哈福德社区大学（Harford Community College），并于2019年当选该校学生会（Student Government Association，SGA）主席。 2021年，他在该校设立了“秦伟平自由奖学金”（Weiping Qin Freedom Scholarship）。据竞选团队介绍，该奖学金旨在支持学生领袖以及具有军队服役经历的学生。 2023年，他获得哈福德社区大学颁发的杰出校友奖（Distinguished Alumni Award）。竞选团队将这一荣誉归因于其个人成就以及对学校和社区的贡献。 在高等教育方面，据其提供的个人履历，秦伟平先后获得哈福德社区大学工商管理副学士学位及会计证书，随后取得马里兰大学全球校区（University of Maryland Global Campus，UMGC）管理研究理学学士学位和工商管理硕士（MBA）学位。 目前，他正在金门大学（Golden Gate University，GGU）攻读公共管理硕士（Master of Public Administration，MPA）学位。 从学生会领导经历、奖学金设立，到继续学习工商管理和公共管理，秦伟平的教育背景涉及学生组织、商业管理和公共部门治理等多个领域。 对于一名地方学区董事候选人而言，这些经历也构成其公开介绍个人教育理念和公共管理兴趣的背景。至于如何将这些学习与实践经验转化为具体的学区政策，仍有待其在后续竞选活动中进一步阐述。 四、了解Katy ISD：近9.5万名学生、1.36万名教职员工的教育系统 要理解秦伟平此次竞选的公共事务背景，有必要先了解Katy ISD的规模，以及其董事会在当地教育体系中所承担的职责。 Katy ISD是美国德克萨斯州休斯敦西部地区的重要公立学区之一。根据德克萨斯州教育厅（Texas Education Agency，TEA）公布的2025—2026学年学区资料，截至2026年11月公布的最新统计，该学区共有 95,136名在校学生、78所学校 ，全职教职员工约13,601人，其中全职教师约6,934人。 这一规模意味着，Katy ISD不仅是一个服务近十万名学生的公共教育系统，也是当地规模较大的公共服务机构之一。其教育政策、财政预算和学校资源配置，直接关系到大量学生、家长、教师及社区居民。 从学生构成来看，TEA数据显示，2025—2026学年Katy ISD学生中，约43.3%属于经济条件相对困难群体，19.2%接受特殊教育服务，24.0%属于英语学习者（Emergent Bilingual Students）。 这些比例反映出学区内部学生需求具有多样性。不同学生在语言学习、特殊教育、学业支持和家庭资源方面可能面临不同情况，也使得教育资源分配和学生支持政策成为学区治理的重要议题。 TEA公布的同一学年资料还显示，Katy ISD的师生比例约为13.7名学生对应一名教师，教师平均年薪约为73,094美元。该学区在2025—2026学年的州级学区问责评级为B，得分88分（满分100分）。 从地理范围来看，根据Katy ISD官方网站介绍，学区覆盖面积约为181平方英里，服务范围涉及Harris、Fort Bend和Waller三个县。需要注意的是，Katy ISD的学区边界并不等同于Katy市的行政边界，其服务范围延伸至Katy市及周边多个社区。 因此，讨论Katy ISD的学生规模和公共服务范围时，应当以学区实际统计为依据，而不能简单将Katy市的人口数字等同于学区人口。 五、年度预算约14.8亿美元：教育资源与纳税人责任 Katy ISD的财政规模同样值得关注。 根据学区2026年8月24日公布的2026—2027财政年度预算信息，董事会批准了约 11.7亿美元的一般运营基金预算（General Operating Fund） 。加上食品服务及债务偿还等其他基金，学区年度总预算约为 14.8亿美元 。 学区公布的信息显示，约83%的预算支出用于学生教学、课堂运营和学生支持。这些资金涉及教师及学校工作人员薪酬、教学活动、学生服务和学校日常运行等重要领域。 与此同时，学区公布的2026—2027年度预算预计存在约2,570万美元的运营赤字。学区方面表示，过去三个已经审计的财政年度，虽然最初均采用赤字预算，但最终通过节约开支、控制实际支出及提高运营效率等措施，实现了年度预算平衡，并增加了基金余额。学区管理层预计2025—2026财政年度也有望延续这一趋势。 在税收方面，学区公布的2026—2027年度拟议综合税率为每100美元应税财产估值1.1171美元，与上一年度保持一致。该税率包括一般运营税率和债务偿还税率。 这些数字说明，学区董事会所涉及的并非单纯的教育理念讨论，还包括规模庞大的公共财政管理工作。 如何在保障教学质量、支持教师队伍、满足特殊教育需求、维护校园设施和控制纳税人负担之间取得平衡，是学区治理长期面对的议题。 这也与秦伟平此次提出的SMART教育纲领中的“R——Responsible Financial Management（负责任的财政管理）”以及“T——Transparency & Community Trust（透明度与社区信任）”两项政策方向直接相关。 六、Katy ISD董事会：七名民选成员共同承担学区治理职责 Katy ISD董事会（Board of Trustees）是学区的政策制定和公共监督机构，由七名董事组成。 根据Katy ISD官方网站，董事通过选举产生，每人任期三年，采取轮换选举方式。董事会成员不领取董事职务薪酬，候选人虽然以不同选区或席位参加选举，但当选后代表整个学区履行职责。 根据德克萨斯州教育厅对公立学区董事会职责的说明，以及Katy ISD公布的董事会制度，董事会主要负责： 制定学区政策和长期发展目标； 聘用、监督并评估学区总监（Superintendent）； 审议和批准年度预算及地方税率； 对学区财务、教育质量和整体管理进行监督； 通过正式董事会会议审议公共教育事务。 需要特别说明的是，学区董事并不直接负责每所学校的日常教学和行政管理。学校日常运营主要由学区总监及其管理团队负责，董事会则通过政策制定、预算批准、目标设定和管理监督履行职责。 此外，董事会作为一个集体机构作出正式决策，单独一名董事不能自行代表整个董事会作出决定。 这一制度安排意味着，学区董事并不是学校的日常行政管理人员，而是代表公众参与公共教育治理的民选代表。 对于即将参加Position 6选举的秦伟平而言，未来如果当选，其职责将不仅涉及自己所在选区的家庭，也将涉及整个Katy ISD学区的公共教育事务。 因此，学生学业表现、教师招聘与留任、特殊教育资源、学区预算、债务管理、学校设施规划以及家长参与机制，都属于与董事会职责密切相关的政策议题。 七、SMART教育纲领：五个方向回应学区治理议题 此次竞选公告最重要的政策内容，是秦伟平正式提出的SMART Education Agenda。 SMART由五个英文关键词的首字母组成，也是其竞选团队用来概括五大教育优先事项的整体框架。 S — Student Success & Academic Excellence 学生成就与学术卓越 秦伟平提出，应当巩固学生在阅读、数学及其他核心学科方面的基础，扩大STEM（科学、技术、工程与数学）教育机会，并提升学生在大学升学和职业发展方面的准备能力。 这一方向强调，学校教育不仅要关注学生是否完成课程，更应关注实际学习成果，以及学生在不同教育阶段所获得的发展机会。 M — Meaningful Support for Every Student 为每一位学生提供实质支持 这一部分特别关注具有不同学习需求的学生。 竞选团队提出的政策方向包括审视特殊教育服务与资源配置，加强对失读症（Dyslexia）和自闭症学生的支持，关注资优生（Gifted and Talented, G/T）项目，并进一步改善英语学习者（English Language Learners，ELL）的教育服务。 这一主张涉及学区资源分配、特殊教育服务和不同学生群体的教育机会。如何评估现有服务的覆盖程度、资源需求和实际成效，将是这一政策方向未来需要进一步讨论的内容。 A — Attract & Retain Great Educators 吸引并留住优秀教师 教师招聘和留任是秦伟平提出的第三项重点。 其竞选纲领提出，应审视教师招聘和留任机制，支持具有竞争力的教师薪酬，同时关注教师工作量、行政负担以及学校工作环境。 这一方向将教师队伍稳定性与学生教育质量联系起来，强调教师不仅需要专业能力，也需要获得适当的工作支持和职业尊重。 R — Responsible Financial Management 负责任的财政管理 在财政管理方面，秦伟平提出加强预算监督和财政信息透明度，审查学区债务及利息支出，并结合学生入学人数预测，合理评估学校建筑、设施和长期教育资源需求。 学区财政管理涉及教育服务质量、公共资金使用和纳税人利益。秦伟平提出的方向，重点在于预算监督、长期规划和资源配置之间的协调。 未来，这一纲领还需要进一步说明具体的预算审查方法、评估指标，以及如何在财政约束与教育需求之间取得平衡。 T — Transparency & Community Trust 透明度与社区信任 第五项政策重点是改善学区与社区之间的沟通。 秦伟平提出，应提高学区公共信息的透明度和可读性，鼓励家长及社区居民参与学区事务，加强公共问责，并推动开放、理性和相互尊重的公共讨论。 这一方向强调，学区治理不仅涉及董事会内部决策，也涉及家长、教师、学校工作人员和社区居民能否及时获得信息、表达意见并了解决策依据。 总体而言，SMART五大纲领将学生学业、教育公平、教师队伍、公共财政和社区参与纳入同一个政策框架，体现了秦伟平此次竞选所关注的主要治理领域。 八、2027年5月选举：Position 6与Position 7将列入选票 根据Katy ISD官方网站公布的信息，学区将于 2027年5月1日举行普通选举 ，董事会第六选区（Position 6）和第七选区（Position 7）将列入选票，选出的董事任期为三年。 官方公布的候选人申请时间为2027年1月13日至2027年2月12日下午5时。候选人需要按照学区公布的程序和德克萨斯州相关法律提交正式申请，并满足相应的参选资格要求。 因此，秦伟平此次宣布参选，属于正式公开宣布竞选意向和开展竞选活动的阶段，并不等同于已经完成正式候选人申请或取得选票资格。 Katy ISD官方网站的董事会资料页面目前列有七个董事席位，其中Position 6显示为空缺。该席位也将列入2027年5月选举。 随着选举临近，候选人将有机会进一步向社区介绍自己的教育理念、治理思路和具体政策方案。对于选民而言，了解不同候选人对学生发展、教师支持、财政管理和社区参与的具体主张，将是参与地方教育治理的重要一环。 九、从公共服务到地方教育：竞选主张仍有待社区检验 秦伟平在退伍军人节发布的声明中，将自己参选的原因概括为希望继续服务社区，为下一代创造更好的教育环境。 他在竞选团队发布的新闻通稿中表示： “对我而言，退伍军人节不仅是一个纪念的日子，更是一种精神的延续。军旅服役虽然有结束的一天，但服务社会的使命不应就此停止。我们可以继续以实际行动奉献社区，为下一代创造更加美好的未来。” 他还表示，作为美国海军退伍军人，自己曾有机会为国家服役；退役后继续通过美国邮政为公众服务；如今作为三名Katy ISD学生的父亲，希望通过参与学校发展、支持教师和保障学生成长机会，继续为社区作出贡献。 从其此次公布的竞选资料来看，秦伟平试图将三方面经历联系起来：军队服役所强调的纪律和责任、联邦公共服务岗位所涉及的日常运营，以及家庭作为学校教育直接参与者的实际体验。 但从竞选纲领走向学区治理，还需要将原则转化为具体政策。例如，如何衡量学生学业进步？如何确定特殊教育资源需求？怎样评估教师留任政策？如何在学校设施投资与财政可持续性之间取得平衡？又如何让家长和社区居民更有效地参与决策？ 这些问题不仅是候选人需要进一步回答的政策议题，也是选民在未来竞选过程中可以持续关注和比较的内容。 随着2027年5月选举临近，候选人将有更多机会向社区介绍各自的教育理念、治理思路和具体政策方案。秦伟平此次公布的SMART教育纲领，为其竞选确立了五个主要方向；这些主张能否形成更加明确、可执行和可评估的政策，将成为后续竞选讨论的重要部分。 秦伟平竞选信息 姓名： Weiping “George” Qin（秦伟平） 竞选职位： Katy ISD Board of Trustees, Position 6 选举日期： 2027年5月1日 竞选口号： Served Our Country. title: Victory, Curtin University team up on rare earth processing
zh_title: Victory与科廷大学合作开发稀土加工
summary: Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) 与澳大利亚珀斯的科廷大学合作，以中试规模将重稀土精矿加工成混合稀土碳酸盐 (MREC)，推进其在澳大利亚的下游加工计划。根据材料转让协议，Victory 的波斯伍德工厂生产的精矿将在该大学的阴极前体生产试验工厂 (C4P) 进行加工。该设施的开发是为了支持澳大利亚的电池和关键矿产行业，投资额超过 1840 万澳元（1260 万美元）。 “确保对 C4P 的访问
content:
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) 与澳大利亚珀斯的科廷大学合作，以中试规模将重稀土精矿加工成混合稀土碳酸盐 (MREC)，推进其在澳大利亚的下游加工计划。根据材料转让协议，Victory 的波斯伍德工厂生产的精矿将在该大学的阴极前体生产试验工厂 (C4P) 进行加工。该设施的开发是为了支持澳大利亚的电池和关键矿产行业，投资额超过 1840 万澳元（1260 万美元）。 Victory 执行董事兼首席执行官布伦丹·克拉克 (Brendan Clark) 表示：“确保进入 C4P 设施是 Victory Metals 的一项重大发展，也是我们建立澳大利亚综合重稀土供应链的雄心。” “这尤其重要，因为我们可以利用澳大利亚现有的加工基础设施和专业知识，而不必独立开发下游加工途径的每个阶段。”根据该计划生产的 MREC 样品预计将返回 Victory 与国际承购和炼油合作伙伴一起进行技术评估和评价。该协议有效期至 2027 年。试点工作还旨在测试澳大利亚 Victory 北斯坦莫尔稀土项目精矿加工路线。周三，Victory 股价在悉尼收于每股 1.24 澳元，上涨 0.4%。
中国的限制 此次合作正值澳大利亚和美国努力限制中国对关键矿产的投资。5月，澳大利亚政府以国家安全为由，命令中国投资者出售北方矿业公司（ASX：NTU）的稀土股份。 11月9日，中国宣布进一步暂停部分出口管制措施至2027年1月10日，其中包括与中重稀土产品有关的措施。克拉克补充道：“胜利公司正在将自己定位为在发展澳大利亚国内重稀土供应链方面发挥重要作用。”由于中国控制着世界约 60% 的稀土矿产量和几乎所有矿物加工能力，许多政府都在寻找确保自身生产安全的方法。 Victory表示，澳大利亚MREC加工中心的建立与美国、欧洲、日本、印度、韩国和越南的客户相关。

【原文 English Original】
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) has partnered with Curtin University in Perth, Australia, to process heavy rare earth concentrate into mixed rare earth carbonate (MREC) at pilot scale, advancing its plans for downstream processing in Australia. Under the material transfer agreement, concentrate produced at Victory’s Burswood plant will be processed at the university’s Cathode Precursor Production Pilot Plant (C4P). The facility was developed to support Australia’s battery and critical minerals industry and represents more than A$18.4 million ($12.6 million) in investment. “Securing access to the C4P facility is a significant development for Victory Metals and our ambition to establish an integrated Australian heavy rare earth supply chain,” said Brendan Clark, Victory’s executive director and CEO. “This is particularly important because we can leverage established Australian processing infrastructure and expertise rather than having to develop every stage of the downstream processing pathway independently.” MREC samples produced under the program are expected to be returned to Victory for technical assessment and evaluation alongside international offtake and refining partners. The agreement runs through 2027.  The pilot work is also intended to test an Australian processing route for concentrate from Victory’s North Stanmore rare earth project. Victory’s shares closed at A$1.24 apiece, up 0.4%, Wednesday in Sydney.  Chinese restrictions The partnership comes as Australia and the UShave made efforts to limit Chinese investment in critical minerals. In May , the Australian government ordered Chinese investors to sell rare earth stakes in Northern Minerals (ASX: NTU), citing national security concerns. On Nov. 9, China announced a further suspension of certain export-control measures until Jan. 10, 2027. These include measures relating to medium and heavy rare-earth products. “Victory is positioning itself to play an important role in developing Australia’s domestic heavy rare earth supply chain,” Clark added.  With China controlling about 60% of the world’s mined rare earth output and nearly all of the minerals’ processing capacity, many governments have looked for ways to secure their own production. Victory says the establishment of Australian MREC processing is relevant to customers in the U.S., Europe, Japan, India, South Korea and Vietnam.

title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

【原文 English Original】
Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi! title: Cathay Pacific orders 11 more Airbus A330neos, raising total to 41
zh_title: 国泰航空再订购 11 架空客 A330neo，总数增至 41 架
summary: 根据 2026 年 11 月 11 日发布的香港证券交易所文件，国泰航空已行使另外 11 架空客 A330-900 飞机的购买权，使该型飞机的确定订单达到 41 架。这些权利可以追溯到国泰航空与空客于 2024 年签订的购买协议，根据该协议，国泰航空订购了 30 架 A330-900 飞机，并获得了再购买 30 架的权利。国泰航空预计这11架新飞机将在2031年至2035年期间交付。20​​24年，它表示最初的30架飞机将在2031年底前抵达。空中客车公司同一天宣布，国泰航空集团已下了14架AI的确定订单。
content:
根据 2026 年 11 月 11 日发布的香港证券交易所文件，国泰航空已行使另外 11 架空客 A330-900 飞机的购买权，使该型飞机的确定订单达到 41 架。这些权利可以追溯到国泰航空与空客于 2024 年签订的购买协议，根据该协议，国泰航空订购了 30 架 A330-900 飞机，并获得了再购买 30 架的权利。国泰航空预计这11架新飞机将在2031年至2035年期间交付。20​​24年，该公司表示最初的30架飞机将在2031年底前抵达。空中客车公司同一天宣布，国泰集团已确定总共购买14架飞机，包括11架A330-900和3架A321neo。这些窄体飞机增加了 2023 年 32 架 A321neo 和 A320neo 飞机的订单，但最新的证券交易所备案文件未涵盖这些飞机。 A330neos将取代国泰航空老化的宽体机队新型A330-900将逐步取代国泰航空现有的中型宽体飞机，主要服务于亚洲的支线航线，未来可灵活运营长途服务。根据国泰航空公司的数据，国泰航空拥有 43 架 A330-300 飞机，平均机龄为 18.2 年。
国泰航空首席运营及服务交付官 Alex McGowan 表示，新增飞机将支持该​​集团在亚太地区的区域运营，同时“为运营更长的航班提供更大的灵活性”。空客对 A330neo 采购给予大幅折扣 该文件对这 11 架飞机的基本价格约为 51.1 亿美元（399 亿港元）。不过，国泰航空表示，空客已给予“大幅价格优惠”，使实际购买价格低于该数字。香港联交所授予国泰航空豁免权，允许其保留最终商定的价格。每架飞机将分八期现金支付，其中七期在交付前支付，其余余额在移交时支付。国泰航空可能通过银行贷款、融资租赁、售后租回安排、运营现金或这些来源的组合来为购买提供资金。该交易不需要股东​​批准。国泰航空扩大其空客和波音订单渠道最新订单进一步丰富了国泰航空更广泛的机队更新计划。 2025 年 8 月，该航空公司行使了另外 14 架波音 777-9 的购买权，使对该型号飞机的坚定承诺达到 35 架。该集团还于2026年5月行使了另外两架空客A350F货机的权利。根据其中期报告，截至2026年6月30日，国泰集团拥有105架飞机的确认订单和另外87架飞机的购买权。这些数字早于最新的空客交易。
这一新承诺是国泰集团首席执行官林中基在 2026 年 6 月的国际航空运输协会年度大会上发表评论后作出的，当时他表示将进一步订购宽体机、窄体机和货机。国泰航空又订购了 11 架空客 A330neo，使总数达到 41 架。

【原文 English Original】
Cathay Pacific has exercised purchase rights for 11 additional Airbus A330-900 aircraft, bringing its firm orders for the type to 41, according to a Hong Kong Stock Exchange filing published on November 11, 2026. The rights date back to Cathay’s 2024 purchase agreement with Airbus, under which the airline ordered 30 A330-900s and secured the right to acquire 30 more. Cathay expects the eleven new aircraft to be delivered between 2031 and 2035. In 2024 , it said the original 30 would arrive by the end of 2031. Airbus announced the same day that the Cathay Group had placed a firm order for 14 aircraft in total, comprising the eleven A330-900s and three A321neos. The narrowbodies add to a 2023 order for 32 A321neo and A320neo aircraft and are not covered by the latest stock exchange filing. A330neos to replace Cathay Pacific’s aging widebody fleet The new A330-900s will progressively replace Cathay Pacific’s existing mid-size widebody aircraft, primarily serving regional routes in Asia, with the flexibility to operate longer-haul services in the future. Cathay Pacific operates 43 A330-300s with an average age of 18.2 years, as per ch-aviation data . Cathay Chief Operations and Service Delivery Officer Alex McGowan said the additional aircraft would support the group’s regional operations across Asia-Pacific while “providing greater flexibility to operate longer flights.” Airbus grants significant discounts on A330neo purchase The filing values the eleven aircraft at a basic price of approximately $5.11 billion (HK39.9 billion). However, Cathay said Airbus had granted “significant price concessions,” bringing the actual purchase price below that figure. The Hong Kong Stock Exchange granted Cathay a waiver allowing it to withhold the final agreed price. Each aircraft will be paid for in eight cash installments, with seven due before delivery and the remaining balance payable upon handover. Cathay may finance the purchase through bank loans, finance leases, sale-and-leaseback arrangements, operating cash, or a combination of these sources. The transaction does not require shareholder approval. Cathay expands its Airbus and Boeing order pipeline The latest order adds to Cathay’s wider fleet renewal program. In August 2025, the airline exercised purchase rights for 14 additional Boeing 777-9s , bringing its firm commitment for the type to 35 aircraft. The group also exercised rights for two additional Airbus A350F freighters in May 2026. As of June 30, 2026, Cathay Group had 105 aircraft on firm order and purchase rights for another 87, according to its interim report. Those figures predate the latest Airbus transaction. The new commitment follows comments by Cathay Group CEO Ronald Lam at the International Air Transport Association annual general meeting in June 2026, when he signaled further orders for widebody, narrowbody and freighter aircraft. title: Austal Cuts First Steel on Landing Craft Heavy for Australian Army

content:
澳大利亚政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日宣布，为澳大利亚陆军采购的两艘两栖登陆艇中的第二艘目前正在建造中。重型登陆艇 (LCH) 的第一批钢材于 10 月下旬完成生产，一个月前中型登陆艇 (LCM) 项目也取得了类似的里程碑。造船商 Austal 绘制的计算机插图中的 Damen LST 100 重型登陆艇 (LCH)。澳大利亚国防镜头。澳大利亚国防部长发布的媒体报道（链接）2026 年 11 月 11 日澳大利亚陆军向两栖作战和远程打击优化的部队转型正在推进，西澳大利亚州登陆艇的建造现已进入新阶段。陆军重型登陆艇的建造工作正在按计划进行，第一艘舰艇已于上月底进行了钢材切割。阿尔巴尼亚政府已授予价值超过 50 亿美元的合同，为陆军提供 18 艘中型登陆艇和 8 艘重型登陆艇，该项目已经促进了就业和当地经济活动。该项目将为西澳创造1,100个直接就业岗位和2,000多个间接就业岗位，并直接支持政府对该州持续造船的承诺。
这些舰艇能够运输多兵种陆地系统，包括高机动火炮火箭系统、艾布拉姆斯主战坦克以及侦察和步兵战车，将增强澳大利亚国防军将潜在对手置于危险之中并确保战略地形安全的能力。这一重大进展表明了阿尔巴尼亚政府致力于建设陆军未来濒海舰队，同时推进国防战略和综合投资计划的优先事项，加强澳大利亚的主权国防工业基础，并创造熟练就业。为了进一步增强澳大利亚的主权造船能力，阿尔巴尼亚政府的国家重建基金公司 (NRFC) 上个月宣布向澳大利亚奥斯塔防务造船有限公司提供 2.45 亿美元贷款，以支持澳大利亚海军陆战队内重型登陆艇设施的建造和装修。该项目是阿尔巴尼亚政府创纪录的国防投资的一部分，是自第二次世界大战以来陆军滨海能力最大规模的资本重组。 “陆军登陆艇舰队建造的进展标志着从设计到交付的过渡，也是澳大利亚国防军关键能力建设的重要一步。随着建设活动的增加，我们正在为当地人创造数千个就业机会，为企业提供投资和发展劳动力所需的信心。
这两个登陆艇项目对于阿尔巴尼亚政府在西澳的持续造船计划至关重要，该计划将为子孙后代提供就业保障，并使澳大利亚人更加安全。”国防工业部长 Pat Conroy MP – 声明结束 – 2026 年 9 月下旬在奥斯塔第一艘 LCM 船的 1 号区块首次焊接。图片来自奥斯塔通过澳大利亚国防部拍摄的镜头。 《海军新闻》评论：继 2026 年 9 月 29 日中型登陆艇 (LCM) 实现类似里程碑之后，重型登陆艇 (LCH) 两栖登陆舰于 10 月下旬宣布进行首次钢材切割。正如《海军新闻》在之前的报道中概述的那样，这两项工作现在都在进行中

【原文 English Original】
The Australian government announced on 11 November 2026 that construction is now underway on the second of two amphibious landing craft-procurements for the Australian Army. First steel for the Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) was cut in late October, followin a similar milestone for the Landing Craft Medium (LCM)-program one month earlier. The Damen LST 100-based Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) in a computer illustration by shipbuilder Austal. Footage Australian Defence. Media release of the Australian Minister for Defence (Link) 11 November 2026 The transformation of the Australian Army into a force optimised for amphibious operations and long-range strike is advancing, with construction in Western Australia of landing craft vessels now progressing to a new phase. Construction of the Army’s Landing Craft Heavy is now underway and on schedule with steel cut on the first vessels late last month. The Albanese Government has awarded over $5 billion in contracts to deliver 18 Landing Craft Medium and eight Landing Craft Heavy for Army, a project that has already boosted employment and local economic activity. The project will create 1,100 direct jobs and more than 2,000 indirect jobs in Western Australia and directly support the Government’s commitment to continuous shipbuilding in the state. Capable of transporting combined-arms land systems, including High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems, Abrams main battle tanks, and reconnaissance and infantry fighting vehicles, the vessels will strengthen the Australian Defence Force’s ability to hold potential adversaries at risk and secure strategic terrain. This significant progress demonstrates the Albanese Government’s commitment to delivering Army’s future littoral fleet, while advancing the priorities of the National Defence Strategy and Integrated Investment Program, strengthening Australia’s sovereign defence industrial base, and creating skilled employment. In a further boost to Australia’s sovereign shipbuilding capability, the Albanese Government’s National Reconstruction Fund Corporation (NRFC) last month announced a $245 million loan to Austal Defence Shipbuilding Australia Pty Ltd to support the construction and fit out of Landing Craft Heavy facilities within the Australian Marine Complex. The project – part of the Albanese Government’s record investment in Defence – represents the largest recapitalisation of Army’s littoral capability since the Second World War. “Progress in constructing Army’s landing craft fleet marks the transition from design into delivery and an important step in building a critical capability for the Australian Defence Force. As construction activity ramps up, we are creating thousands of jobs for locals, providing businesses the confidence they need to invest and grow their workforce. These two landing craft projects are critical to the Albanese Government’s continuous shipbuilding plan for WA, which is providing job security for generations to come, and making Australians safer.” Minister for Defence Industry Pat Conroy MP – end of statement – First weld on block 1 of the first LCM vessel at Austal in late September, 2026. Image from footage by Austal via Australian DoD. Naval News comments: The announcement for first steel cut on the Landing Craft – Heavy (LCH) amphibious landing ships in late October follows a similar milestone met for the Landing Craft – Medium (LCM)-effort on 29 September 2026. As Naval News has outlined in previous coverage , both efforts are now effectively occurring in parallel due to earlier delays on moving LCM from design to construction. Austal is capable of constructing the LCM-vessels with a displacement of approximately 500 tons within its existing facilities at Henderson and on Hope Valley Road. For the construction of the far larger LCH based on Damen’s LST 100 displacing nearly 4,000 tons however the government-designated strategic shipbuilder will need to utilise facilities within the wider Henderson Defence Precinct, notably the Common User Facility (CUF). The yard intends to move LCH-production to a yet to be established “permanent” production facility at a later date, according to a previous contract-announcement by the Australian government. Australia has ordered 18 LCM and eight LCH for expanded amphibious capability operated by the Australian Defence Force. The post Austal Cuts First Steel on Landing Craft Heavy for Australian Army appeared first on Naval News .

title: F-16V vs F-16C Block 70/72: Understanding The Differences Between The Latest Viper Variants
zh_title: F-16V 与 F-16C Block 70/72：了解最新 Viper 变体之间的差异
summary: 尽管经常互换使用，F-16V 和 F-16C Block 70/72 名称描述了毒蛇进化的两个方面，升级飞机和新建飞机之间存在重要区别。 F-16 战隼的最新发展成为近几个月多条新闻的焦点，突显了该机在首次飞行后 50 多年里如何继续发展。从交付客户的新生产战斗机到现有机队的广泛现代化计划，最新进展表明第四代战斗机仍然是战斗机的重要组成部分。
content:
尽管经常互换使用，F-16V 和 F-16C Block 70/72 名称描述了毒蛇进化的两个方面，升级飞机和新建飞机之间存在重要区别。 F-16 战隼的最新发展成为近几个月多条新闻的焦点，突显了该机在首次飞行后 50 多年里如何继续发展。从交付客户的新生产战斗机到现有机队的广泛现代化计划，最新进展表明第四代战斗机仍然是众多空军未来计划的重要组成部分。 10 月，台湾收到了首批两架新制造的 F-16C Block 70 战斗机，这是拖延已久的 66 架飞机订单的一部分。此次交付标志着一个重要的里程碑，这些喷气式飞机补充了升级为 F-16V 配置的岛上现有机队。第二批飞机已于 11 月初交付，同时飞机的训练仍在美国亚利桑那州图森市的莫里斯空军国民警卫队基地继续进行。航空摄影师 Thomas Backus (@machtwoimages) 拍摄了其中两个机身，并与我们分享了这些图像。同样在10月，洛克希德·马丁公司宣布摩洛哥首架F-16D Block 72首飞，这也是第一架新制造的Block 72喷气式飞机。摩洛哥还在推行并行现代化工作，将 23 架现有 F-16C/D Block 52 飞机升级为 F-16V 配置。
说到现代化的“毒蛇”战斗机，希腊于 9 月接收了第 60 架 F-16V，作为该计划的一部分，该计划将首先将 84 架 F-16 Block 52+ 和 Block 52+ Advanced 升级到新配置，然后是 38 架较旧的 Block 50。与此同时，洛克希德·马丁公司向美国空军和 F-16C/D Block 推销了一款基于 Block 70 的变体，称为 F-16G。 70/72 给乌克兰空军。 Visualizza questo post su Instagram                         Un post condiviso da Thomas “Taj” Backus (@machtwoimages) 这些进展说明了运营商投资“战隼”的不同方式。然而，它们也重新引起了人们对即使是航空爱好者也可能感到困惑的术语的关注：F-16V、F-16C/D、Block 70 和 Block 72。虽然这些名称有时可以互换使用，但它们并不意味着同一件事。了解每个名称的含义对于区分新制造的 F-16C/D Block 70/72 和升级到 F-16V 配置的旧版 F-16 至关重要。了解名称 F-16V（其中“V”代表 F-16 的昵称“毒蛇”）由洛克希德·马丁公司推出，作为现有“战隼”战斗机的现代化套件。 F-16V 于 2012 年宣布并于 2015 年首飞，旨在使早期的 F-16 改型达到更先进的技术标准，而不需要运营商购买全新的飞机。
该套件对飞机的雷达、任务计算机、驾驶舱显示器和航空电子设备架构进行了重大改进。这些更改随后被纳入新制造飞机的 Block 70/72 生产配置中。 Block 名称标识了 F-16 的特定渐进生产标准，从 F-16A Block 1 开始。F-16C 和 F-16D 名称（类似于 F-16A 和 B，以及 F-16E 和 F）分别标识飞机的单座和两座变体。 ROCAF F-16V 准备快速反应啤酒

【原文 English Original】
Although often used interchangeably, the F-16V and the F-16C Block 70/72 designations describe two sides of the Viper’s evolution, with important differences between upgraded and newly built aircraft. The F-16 Fighting Falcon’s latest evolution has been at the center of several news in recent months, highlighting how the aircraft continues to evolve more than five decades after its first flight. From new-production fighters reaching customers to extensive modernization programs for existing fleets, the latest developments show that the fourth-generation fighter remains an important component of numerous air forces’ future plans. In October, Taiwan received its first two newly manufactured F-16C Block 70 fighters , part of a long-delayed order for 66 aircraft. The delivery marked an important milestone, with these jets complementing the island’s existing fleet upgraded to the F-16V configuration. A second batch was delivered in early November, while training on the aircraft continues in the U.S. at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. Aviation photographer Thomas Backus ( @machtwoimages ) photographed two of the airframes and kindly shared the images with us. Also in October, Lockheed Martin announced the maiden flight of Morocco’s first F-16D Block 72, which is also the first newly manufactured Block 72 jet . Morocco is also pursuing a parallel modernization effort, upgrading 23 existing F-16C/D Block 52 aircraft to the F-16V configuration. Speaking of modernized Vipers, in September, Greece received its 60th F-16V, as part of a program which will first see 84 F-16s Block 52+ and Block 52+ Advanced upgraded to the new configuration, followed by 38 older Block 50s. Meanwhile, Lockheed Martin pitched a Block 70-based variant called F-16G to the U.S. Air Force and the F-16C/D Block 70/72 to the Ukrainian Air Force.             Visualizza questo post su Instagram                         Un post condiviso da Thomas “Taj” Backus (@machtwoimages) These developments illustrate the different ways in which operators are investing in the Fighting Falcon. However, they have also brought renewed attention to a terminology that can be confusing even for aviation enthusiasts: F-16V, F-16C/D, Block 70 and Block 72. Although these designations are sometimes used interchangeably, they do not mean the same thing. Understanding what each designation means is essential to distinguish a newly manufactured F-16C/D Block 70/72 from an older F-16 upgraded to the F-16V configuration . Understanding the designations The F-16V, with the ‘V’ standing for the F-16’s nickname Viper, was introduced by Lockheed Martin as a modernization package for existing Fighting Falcons. Announced in 2012 and first flying in 2015 , the F-16V was intended to bring earlier F-16 variants up to a more advanced technological standard without requiring operators to purchase entirely new aircraft. The package introduced significant improvements to the aircraft’s radar, mission computers, cockpit displays and avionics architecture. These changes were subsequently incorporated into the Block 70/72 production configuration for newly manufactured aircraft. The Block designation identifies a particular progressive production standard of the F-16, starting with the F-16A Block 1. The F-16C and F-16D designations (similarly to the F-16A and B, and the F-16E and F ) identify the aircraft single-seat and two-seat variants, respectively. A ROCAF F-16V prepares for a Quick Reaction Alert mission during a combat readiness exercise in 2022. | Source: CNA Consequently, an F-16C Block 70/72 is a single-seat, newly manufactured Fighting Falcon built to the latest production standard, while an F-16D Block 70/72 is its two-seat counterpart. The Block 70 and 72 designations identify different engine configurations, which will be discussed later. An existing F-16C or F-16D (or, in Taiwan’s case, F-16A or F-16B ) modernized to the F-16V standard retains its original airframe and powerplant. However, many of its systems are brought up to a configuration comparable to the Block 70/72 production aircraft, with few differences. The similarities: radar and avionic upgrades Among the new systems installed om both the modernized F-16V and the newly manufactured Block 70/72 we can find the  APG-83 AESA  (Active Electronically Scanned Array) radar, a new Center Pedestal Display (CPD), the AN/APX-126 Advanced IFF (Identification Friend or Foe), Link 16 datalink, full NVIS (Night Vision Imaging System) and JHCMS II (Joint Helmet-Mounted Cueing System II) compatibility, a new Embedded GPS/INS (EGI), a modern commercial off-the-shelf (COTS)-based avionics subsystem, a high-volume, high-speed data bus and the  Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System (Auto GCAS). The radar, built by Northrop Grumman as the Scalable Agile Beam Radar (SABR), is undoubtedly one of the most important features. Notably, this radar is designed to fit the F-16 with no structural, power or cooling modifications, and is also being installed on U.S. Air Force F-16s as part of the ongoing upgrades . This AESA radar represents a significant improvement over the mechanically scanned AN/APG-66 and AN/APG-68 radars fitted to earlier F-16 variants. Unlike mechanically scanned radars, which rely on a moving antenna to direct the radar beam, an AESA uses multiple transmit/receive modules to electronically steer the beam. Two Republic of China Air Force (ROCAF) F-16C Block 70 jets on the ground at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. | Source: Thomas Backus machtwoimages The new radar enables the F-16 to detect, track and identify a greater number of targets (reportedly more than 20 at the same time) faster and at longer ranges while providing all-weather, high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) mapping. The system also integrated a robust electronic protection to operate in hostile electronic environments. The radar is complemented by an upgraded Modular Mission Computer and a modernized avionics architecture. This is designed to process the increased volume of information generated by the new sensors and provide pilots with a more comprehensive tactical picture. The cockpit has also received substantial improvements, with one of the most recognizable additions being the Center Pedestal Display (CPD). The CPS is a high-resolution, 6-by-8-inch color display installed in the center of the instrument panel instead of the older analog gauges, providing access to radar information, targeting pod imagery, digital maps and other tactical data, complementing the existing Multi-Function Displays (MFD). The newly manufactured aircraft also include new digital standby attitude indicator, engine and fuel gauges, as well as a new Integrated Control Panel (ICP) which includes the Data Entry Display (DED). On the other hand, the F-16V retains the original standby attitude indicator, engine and fuel gauges, and ICP, with the DED remaining in the original position. The differences: new and life-extended airframe Perhaps the most important distinction between a newly manufactured Block 70 and an older F-16 upgraded to the F-16V standard concerns the airframe itself. The Block 70/72 features a structural service life of 12,000 flight hours, while the F-16V features an airframe which already accumulated a number of flight hours and underwent a Service Life Extension Program (SLEP) during the upgrade . A Republic of China Air Force (ROCAF) F-16C Block 70 returns from a training sortie at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. | Source: Thomas Backus machtwoimages The Block 70/72’s structural service life is more than 50% greater than that of previous production F-16s, according to Lockheed Martin. This was achieved through structural improvements incorporated during manufacturing, allowing the aircraft to remain in service for several decades without requiring the same extensive structural interventions that older airframes may eventually need. This distinction is particularly important when comparing the two configurations. In fact, although an upgraded F-16V may offer similar avionics and mission capabilities to a Block 70/72, the latter starts from zero flight hours since it is newly manufactured, while the former’s service life depends on the original aircraft’s condition and operational history. Engine and external configuration The Block 70 and Block 72 designations, as mentioned earlier, identify different engine configurations. The Block 70 is powered by the General Electric F110-GE-129D turbofan , while the Block 72 uses the Pratt & Whitney F100-PW-229 engine. Both engines belong to established families already used by previous F-16 variants, but the choice of powerplant depends on the customer’s requirements and existing logistics infrastructure. The use of the Block x0/x2 designation goes back to the early 1980s, when it was first used for the F-16C/D Block 30 and Block 32 aircraft. The F-16’s initial variants – from the A/B Block 1 to the C/D Block 25 – were powered by the Pratt & Whitney F100-PW-200 turbofan, followed by the upgraded F100-PW-220 turbofan. However, in 1984, the U.S. Air Force decided to adopt both P&W and GE engines under the Alternative Fighter Engine (AFE) program. The F-16C/D Block 30/32 thus included a common engine bay, able to accept either powerplant. However, that was not the only modification required for the different engine. In fact, with GE’s F110 providing more thrust and thus requiring a larger airflow, the air inlet had to be enlarged. This led to the larger inlet becoming the standard for F110-powered F-16s, which were referred to as “ Big-mouths,” while the F100-powered F-16s retained the original smaller inlet as the larger one would be detrimental to the flight performance.

title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt
zh_title: 黄仁勋现在被指控与向他汇报的英伟达高管有染，涉嫌掩盖事实
summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）已经卷入与一名被美国情报部门认为代表中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情的丑闻。据报道，英伟达董事会现在正准备解雇黄。 《泰晤士报》援引英伟达内部五名匿名消息人士的话称，黄与该公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有关系。消息人士称，黄和鲍威尔三月份在圣何塞的一家酒店“被拍到亲热的视频”，
content:
据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）已经卷入与一名被美国情报部门认为代表中国从事间谍活动的女性发生婚外情的丑闻。据报道，英伟达董事会现在正准备解雇黄。 《泰晤士报》援引英伟达内部五名匿名消息人士的话称，黄与该公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有关系。消息人士称，黄和鲍威尔于 3 月份在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的一家酒店“亲昵地被拍到”，该公司的 GTC 会议就在那里举行。该报道称，酒店有人用智能手机拍摄了这一时刻，但黄的安全团队“隔离”了他们，并“向该人提出签署保密协议”。鲍威尔于2008年加入英伟达，并一直稳步晋升。 《泰晤士报》强调，Nvidia 的行为准则中提到，个人关系可能会导致利益冲突。和黄一样，她也嫁给了别人。 2018 年，英特尔前首席执行官布莱恩·科再奇 (Brian Krzanich) 因与一名员工发生关系而辞职，这也违反了公司的政策。 Nvidia 尚未回复 Tom's Hardware 的置评请求。如果我们收到回复，这个故事将会更新。
本周早些时候，有消息称詹森与新加坡公司 Megaspeed 的前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有婚外情，美国情报部门认为她是间谍。黄在给英伟达员工的电子邮件中承认了这一事件。中国否认了间谍活动的指控。 Nvidia 董事会正在对此事进行调查，由 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 律师事务所牵头。在调查正在进行期间，黄将继续经营该公司。律师事务所一直在竞相代表股东起诉该公司，其中包括一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控英伟达在有关该业务的重要事实上误导了投资者。国会众议院中国委员会已呼吁黄进行闭门会议，共和党议员表示这些报告“引发了重大的国家安全担忧”。黄仁勋一直是人工智能行业的领导者，提供该领域最受欢迎的芯片。他还听取了唐纳德·特朗普总统的意见，与他一起旅行并试图影响出口管制。特朗普告诉记者，联邦调查局正在调查黄，但英伟达首席执行官“完全不知道该人是间谍”。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — already embroiled in a scandal for an extramarital relationship with a woman believed by U.S. intelligence to be spying on behalf of China — reportedly had a separate affair with one of his direct reports, according to the New York Times . Nvidia's board is now reportedly preparing to fire Huang . The Times , citing five anonymous sources within Nvidia, says that Huang had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company's vice president of health care. The sources claim that Huang and Powell were "captured on video being affectionate" in March at a hotel in San Jose, Calif., where the company's GTC conference takes place. That report says that someone at the hotel filmed the moment on their smartphone, but that Huang's security team "sequestered" them and "made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement." Powell joined Nvidia in 2008 and has been steadily promoted. The Times highlights that personal relationships are mentioned as potentially causing conflicts of interest in Nvidia's code of conduct . Like Huang, she is married to someone else. In 2018, former Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned following a relationship with an employee, which was also against the company's policies. Nvidia has not responded to a request for comment from Tom's Hardware. This story will be updated if we hear back. Earlier this week, it came out that Jensen had an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, formerly a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and believed by U.S. intelligence to be a spy. Huang admitted to the affair in an email to Nvidia employees. China has denied claims of espionage. Nvidia's board has an ongoing investigation into that affair, led by the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. Huang is continuing to run the company while that investigation is ongoing. Law firms have been racing to sue the company on behalf of shareholders, including a proposed class-action lawsuit that Nvidia misled investors on material facts about the business. The Congressional House committee on China has called on Huang for a closed-door session, with Republican lawmakers saying the reports "raise significant national security concerns." Huang has been a leader of the AI industry, providing the most sought-after chips in the field. He has also had the ear of President Donald Trump, traveling with him and attempting to influence export controls. Trump told reporters that the FBI was investigating Huang, but also that the Nvidia CEO "had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy.”

summary: 据美国广播公司新闻报道，众议院外交事务委员会主席、佛罗里达州共和党众议员布莱恩·马斯特 (Brian Mast) 表示，如果英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 不回应委员会要求在 11 月 11 日星期三之前与他们在 11 月 18 日会面的要求，他将向他发出传票。众议院邀请他与众议院中国、外交和情报委员会负责人举行“联合闭门简报会”，他们将重点讨论他的公司的“针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议”。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
content:
据美国广播公司新闻报道，众议院外交事务委员会主席、佛罗里达州共和党众议员布莱恩·马斯特 (Brian Mast) 表示，如果英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 不回应委员会要求在 11 月 11 日星期三之前与他们在 11 月 18 日会面的要求，他将向他发出传票。众议院邀请他与众议院中国、外交和情报委员会负责人举行“联合闭门简报会”，他们将重点讨论他的公司的“针对外国对手间谍活动的安全协议”。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释说，国会于 11 月首次致电四面楚歌的首席执行官7 月 7 日，几天前，有关黄与一名涉嫌向中国情报机构传递信息的特定中国高管“关系密切”的谣言开始流传。第二天，Nvidia 发布了 Jensen 的一份声明，承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 有染，并为他的不忠行为道歉，同时该公司董事会确认，将针对该首席执行官受到中国国家安全部 (MSS) 特别针对的指控展开独立调查。
据报道，除了必须面对国会之外，黄仁勋还受到联邦调查局的调查。目前尚不清楚黄仁勋是否成为情报机构的目标，但他因人工智能热潮而声名鹊起，而这场热潮可以说是由英伟达的人工智能芯片推动的。这导致了我们今天所知的人工智能竞赛，美国因担心中国将这项技术用于军事目的而采取措施推迟中国的进步。我们也不知道黄乐或爱丽丝黄实际上是中国间谍还是陷入指控网络的“无辜”旁观者。而且，即使她确实与国家安全局合作，问题仍然是她是否专门针对英伟达首席执行官，或者中国情报部门是否发现了他们的轻率行为，并利用其作为敲诈勒索她信息的便利工具。然而，前中央情报局特工达雷尔·布洛克告诉美国广播公司新闻，当局应该只关注詹森。 “我认为最大的担忧是，仅仅关注或过度关注黄仁勋和英伟达可能会忽视其他人已成为中国人攻击目标的事实。他们是否在与工程师交谈？他们是否与其他可能比首席执行官拥有更多接触机会的人交谈？因此，这种关注不应该是单一的；它应该包括公司中的每个人，坦率地说，每家科技公司都应该关注其管理人员和员工拥有的所有联系人。” “这绝对不是一次性的事情。
当你经营一家价值数万亿美元的公司时，你知道你的背上有一个靶心； “无论是来自竞争还是来自民族国家，所以这绝对不是一次性的。黄仁勋并不是英伟达唯一一个能够接触到皇冠上的明珠的人，所以我会根据其他人所享有的接触机会以及他们与中国公民的接近程度来看待他们。”

【原文 English Original】
Rep. Brian Mast (R-Fla.), the chairperson of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, has said that he will issue a subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he does not respond to the committee’s request to meet with them on November 18 by Wednesday, November 11, according to ABC News . The House invited him to a “joint, closed-door briefing” with the heads of the House committees on China, Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence, and that they will focus on his company’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage.” Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Congress first called the embattled CEO on November 7, a few days after rumors started circulating about Huang’s “closeness” to a particular Chinese executive suspected of passing information to Chinese intelligence. The following day, Nvidia released a statement from Jensen admitting to an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, apologizing for his unfaithfulness, while the company’s board of directors confirmed it will launch an independent investigation regarding the allegations that the CEO has been specifically targeted by China’s Ministry of State Security (MSS). Aside from having to face Congress, Jensen Huang is also reportedly being looked into by the FBI. It remains unclear whether Jensen Huang was targeted by intelligence agencies, but he came into prominence with the AI boom that was arguably fueled by Nvidia’s AI chips. This led to the AI race as we know it today, with the U.S. taking steps to delay China’s advancement for fears that it will use the technology for military purposes. We also don’t know if Huang Le or Alice Huang is actually a Chinese spy or an “innocent” bystander caught in a web of accusations. And, even if she did work with the MSS, the question remains as to whether she specifically targeted the Nvidia CEO or whether Chinese intelligence discovered their indiscretion and used that as a convenient tool for blackmail to extract information from her. However, former CIA agent Darrel Blocker told ABC News that the authorities should just focus on Jensen. “I think that the biggest concern is that the focus or overfocus on just Jensen Huang and Nvidia risks losing sight of the fact that other people have been targeted by the Chinese. Are they talking to the engineers? Are they talking to other people who might have even more access than even the CEO has? So, this focus should not be singular; it should include everyone in the company, and quite frankly, every tech company out there should be looking at all the contacts that their officers and employees have.” “It’s definitely not a one-time thing. When you run a trillion-dollar company, you know that you have a bullseye on your back; whether it’s from competition or rather from nation-states, so this is absolutely not a one-off. Jensen Huang is not the only person at Nvidia that has access to the crown jewels, so I would be looking at the other people in terms of the access that they enjoy and their proximity to Chinese nationals.”

content:
随着五角大楼最终完成对美国在欧洲的军事态势的审查，一项相对较小的承诺值得避免预算削减：即在北约科索沃部队服役的约 600 名美国士兵。他们几乎没有参与关于旅和数十亿美元项目的辩论，但他们在巴尔干地区保持了来之不易的和平，将他们撤出几乎什么也挽救不了，同时让莫斯科获得了廉价的战略胜利。驻科部队于 1999 年 6 月在北约指挥下部署，此前北约轰炸了南斯拉夫，以制止斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇领导的塞尔维亚军队对阿尔巴尼亚人的暴力行为。科索沃于2008年宣布独立，但塞尔维亚在俄罗斯和中国的支持下仍然拒绝承认。欧洲态势评估是一项合法的活动。在多年来敦促欧洲盟国承担更多常规防御之后，特朗普政府正确地提出了一些尖锐的问题，即美国军队在哪些方面可以增加独特的价值，以及在适当的时间发展其能力和能力的情况下欧洲可以在哪些方面加强。但驻科部队是一项美国角色不易被取代的任务，因为它既是政治性的，也是军事性的，而且错误的决定可能会导致欧洲东南侧的不稳定。从威胁开始。即使在乌克兰遭受重大损失的同时，弗拉基米尔·普京也没有放弃破坏欧洲稳定的努力。巴尔干地区是欧洲的软肋，是一个备受青睐的舞台：搅动成本低廉，是一个分散西方对乌克兰注意力的地方。
莫斯科长期以来一直利用塞尔维亚作为破坏科索沃稳定的杠杆。2017年，一列俄罗斯制造的火车开往科索沃北部，这是一次带有“科索沃是塞尔维亚”口号的滚动挑衅。俄罗斯在科索沃附近运营着一个所谓的人道主义中心，该中心被怀疑充当俄罗斯情报站。塞尔维亚与俄罗斯密切的情报联系使莫斯科能够接触到准备挑衅的当地民族主义力量。 2023年，科索沃北部警察遭到武装袭击，普里什蒂纳将此归咎于塞尔维亚支持的武装分子，这加剧了人们对与俄罗斯结盟的行为体利用紧张局势的担忧；今年早些时候，俄罗斯外交部长警告称，“欧洲中心正在酝酿一场重大爆炸性局势”。紧张局势一再爆发。 2023年5月，塞尔维亚抗议者与科索沃警察发生冲突，造成90多名北约维和人员受伤，促使塞尔维亚提高军事戒备级别。那年 9 月，在巴尼斯卡发生的一次袭击中，全副武装的塞族枪手杀死了一名科索沃警察，并将自己关在一座修道院里，这表明当地的冲突可以多么迅速地演变为地区危机。危险还没有过去。塞尔维亚强人亚历山大·武契奇承认在10月25日的塞尔维亚议会选举中落败，但贝尔格莱德的外交政策方向尚不确定，人们担心其对科索沃的看法不会改变。

【原文 English Original】
As the Pentagon finalizes its review of U.S. force posture in Europe, one relatively small commitment deserves protection from the budget axe: the roughly 600 American troops serving in NATO’s Kosovo Force. They barely register in a debate about brigades and billion-dollar line items, but they keep a hard-won peace in the Balkans, and pulling them out would save almost nothing while handing Moscow a cheap strategic win. KFOR was deployed in June 1999 under NATO command, after the alliance bombed Yugoslavia to stop the violence perpetrated by Slobodan Milosevic’s Serbian forces against ethnic Albanians. Kosovo declared independence in 2008, but Serbia, backed by Russia and China, still refuses to recognize it. The Europe posture review is a legitimate exercise. After years of urging European allies to shoulder more of their own conventional defense, the Trump administration is right to ask hard questions about where American forces add unique value and where Europe can step up given suitable time to develop their capabilities and capacities. But KFOR is a mission in which the American role is not easily replaced, because it is as much political as military, and where a wrong call risks instability on Europe’s southeastern flank. Start with the threat. Even while absorbing heavy losses in Ukraine, Vladimir Putin has not given up on destabilizing Europe. The Balkans, Europe’s soft underbelly, are a favored arena: cheap to stir, a place to distract Western attention from Ukraine. Moscow has long used Serbia as a lever against Kosovo’s stability. In 2017, a Russian-made train was sent toward northern Kosovo, a rolling provocation that bore the slogan “Kosovo is Serbia.” Russia runs a so-called humanitarian center near Kosovo that is suspected of serving as a Russian intelligence station. Close Serbian-Russian intelligence ties give Moscow access to local nationalist forces prepared for provocations. In 2023, an armed attack on Kosovo police in the north, which Pristina blamed on Serbian-backed militants, heightened fears that Russian-aligned actors were exploiting the tension; earlier that year, Russia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs warned that “a major explosive situation is brewing in the heart of Europe.” Tensions have repeatedly flared. In May 2023, clashes between Serb protesters and Kosovo police injured more than 90 NATO peacekeepers and prompted Serbia to raise its military alert level. That September, an attack in Banjska, where heavily armed Serb gunmen killed a Kosovo police officer and barricaded themselves in a monastery, showed how quickly a local flare-up can become a regional crisis. The danger has not passed. Serbian strongman Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat in Serbia’s Oct. 25 parliamentary election, but Belgrade’s foreign-policy direction is uncertain and there are concerns that its views on Kosovo will not change. In October, Russia’s ambassador to the UN warned that the situation in Kosovo “remains persistently tense and is literally teetering on the brink.” Still, Kosovo and Serbia have remained at peace since 1999, in large part because of KFOR. In the words of a bipartisan group of U.S lawmakers, the force functions as “a political deterrent to those seeking to stoke ethnic violence.” An American drawdown from KFOR may embolden nationalist agendas in Kosovo and Serbia as well as separatist ambitions in Republika Srpska, the Serb-dominated region in nearby Bosnia. The American presence in KFOR is valued precisely because it is American. U.S. troops have anchored KFOR since its creation, and Washington currently leads Regional Command East, a position of real operational weight, not symbolism. The U.S. has traditionally provided the 600 or so American troops—often Army National Guardsmen—an economy-of-force mission with minimal cost or effect on the U.S. Army’s ability to execute missions elsewhere around the globe. The mission accounts for less than 1 percent of the total U.S. troops in Europe. KFOR’s value becomes plain when contrasted with Operation Althea in neighboring Bosnia. EUFOR, an EU-led force with roughly 1,500 troops, has struggled to respond decisively to repeated provocations by Republika Srpska leader Milorad Dodik, who’s backed by Moscow and Belgrade. EU ambassadors rejected Bosnian appeals to help enforce an arrest warrant against him in 2025, citing political risk. Dodik has openly mocked EUFOR’s patrols. Lacking an American anchor and a unified chain of command willing to act, EUFOR has too often had to manage crises rather than deterring them. KFOR, by contrast, has demonstrated it can surge forces when tested, providing genuine deterrence. After the 2023 Banjska incident, NATO increased its peacekeeping presence in Kosovo. Serbia drew down its border deployment, ending the crisis. The Pentagon is right to ask what the value of an American military presence is worth. For KFOR, the answer is plain: a few hundred U.S. troops are successfully maintaining a quarter-century-long peace that Russia would love to see unravel. Lawmakers from both parties already understand that. The Pentagon should, too, and keep KFOR intact. Mark Montgomery, a retired U.S. Navy rear admiral, serves as a senior director at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies’ (FDD), where Ivana Stradner is a research fellow. ]]>

title: US postpones ‘million-dollar’ China ship tax until January
zh_title: 美国将“百万美元”的中国船舶税推迟至一月
summary: 根据周二在《联邦公报》上发布的通知，美国已将针对与中国相关的航运的暂停征收港口费的期限再延长两个月，并将该措施搁置至 2027 年 1 月 9 日。这一决定使华盛顿和北京有更多时间就影响海事、物流和造船业的中国政策进行谈判。美国贸易代表办公室表示，延期于 11 月 9 日生效，一直持续到晚上 11 点 59 分。东部时间 1 月 9 日。此前，自 202 年 11 月 10 日起暂停一年
content:
根据周二在《联邦公报》上发布的通知，美国已将针对与中国相关的航运的暂停征收港口费的期限再延长两个月，并将该措施搁置至 2027 年 1 月 9 日。这一决定使华盛顿和北京有更多时间就影响海事、物流和造船业的中国政策进行谈判。美国贸易代表办公室表示，延期于 11 月 9 日生效，一直持续到晚上 11 点 59 分。东部时间 1 月 9 日。根据唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平宣布的贸易协议，自 2025 年 11 月 10 日开始暂停一年。暂停还继续涵盖该机构先前行动中指定的对中国船岸起重机和其他货物装卸设备的额外关税。中国还将暂停向与美国有联系的船只征收港口互惠费的期限延长至 1 月 10 日。美国贸易代表办公室表示，支持最初暂停征收的情况仍然存在，需要与中国进行进一步讨论。对于单艘船只的访问，美国的费用可能高达数百万美元。例如，一艘 50,000 净吨的船舶将欠 250 万美元的费用。这些措施源于美国根据 1974 年贸易法第 301 条对中国针对海事、物流和造船业争夺主导地位进行的调查。
暂停收费类别包括影响中国拥有或经营的船舶、中国建造的船舶和外国建造的车辆运输船的收费。 在向美国贸易代表办公室发表评论时，暂停的支持者认为，这将避免更高的运输成本，防止商业中断并为谈判提供时间。一些人寻求永久暂停某些费用，警告称这些费用的退回可能会扰乱贸易并损害美国的出口。反对者认为，这些费用是为了鼓励对美国造船业和相关行业（包括集装箱制造）的投资。一些评论者还敦促美国贸易代表将货运设备关税与海运服务费分开处理，并结束暂停征收这些关税。美国贸易代表办公室表示，美国将利用额外的谈判时间来解决与中国的关切，同时继续努力扩大国内商业造船能力、发展劳动力并与盟国合作。重要性：相互暂停可以避免额外的运输成本和潜在的干扰，不仅影响美国和中国的承运人，而且影响全世界依赖中国制造船舶的企业。在贸易谈判继续进行的同时，它为进口商、出口商和船东提供了暂时的缓解。请在此处阅读斯图尔特·奇尔斯 (Stuart Chirls) 撰写的更多文章。了解更多：随着第三季度亚洲-美国海运收入攀升，第三季度运输成本上升挤压制造商，奖励铁路并重塑贸易，中远集团利润猛增 81%。
Xeneta 表示，自伊朗战争爆发以来，西海岸海运集装箱即期运价上涨了 343%，随着工会合同谈判的继续，洛杉矶-长滩港的罢工被推迟。随着货运定价压力的加大，北美集装箱进口量增长了 9%。美国将“百万美元”的中国船舶税推迟到 1 月份首次出现在 FreightWaves 上。

【原文 English Original】
The United States has extended the suspension of port fees targeting China-linked shipping for another two months, keeping the measures on hold through January 9, 2027, according to a notice published Tuesday in the Federal Register. The decision gives Washington and Beijing additional time to negotiate over Chinese policies affecting the maritime, logistics and shipbuilding industries. The Office of the United States Trade Representative said the extension took effect November 9 and runs through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on January 9. It follows a one-year suspension that began November 10, 2025, under a trade agreement announced by President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The pause also continues to cover additional duties on Chinese ship-to-shore cranes and other cargo-handling equipment specified in the agency’s earlier action.  China also extended its suspension of reciprocal port fees on U.S.-linked vessels until January 10. USTR said the circumstances supporting the original suspension remain in place and that further discussions with China are needed.  The U.S. fees could amount to millions of dollars for a single vessel’s visit. A 50,000-net ton ship, for example, would owe $2.5 million in charges. The measures arose from the U.S. investigation under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 into China’s targeting of the maritime, logistics and shipbuilding sectors for dominance. The suspended fee categories include charges affecting Chinese-owned or operated vessels, Chinese-built vessels and foreign-built vehicle carriers. In comments to USTR, supporters of the pause argued that it would avoid higher shipping costs, prevent commercial disruptions and provide time for negotiations. Some sought permanent suspension of certain fees, warning that their return could disrupt trade and harm U.S. exports. Opponents argued that the fees are needed to encourage investment in American shipbuilding and related industries, including container manufacturing. Some commenters also urged USTR to treat cargo-equipment tariffs separately from maritime service fees and end the suspension of those tariffs. USTR said the United States will use the additional negotiating period to pursue its concerns with China while continuing efforts to expand domestic commercial shipbuilding capacity, develop the workforce and cooperate with allies. Why it matters: The reciprocal pause averts additional shipping costs and potential disruptions affecting not only U.S. and Chinese carriers but also businesses worldwide that rely on Chinese-built vessels. It gives importers, exporters and shipowners temporary relief while trade negotiations continue. Read more articles by Stuart Chirls  here . title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s involvement with an alleged Chinese spy is the stuff of Hollywood thrillers. These 10, for example
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名所谓的中国间谍的牵连堪称好莱坞惊悚片的情节。例如这10个
summary: 世界上最成功的公司之一的亿万富翁首席执行官与一位迷人的坐飞机的女商人发生了风流韵事。他变得更加亲密，分享了更多——却发现她秘密是一名中国间谍。听起来就像好莱坞大片的情节。但据称，这一情节的一个版本正在全球第二大市值公司英伟达内部真实展开。据报道，首席执行官黄仁勋承认与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者被指控与中国政府合作。英伟达董事会表示，它正在努力
content:
世界上最成功的公司之一的亿万富翁首席执行官与一位迷人的坐飞机的女商人发生了风流韵事。他变得更加亲密，分享了更多——却发现她秘密是一名中国间谍。听起来就像好莱坞大片的情节。但据称，这一情节的一个版本正在全球第二大市值公司英伟达内部真实展开。据报道，首席执行官黄仁勋承认与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者被指控与中国政府合作。英伟达董事会表示仍在调查这些指控，并且没有理由相信商业秘密遭到泄露。与此同时，好莱坞近一个世纪以来一直在探索“美人计”情节。这里有 10 个值得注意的例子。 1. FX 广受好评的《美国谍梦》（2013-2018）间谍剧对长期的美人陷阱进行了多层次的描绘。凯丽·拉塞尔和马修·里斯饰演伊丽莎白·詹宁斯和菲利普·詹宁斯，他们是冷战期间渗透到美国的苏联间谍。大多数美人计情节都将女间谍描绘成诱惑者。美国人翻转了剧本——带来了毁灭性的结果。 2.《红麻雀》(Red Sparrow) (2018) 詹妮弗·劳伦斯 (Jennifer Lawrence) 饰演多米尼卡·叶戈洛娃 (Dominika Egorova)，她是一名俄罗斯芭蕾舞演员，被招募到秘密情报计划中。叶戈洛娃在追捕一名中央情报局特工并受到俄罗斯上司的精心控制的过程中，发现对美人计特工的操纵是双向的。 3.
色戒 (2007) 美人计是西方间谍片的主要内容。但相同的基本情节跨越文化。在李安的这部影片中，汤唯扮演了一名在日本占领中国期间被抵抗组织招募的年轻女子。她的任务是安排暗杀目标，但感情开始阻碍她。 4. 《美人计》 (1946) 阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克 (Alfred Hitchcock) 1946 年的电影证明了美人计让几代编剧和导演着迷。 《美人计》由英格丽·褒曼和加里·格兰特等传奇演员组成，探索当美人计变成三角恋时会发生什么。 5. 小鼓手女孩 (2018) 尽管好莱坞为银幕上描绘美人陷阱提供了特别肥沃的土壤，但美人陷阱的想法也是间谍小说的主要内容。典型的例子：约翰·勒卡雷的间谍惊悚片，被改编成银幕的《小鼓手女孩》。这部迷你剧描绘了以色列情报部队的一名年轻新兵，其任务是渗透到一个巴勒斯坦激进组织，模糊了虚假身份和真实身份之间的界限。 6. 《黑皮书》（2006） 这部保罗·范霍文的电影以二战期间纳粹占领的荷兰为背景。犹太特工雷切尔·斯坦（卡丽斯·范·豪顿饰）肩负着渗透德国情报圈的任务，她开始质疑周围人的真正忠诚度。 7. 《使女》 (2016) 大多数美人计都涉及间谍和间谍活动的秘密世界。
但也有一些人在不太隐秘的地方探索了同样的总体思路。韩国电影制片人朴赞郁 (Park Chan-Wook) 2016 年的电影讲述了一名年轻扒手被招募来帮助一名骗子勾引一名富有的女继承人的故事。然而，很快就不清楚谁在操纵谁。 8. M. Butterfly (1993) 在间谍活动的绝密世界中发生的大部分事情仍然是：绝密。但现实生活中的谍战剧偶尔也会被解密。当这种情况发生时，它们通常会成为好莱坞故事的绝佳素材。情况就是如此

【原文 English Original】
The billionaire CEO of one of the world’s most successful companies is drawn into an affair with an alluring, jet-setting businesswoman. He becomes closer and shares more—only to discover that she’s secretly a Chinese spy. It sounds like the plot of a Hollywood blockbuster. But a version of that plotline is allegedly unfolding for real inside Nvidia , the world’s second most valuable company. CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who is accused of working with the Chinese government . Nvidia’s board says it’s still investigating the allegations, and that it has no reason to believe trade secrets were compromised. Hollywood, meanwhile, has been exploring the “honey trap” plot for nearly a century. Here are 10 notable examples. 1. The Americans (2013-2018) FX’s critically acclaimed spy drama offers a multi-layered portrayal of the long-term honey trap. Keri Russell and Matthew Rhys star as Elizabeth and Philip Jennings, Soviet spies infiltrating America during the Cold War. Most honey trap plots portray a female spy as the seducer. The Americans flips the script—with devastating results. 2. Red Sparrow (2018) Jennifer Lawrence plays Dominika Egorova, a Russian ballerina recruited into a secret intelligence program. Pursuing a CIA operative and carefully controlled by her Russian handlers, Egorova discovers that the manipulation of a honey trap agent can go both ways. 3. Lust, Caution (2007) The honey trap is a staple of Western spy films. But the same basic plotline cuts across cultures. In this film from Ang Lee, Tang Wei portrays a young woman who is recruited by a resistance organization during the Japanese occupation of China. Her mission is to arrange for her target’s assassination, but feelings begin to get in the way. 4. Notorious (1946) Alfred Hitchcock’s 1946 film is proof that the honey trap has fascinated screenwriters and directors for generations. With a legendary cast, including Ingrid Bergman and Cary Grant, Notorious explores what happens when a honey trap becomes a love triangle. 5. The Little Drummer Girl (2018) Although Hollywood has provided especially fertile ground to depict honey traps on the screen, the idea of a honey trap is a staple of the spy novel, too. Case in point: John le Carré’s espionage thriller, which was adapted for the screen as The Little Drummer Girl . The miniseries depicts a young recruit of the Israeli intelligence forces tasked with infiltrating a Palestinian militant organization, blurring the lines between fake and real identities. 6. Black Book (2006) This Paul Verhoeven film is set in the Nazi-occupied Netherlands during World War II. Tasked with infiltrating German intelligence circles, Jewish operative Rachel Stein (Carice van Houten) begins to question the real loyalties of those around her. 7. The Handmaiden (2016) Most honey traps involve spies and the clandestine world of espionage. But some explore the same general idea in less secretive places. South Korean filmmaker Park Chan-Wook’s 2016 film depicts a young pickpocket who is recruited to help a con artist seduce a wealthy heiress. It quickly becomes unclear, though, who is manipulating whom. 8. M. Butterfly (1993) Much of what happens in the top secret world of espionage remains exactly that: top secret. But occasionally real-life spy dramas are declassified. When that happens, they often make great material for a Hollywood story. That’s the case with this film about a diplomat who is seduced by a Chinese opera singer. Inspired by real events, the film shows how even a high-level figure can be drawn into a honey trap.  9. From Russia With Love (1963) James Bond may be able to skydive into a falling airplane or windsurf a tsunami , but even he can fall prey to the honey trap. The classic Bond film From Russia With Love centers around Soviet clerk Tatiana Romanova, who appears willing to defect—and draws Bond into a romantic entanglement. But as is so often the case in Bond’s world, things get “shaken” up, as the truth about Romanova comes out. 10. Ex Machina (2014) Not every honey trap operative needs to be human. In Alex Garland’s classic sci-fi film, a young programmer, Caleb, is tasked with evaluating an advanced artificial intelligence system named Ava. As man and machine become closer, the film questions whether their attraction is real—or whether Ava is secretly manipulating Caleb to achieve her own aim. Given Nvidia’s role as the shovel seller of the AI gold rush, the idea of a honey-trapping AI feels especially apt.

title: Nvidia stock gets its first boost of the Jensen Huang scandal era. What’s driving shares higher today?
zh_title: 英伟达股价在黄仁勋丑闻时代首次上涨。今天是什么推动股价走高？
summary: Nvidia Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的股价周三盘前上涨超过 4%，这要归功于 CoreWeave。在首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍有婚外情的消息传出后，这家半导体巨头连续几天目睹其股价暴跌。过去五天股价下跌 15.61%，本月下跌 26.34%。现在，Nvidia 的股票似乎受益于 CoreWeave 的好消息。周二，这家云计算公司公布了第三季度收益，超出了华尔街的收入预期，并改善了前景。 CoreWeave 收入增至 36.6 亿美元
content:
Nvidia Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的股价周三盘前上涨超过 4%，这要归功于 CoreWeave。在首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍有婚外情的消息传出后，这家半导体巨头连续几天目睹其股价暴跌。过去五天股价下跌 15.61%，本月下跌 26.34%。现在，Nvidia 的股票似乎受益于 CoreWeave 的好消息。周二，这家云计算公司公布了第三季度收益，超出了华尔街的收入预期，并改善了前景。根据 CNBC 援引的共识估计，CoreWeave 的收入升至 36.6 亿美元，高于预期的 35.5 亿美元。其收入同比增长 168%。该公司还将 2026 年全年收入预期从 130 亿美元上调至 133 亿美元。作为回应，CoreWeave 的股价（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）在周三盘前上涨了 15% 以上。为什么 CoreWeave 的成功对 Nvidia 有帮助？总体而言，当一家大型人工智能公司取得成功时，它有助于缓解投资者对人工智能泡沫破裂的担忧，从而提振其他人工智能股票。在这种情况下，Nvidia 可以从 CoreWeave 的成功中获益更多。今年1月，英伟达向CoreWeave投资20亿美元，成为该公司第二大股东。因此，当 CoreWeave 表现出色时，它会直接提升 Nvidia 的地位。此次上涨也标志着 CoreWeave 的好转，该公司的股价因担心人工智能超支而陷入困境。
像专门针对人工智能的云提供商 CoreWeave 这样的所谓新云公司最近受到的打击尤其严重。在发布财报之前，CoreWeave 的股价上个月下跌了 40.63%。英伟达会发生什么？英伟达的情况将如何改变，目前谁都在猜测。博彩市场预测黄仁勋不会辞去首席执行官一职——至少在短期内不会。公司董事会目前正在调查他的事件以及对公司的影响。与此同时，贝尔德刚刚将英伟达的股票评级从“跑赢大盘”下调至“中性”。据 CNBC 报道，摩根士丹利也放弃了英伟达的首选公司之一。

【原文 English Original】
Shares of Nvidia Corp. (Nasdaq: NVDA) rose over 4% in premarket on Wednesday, and it has CoreWeave to thank. The semiconductor giant has spent days watching its stock tumble following news that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with a alleged Chinese spy. Shares were down 15.61% in the last five days and 26.34% for the month. Now, Nvidia’s stock appears to be benefiting from good news over at CoreWeave. On Tuesday, the cloud-computing company shared third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street’s revenue estimates and included an improved outlook. CoreWeave’s revenue rose to $3.66 billion, higher than the expected $3.55 billion, according to consensus estimates cited by CNBC . Its revenue was up 168% year-over-year (YOY).  The company also raised its 2026 full year outlook for revenue from $13 billion to $13.3 billion.  CoreWeave’s shares (Nasdaq: CRWV) rose over 15% during premarket Wednesday in response.   Why does CoreWeave’s success help Nvidia? Overall, when one major AI company succeeds it helps ease investors’ concerns about the AI bubble bursting, buoying fellow AI stocks alongside it. In this case, Nvidia has even more to gain from CoreWeave’s success. In January, Nvidia invested $2 billion in CoreWeave , making it the company’s second largest shareholder. So, when CoreWeave does well, it directly boosts Nvidia’s standing. This jump also marks a turnaround for CoreWeave, which has seen its stock struggle amid fears of AI overspending . So-called neocloud companies like CoreWeave, a cloud provider specialized for AI, have been hit especially hard recently. Ahead of its earnings report, CoreWeave’s shares were down 40.63% in the last month. What will happen at Nvidia? How things at Nvidia will shake out is anyone’s guess right now. Betting markets predict that Huang won’t leave the CEO role —at least any time soon. The company’s board of directors is currently investigating his affair and any impact on the company. At the same time, Baird just downgraded Nvidia’s stock from “Outperform” to “Neutral.” Morgan Stanley also dropped Nvidia as one of its top picks, CNBC reports .

title: John Kerry: America Must Now Follow China’s Lead on Clean Energy

content:
本文最初由《卫报》发表，并作为气候服务台合作的一部分转载于此。 美国前国务卿约翰·克里告诉《卫报》，中国正在引领世界摆脱化石燃料，包括美国在内的全球其他国家现在必须效仿，因为警察观察家想知道中国将如何应对今年的气候峰会。随着今年气候大会在土耳其举行的第三十一届缔约方大会开幕，人们纷纷猜测中国是否最终会担任其长期以来一直回避的领导角色。在2026年3月通过的最新“五年计划”中，中国首次承诺“积极参与和引领全球气候治理”。第三十一届缔约方会议可能首次表明北京已准备好将这一言论付诸行动，而这是中国历来不愿做的事情。绿色能源是出口引擎的重要组成部分，使中国在疫情后低迷的经济保持在正轨。其出口的成功与其未能大幅提振国内一般消费形成鲜明对比，这一结构性弱点一直困扰着领导人。 2025年，清洁技术出口将超过2200亿美元，今年应该会再次增长；这个世界上最大的排放国现在是世界领先的清洁能源技术供应商。
中国约占太阳能供应链产能的 85% 和锂离子电池供应链产能的 80%，到 2025 年，近 75% 的电动汽车都是在中国生产的。“市场已经做出了决定，全球正在转向电子和电解状态……这是不可阻挡的。”中国现在采取的明智举措将使其成为未来国家世界秩序的关键，说服竞争对手进行合作，并巩固其在南半球的影响力。与此同时，包括唐纳德·特朗普领导下的美国在内的其他国家却严重落后。克里表示，除非他们也接受低碳电力和快速电气化，否则他们将在经济上遭受损失，并使气候面临进一步的危险。 “唯一一个大幅加速的国家是中国。世界其他国家都在跌跌撞撞地前进，而大自然每周、每天都在向我们发出更强有力的信号，”他说。 “[中国]突然意识到他们对其他地方的石油和天然气有太多的依赖，他们决定需要独立。自从伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡被中断以来，其他国家也做出了类似的决定，他们正在独立行动。可再生能源的部署大幅增加。谢谢你，唐纳德·特朗普。”他补充说，对于没有自由公正选举的独裁国家来说，看到中国获得的经济利益将成为采取低碳增长的动力。
“他们会看到市场走向，他们会认识到哪里有更便宜的替代品。甚至他们可以阅读电子表格，了解哪里（化石燃料）成本过高，哪里有更好的交易，”克里说。 “目前，可再生能源与存储以及一些过渡性天然气比仅仅使用化石燃料更便宜、更有效。”他补充道：“市场已经做出了决定，全球范围内正在转向电子和静电状态。人们将转向电力，他们将尝试尽可能清洁地做到这一点。这是我看到在许多不同地方正在实施的选择。它是

【原文 English Original】
This story was originally published by  The Guardian and is reproduced here as part of the  Climate Desk   collaboration. ​ China is leading the world in moving away from fossil fuels , and the rest of the globe—including the United States—must now follow, former US Secretary of State John Kerry has told The Guardian , as Cop watchers wonder exactly how China is going to approach this year’s climate summit. As Cop31 opens—this year the climate conference is in Turkey —there is plenty of speculation about whether China will finally step into the leadership role that it has long avoided. In its latest “five-year plan” adopted in March 2026, China for the first time pledged to “actively participate in and lead global climate governance.” Cop31 could provide the first indications Beijing is ready to put that rhetoric into action, something it has historically been reluctant to do. Green energy is a vital component of the export engine that has kept China’s sluggish post-pandemic economy on track. The success of its exports stands in contrast to its failure to significantly boost domestic general consumption, a structural weakness that has persistently vexed leaders. In 2025, clean-tech exports surpassed $220bn, and they should grow again this year; the world’s largest emitter is now the world’s leading supplier of clean energy technology. China accounts for about 85 percent of solar and 80 percent of lithium-ion battery supply chain production capacity, and in 2025, nearly 75 percent of electric cars were manufactured there. “The marketplace has made its decision and globally is moving to electrons, and electrostate status…It is unstoppable.” Smart moves now by China would position it as a linchpin in a future electrostate world order, persuade rivals to cooperate, and solidify its influence in the global south. Meanwhile other countries, including the US under Donald Trump, have fallen badly behind. Kerry said they would lose out economically—as well as putting the climate in further danger—unless they, too, embraced low-carbon power and rapid electrification. “The only country that has hugely accelerated is China. The rest of the world is stumbling along while Mother Nature is sending us more powerful signals every week, every day,” he said. “[China] realized suddenly they had way too much dependency on oil and gas from other places, and they decided they needed to be independent. Other countries, since the war in Iran, and since the strait of Hormuz has been interrupted, have made a similar decision, and they’re moving independently. There’s been a massive uptick in deployment of renewables. Thank you, Donald Trump.” For autocratic states without free and fair elections , seeing the economic benefits reaped by China would be the spur to adopt low-carbon growth, he added. “They’ll see where the market is going, and they will recognize where the cheaper alternatives are. Even they can read a spreadsheet, and understand where costs are exorbitant [in fossil fuels], and where you have a better deal,” Kerry said. “Right now, renewables together with storage, together with some transitional gas, is cheaper and more effective, than just going with fossil fuels.” He added: “The marketplace has made its decision and globally is moving to electrons, and electrostate status. People are going to electricity and they’re going to try to do that as clean as humanly possible. That’s the choice that I see being implemented in many different places. It is unstoppable.” China has already said it wants Cop31 to discuss the free flow of green technology against a backdrop of “intensifying” geopolitical conflicts—widely seen as a reference to US and EU tariffs on items such as Chinese electric vehicles and solar products. Li Shuo from the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI) puts it this way : “In a world where climate action was once seen as a constraint on growth but is now increasingly a driver of it, China faces a singular question: will it step into a leadership role not out of obligation, but out of self-interest?” The summit’s presidency has promised this Cop will be one of “implementation and acceleration”—and when it comes to the green transition, nowhere has implemented or accelerated quite like China. As a result, emissions have been in a “flat or falling” trend since March 2024, analysis for Carbon Brief shows . Beijing sees the energy transition as “central to economic modernisation and energy security, with significant implications for international influence”, said Kevin Tu from the Oxford Institute for Energy Studies. The wars in Ukraine and the Middle East and their effect on oil and gas supplies have only hardened that stance. The world needs “to be ready to accept China’s leadership, and I don’t think this is the case, especially for global north countries.” The conflicts have also highlighted the geopolitical implications of a planetary shift to green energy. In the fossil fuel era, the designation of the US dollar as the global trading currency for oil gave Washington “what has been termed the exorbitant privilege of being the global lender of last resort,” said Isabel Hilton, the founder of the specialist environment outlet China Dialogue. “Without that, the US position in the world looks weaker, and if you add China’s dominance of the supply of clean technologies and the supply chains that produce them, US dominance looks more vulnerable still.” Meanwhile, President Xi Jinping describes China as a “doer and go-getter working for the cause of global development” and state media frequently showcase Chinese renewable projects in countries ranging from Indonesia to Pakistan and Kenya. The value of the green energy deals in China’s belt and road initiative in the first half of 2026 has already surpassed the total for the whole of 2025, a recent analysis showed . Those countries could be useful allies if China can get the subject of tariffs into the talks. “China is likely to find support from Brazil, India, South Africa and other developing countries concerned about the costs and market-access effects of climate-related trade measures,” said Tu. China has generally held back from policy ambition or agenda-setting at forums such as Cop. Its attitude to the plans to set a global target for electrification has been ambivalent, even though it would easily hit it, according to ASPI’s Kate Logan. Partly, China has an aversion to prescriptive outside targets, but it is also trying to navigate the divergent interests of its global south partners. Yixian Sun, a professor of sustainability governance at the University of Bath, said: “I still think there is a mismatch between Chinese policymakers’ views on the role that China can play in global climate governance and international expectations on the influence that China should exert.” If the world wants China to play a leadership role, the environment needs to change, and more trust extended, he says. “They have to be ready to accept China’s leadership, and I don’t think this is the case, especially for global north countries.” Analysts will watch China’s actions around climate finance commitments and support for a “just transition”—a framework designed to secure workers’ rights and livelihoods in the move away from fossil fuels. They will also be looking for signals Beijing will bid for Cop33 in 2028; officials are said to be trying to decide if hosting would be beneficial. For now, said Logan, “China would be happy with a Cop that doesn’t necessarily produce anything monumental, but comes out with a relatively cooperative outcome…so no major drama.”

title: Democrats Miss Hegseth Impeachment Vote for 'Elect Democratic Women' Event
zh_title: 民主党人错过了“选举民主党女性”活动的赫格斯弹劾投票
summary: 国会议员实际上只有一项工作：出席并投票。他们往往懒得去做这件事。周二下午，众议院以 211 票对 204 票决定不对弹劾战争部长皮特·赫格斯进行全面投票，除倾向自由主义的众议员托马斯·马西（肯塔基州共和党人）外，所有共和党人都投票反对弹劾。据《Politico》报道，共和党领导层实际上一直期待弹劾案能够推进并获得通过。但有 11 名民主党人错过了投票。据 Axios 记者报道，其中一些人正在参加一个名为“选举民主 W”组织的招待会。
content:
国会议员实际上只有一项工作：出席并投票。他们往往懒得去做这件事。周二下午，众议院以 211 票对 204 票决定不对弹劾战争部长皮特·赫格斯进行全面投票，除倾向自由主义的众议员托马斯·马西（肯塔基州共和党人）外，所有共和党人都投票反对弹劾。据《Politico》报道，共和党领导层实际上一直期待弹劾案能够推进并获得通过。但有 11 名民主党人错过了投票。据 Axios 记者报道，其中一些人正在参加一个名为“选举民主妇女”组织的招待会。讽刺的是，该组织是由众议院民主党党鞭凯瑟琳·克拉克（康涅狄格州）创立的，她的字面意思是确保成员以正确的方式投票。民主党人并不是唯一逃学的人。七名共和党人也未能出席。避免对具体弹劾条款进行投票的程序决定表明，许多成员根本不想将自己的立场记录在案。两党都异常大规模地缺席了一场势均力敌、高风险的投票（往往理由站不住脚），这也是如此。有些缺席是不可避免的。众议员卢·科雷亚（加利福尼亚州民主党人）事先曾公开警告称，由于医疗原因，他无法参加投票。众议员史蒂文·霍斯福德（内华达州民主党人）的办公室事后表示，由于未透露姓名的个人紧急情况，他不得不错过投票。
这使得民主党核心小组的其他成员出席变得更加重要——至少，如果他们希望投票通过的话。投票定于下午 5:30 进行。与此同时，当选民主党妇女招待会定于下午 4:30 至 6:30 在一家餐厅举行，该餐厅通常距离国会大厦有五分钟车程。但由于警方的护送，该地区出现了意想不到的交通堵塞。四名民主党成员——劳拉·吉伦（纽约州）、乔纳森·杰克逊（伊利诺伊州）、梅兰妮·斯坦斯伯里（新墨西哥州）和玛丽莲·斯特里克兰（华盛顿州）——都将他们的缺席归咎于交通堵塞。考虑到日程安排上的冲突和投票的重要性，当选民主党妇女可以重新安排招待会的时间。该组织没有通过电子邮件回复 Reason 的问题。与此同时，名誉议长南希·佩洛西（加利福尼亚州民主党人）的发言人告诉《华盛顿太阳报》，她错过了在加利福尼亚州举行的退伍军人节活动的投票。众议员布列塔尼·彼得森（科罗拉多州民主党人）表示，她“被剥夺了对该动议进行投票的能力”，但没有详细说明。民主党众议员朱莉娅·布朗利（加利福尼亚州）、海莉·史蒂文斯（密歇根州）和弗雷德丽卡·威尔逊（佛罗里达州）没有回答 Reason 关于他们缺席的问题。大多数缺席的共和党人也没有。众议员朱莉娅·莱特洛 (R-La.) 的发言人告诉 Reason，“她跑到场上，但到得太晚了，这就是她错过投票的原因”，并表示她会投票阻止弹劾。众议员的发言人。
Rudolph Yakym（印第安纳州共和党人）表示，他也会进行类似的投票，但没有解释为什么缺席。(function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})();弹劾文章的撰写者马西将弹劾赫格塞斯视为对特朗普政府战争的公投，特别是 2026 年 2 月对伊朗的突然袭击。前三篇文章

【原文 English Original】
Members of Congress literally have one job: show up and vote. And they often can't be bothered to do it. On Tuesday afternoon, the House of Representatives voted 211–204 not to have a full vote on impeaching Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, with all Republicans but the libertarian-leaning Rep. Thomas Massie (R–Ky.) voting against the impeachment. Republican leadership had actually been expecting the impeachment to move forward and pass, Politico reports. But 11 Democrats missed the vote. According to an Axios reporter, some of them were attending a reception for a group called Elect Democratic Women. Ironically, the group was founded by House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark (Conn.), whose literal job is making sure members show up to vote the right way. Democrats weren't the only ones to play hooky. Seven Republicans also failed to show up. The procedural decision to avoid a vote on specific articles of impeachment suggests that many members simply didn't want to put their stances on the record. So does the unusually large absence on both sides of the aisle (often with flimsy reasons) for a close, high-stakes vote. Some of the absences were unavoidable. Rep. Lou Correa (D–Calif.) had warned publicly beforehand that he couldn't make it to the vote due to a medical procedure. The office of Rep. Steven Horsford (D–Nev.) said afterwards that he had to miss the vote due to an unnamed personal emergency . That made it even more important for the rest of the Democratic caucus to show up—at least, if they wanted the vote to pass. The vote was scheduled for 5:30 p.m. Meanwhile, the Elect Democratic Women reception was scheduled from 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm at a restaurant that is normally a five-minute drive from the Capitol building. But there was unexpected traffic due to a police escort in the area. Four Democratic members— Laura Gillen (N.Y.), Jonathan Jackson (Ill.), Melanie Stansbury (N.M.), and Marilyn Strickland (Wash.)—all blamed the traffic for their absence. Given the scheduling conflict and the importance of the vote, Elect Democratic Women could have rescheduled the reception. The organization did not respond to Reason 's questions by email. Meanwhile, Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi (D–Calif.) missed the vote for a prescheduled Veterans' Day event in California, her spokesman told The Washington Sun . Rep. Brittany Petersen (D–Colo.) stated that she was "denied the ability to vote on this motion" without elaborating. Democratic Reps. Julia Brownley (Calif.), Haley Stevens (Mich.), Frederica Wilson (Fla.) didn't respond to Reason 's questions about their absence. Neither did most of the absent Republicans. A spokesperson for Rep. Julia Letlow (R–La.) tells Reason that "she ran to the floor but got there too late which is why she missed the vote," and says that she would have voted to stop the impeachment. A spokesperson for Rep. Rudolph Yakym (R–Ind.) says he would've voted similarly, without explaining why he was absent.
