The first three articles accuse Hegseth of waging war on Iran against Congress' wishes. The fourth and fifth concern the killing of civilians in Iran and the Caribbean. The sixth accuses him of attempting to "retaliate against and intimidate" Sen. Mark Kelly (D–Ariz.) for his criticism of the killings. The seventh and eighth concern the administration's undeclared wars in Venezuela and Yemen. Voting on those specific questions may have been uncomfortable for Democratic leadership, which is notably lukewarm on the war in Iran. Although Democratic voters (and Americans in general) overwhelmingly oppose the war, party members reportedly saw it as a necessary evil that was better to saddle Republicans with. On its first day, House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries (N.Y.) stated that "Iran is a bad actor and must be aggressively confronted" while doubting President Donald Trump's ability to do so. Stevens, a party favorite who lost her primary to upstart Abdul El-Sayed, called El-Sayed soft on Iran and endorsed the Republican candidate a few days before the general election. Asked by Reason , her office did not explain her absence from the Hegseth vote. The vote on Hegseth also put Republican members in an awkward spot. On one hand, in the eyes of some members, Hegseth has been an incompetent manager of the war and an all-around embarrassing liability . Even the arch-hawk Sen. Ted Cruz (R–Texas) had said before the vote that "either [Hegseth] will resign voluntarily or Trump will fire him." On the other hand, Trump made support for Hegseth a symbol of personal loyalty to himself. Still, Tuesday's non-vote was only a temporary reprieve for representatives worried about having to do their jobs. When the new Congress takes office in two months, Democrats will have a clear majority to pass articles of impeachment on parties, but not the two-thirds majority needed to convict Hegseth. Lawmakers can expect more votes where their presence matters. The post Democrats Miss Hegseth Impeachment Vote for 'Elect Democratic Women' Event appeared first on Reason Magazine .

title: Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut
zh_title: Topco Scientific 建立德累斯顿中心，SEMICON Europa 首次亮相
summary: 在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本的供应商合作伙伴一起展示其跨界合作。
content:
在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本供应商合作伙伴展示其跨境资源一体化和本地化服务能力。拓普科德国于2026年8月正式成立，将亮相台湾馆，展示涵盖工艺材料、特种化学品、扩散工艺清洗设备、关键零部件的一站式解决方案。这些解决方案旨在支持欧洲代工厂和汽车电子制造商的晶圆厂建设和生产需求。作为欧洲最大的半导体集群之一，德累斯顿是博世、英飞凌、恩智浦和格罗方德等主要半导体公司的所在地。随着世界领先的铸造厂在德国落户，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 正在加速向欧洲市场的扩张。
该公司利用德累斯顿当地团队提供及时的材料供应和技术支持，将来自台湾、日本和其他市场的领先材料、设备和耗材供应商与欧洲客户联系起来。这种集成服务模式可帮助客户在半导体工厂不断扩张的情况下减轻供应链中断风险，并降低资质和入厂成本。对于关键的前端工艺材料，拓普科将在展会上展示日本供应商SHIN-ETSU POLYMER的12英寸晶圆载具解决方案，满足欧洲12英寸代工厂和集成器件制造商（IDM）严格的清洁度和自动化要求。其前开式统一盒 (FOUP) 具有抗静电保护和一体式结构，有助于缩短清洁和干燥周期，同时有效减少颗粒的产生。该公司还将展示符合 SEMI 标准的前开式运输箱 (FOSB)，并具有坚固的密封结构，可在长途国际运输过程中保护晶圆。为了满足先进半导体工艺的微缩要求，拓普科引进日本先进的前驱体材料，为高端薄膜沉积工艺提供全面的解决方案，包括化学气相沉积（CVD）和物理气相沉积（PVD）。
这些材料具有超高纯度和出色的热稳定性，有助于提高器件性能和产量，支持可靠的先进半导体制造。对于蚀刻和薄膜沉积工艺，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 将展示使用 TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS 的定制精密加工能力制造的关键组件。这些组件由石英、硅、陶瓷和碳化硅 (SiC) 制成，与主要半导体设备平台兼容。结合专门的抗等离子和耐磨涂层技术，它们有助于延长设备耗材的使用寿命，使客户能够提高产量，同时支持更可持续的制造。

【原文 English Original】
Driven by the European Chips Act and the trend toward localized semiconductor manufacturing, demand for materials, equipment, and technical services in Europe has attracted growing attention. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Co., Ltd. (TAIEX: 5434), an integrated services provider for the semiconductor industry, announced that its German subsidiary, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Germany GmbH (TOPCO GERMANY), will participate for the first time in SEMICON Europa 2026, to be held at Messe München in Germany from November 10 to 13. Together with supplier partners from Taiwan and Japan, the company will showcase its cross-border resource integration and localized service capabilities. Officially established in August 2026, TOPCO GERMANY will exhibit at the Taiwan Pavilion, presenting one-stop solutions covering process materials, specialty chemicals, diffusion process cleaning equipment, and critical components. These solutions are designed to support the fab construction and production needs of European foundries and automotive electronics manufacturers. As one of Europe’s largest semiconductor clusters, Dresden is home to major semiconductor companies, including Bosch, Infineon, NXP, and GlobalFoundries. With the world’s leading foundry establishing a presence in Germany, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC is accelerating its expansion into the European market. Leveraging its local team in Dresden to provide timely materials supply and technical support, the company connects leading materials, equipment, and consumables suppliers from Taiwan, Japan, and other markets with European customers. This integrated service model helps customers mitigate supply chain disruption risks and reduce qualification and onboarding costs amid the ongoing expansion of semiconductor fabs. For critical front-end process materials, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase 12-inch wafer carrier solutions from Japanese supplier SHIN-ETSU POLYMER at the exhibition, addressing the stringent cleanliness and automation requirements of European 12-inch foundries and integrated device manufacturers (IDMs). Its Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP), featuring antistatic protection and an integrated, one-piece construction, helps shorten cleaning and drying cycles while effectively minimizing particle generation. The company will also showcase Front Opening Shipping Box (FOSB) that comply with SEMI standards and feature robust sealing structures to protect wafers during long-distance international transportation. To address the scaling requirements of advanced semiconductor processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC introduces advanced precursor materials from Japan, offering comprehensive solutions for high-end thin-film deposition processes, including chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and physical vapor deposition (PVD). Featuring ultra-high purity and excellent thermal stability, these materials help enhance device performance and yield, supporting reliable advanced semiconductor manufacturing. For etching and thin-film deposition processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase critical components manufactured using customized precision machining capabilities from TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS . These components, made from quartz, silicon, ceramics, and silicon carbide (SiC), are compatible with major semiconductor equipment platforms. Combined with specialized plasma-resistant and wear-resistant coating technologies, they help extend the service life of equipment consumables, enabling customers to improve yield while supporting more sustainable manufacturing. For semiconductor facility engineering and equipment maintenance, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC also offers solutions for the maintenance and servicing of critical equipment and precision components. In the diffusion process segment, the company introduces quartz cleaning equipment from Japanese supplier FIRST EXA to improve the cleanliness of quartz components. Using automated acid cleaning and nitrogen purging technologies, the equipment effectively removes residues from high-temperature deposition processes, reduces particle contamination, and extends the service life of quartz consumables, helping safeguard wafer yield. Charles Lee, President of TOPCO SCIENTIFIC, said, “The regionalization and localization of global semiconductor supply chains have become an irreversible trend. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC established its German subsidiary in August 2026, positioning Dresden as its European operational and technical service hub. This move not only strengthens our presence in Europe but also establishes an important strategic hub for global supply chain integration. Building on more than 35 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, we connect suppliers from Taiwan and Japan with local European customers, providing timely technical support and integrated services. Going forward, we will further strengthen strategic cooperation with leading European suppliers to build an international supply chain platform connecting Asia and Europe and serving customers worldwide, thereby enhancing global supply chain resilience.” The post Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut appeared first on Semiconductor Digest .

title: The Rise and Rise of Alice Huang
zh_title: 黄爱丽的崛起与崛起
summary: Alice Huang 的崛起与崛起 - The Wire 中国 Alice Huang 和 Nvidia 首席执行官 Jensen Huang，台湾台北，2024 年。图片来自 LinkedIn 2019 年，与 Nvidia 创始人 Jensen Huang 有染的涉嫌中国间谍 Alice Huang 通过出售一家在线游戏集团赚取了 1.45 亿美元，该集团三年前的年收入仅为 36,000 美元。摘自第七大道控股于 2019 年 8 月 23 日向香港证券交易所提交的证券备案文件，详细介绍了收购桂花谷控股的交易。图片来源：香港交易所 根据一份证券备案文件，黄女士出售了其位于英属维尔京群岛的公司
content:
黄爱丽的崛起与崛起 - The Wire China
Alice Huang 和 Nvidia 首席执行官 Jensen Huang 于 2024 年在台湾台北。图片来自 LinkedIn
2019 年，与 Nvidia 创始人黄仁勋有染的涉嫌中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 通过出售一家在线游戏集团赚取了 1.45 亿美元，该集团三年前的年收入仅为 36,000 美元。
摘自第七大道控股于 2019 年 8 月 23 日向香港证券交易所提交的证券备案文件，详细介绍了收购桂花谷控股的交易。图片来源：香港交易所
根据一份证券备案文件，黄女士出售了位于英属维尔京群岛的控股公司 Osmanthus Vale Holdings Limited，该公司的收入在 2018 年飙升了 1,000 倍，达到 3,600 万美元。这笔交易也是黄乐职业生涯戏剧性转变的催化剂，她的中文名黄乐，到 2023 年已升任一家主要数据中心运营商和 Nvidia 合作伙伴新加坡 Megaspeed 的董事总经理。
从黄手中收购桂花的公司是第七大道控股公司，这是一家总部位于深圳、在香港证券交易所上市的视频游戏开发商。
2021年，第七大道进军云计算行业，恰逢ChatGPT的发布，造就了云计算股票的热潮。但当拜登政府于 2022 年 10 月对中国实施出口管制时，该公司无法再从 Nvidia 等公司购买最先进的人工智能芯片。
第七大道决定剥离其新加坡子公司，该子公司可以购买美国最好的人工智能芯片。该子公司 7Road International PTE 被出售给与黄女士有关联的一家在英属维尔京群岛注册的公司，并更名为 Megaspeed。
Nvidia 网站上显示的 Megaspeed 合作伙伴资料。
Megaspeed 随后购买了价值数十亿美元的包含先进 Nvidia AI 芯片的服务器，并成为美国和新加坡政府调查其是否向中国走私芯片的对象。
截至 11 月 11 日，Nvidia 继续在其网站上将 Megaspeed 列为官方合作伙伴。
《纽约时报》和《金融时报》分别率先报道称，美国官员怀疑黄女士在中国国家安全部工作，并与黄仁勋有染。中国外交部否认黄女士为国安部工作。
黄仁勋告诉彭博社，他与黄女士的关系没有任何不当之处。
黄爱丽丝和黄仁勋。照片来自社交媒体
这位英伟达创始人随后承认他对妻子不忠，但没有承认与黄女士有染。
唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，英伟达创始人黄仁勋在与黄仁勋的电话中告诉他，他不知道黄女士可能与中国情报部门有任何联系。这一丑闻将影响总统下周的亚洲之行，出席在菲律宾和中国举行的峰会。
第七大道交易只是推动黄女士进入人工智能数据中心领域的众多交易之一。
根据她后来工作的一家投资公司的简历，她的职业生涯始于国家电视台的新闻记者，然后进入金融业。据监管机构中国证券投资基金业协会称，她最终成为上海河西投资基金公司的执行董事。
中国证券投资基金业协会的一份文件指出黄丽娟担任上海河西投资基金执行董事。图片来源：AMAC

【原文 English Original】
The Rise and Rise of Alice Huang - The Wire China
Alice Huang and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in Taipei, Taiwan, 2024. Image via LinkedIn
In 2019 Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy who had an affair with Nvidia founder Jensen Huang, made $145 million from the sale of an online gaming group that three years earlier had annual revenues of just $36,000.
An excerpt from a Hong Kong Stock Exchange securities filing by 7Road Holdings, August 23, 2019, detailing the acquisition of Osmanthus Vale Holdings. Credit: HKEX
According to a securities filing, Ms Huang’s sale of her British Virgin Islands-based holding company, Osmanthus Vale Holdings Limited, came shortly after its revenues had soared 1,000 fold to $36 million in 2018. The transaction was also the catalyst for a dramatic career shift for Huang, also known by her Chinese name Huang Le, who by 2023 had risen to become managing director of a major data-center operator and Nvidia partner, Singapore-based Megaspeed.
The company that purchased Osmanthus from Huang was 7Road Holdings, a video game developer based in Shenzhen and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
In 2021, 7Road entered the cloud computing industry, just before the release of ChatGPT created a boom in such stocks. But when the Biden administration imposed export controls on China in October 2022, the company could no longer buy the most advanced AI chips from the likes of Nvidia.
7Road decided to spin off its Singapore subsidiary, which could buy America’s best AI chips. That subsidiary, 7Road International PTE, was sold to a BVI-registered company associated with Ms Huang and renamed Megaspeed.
Megaspeed’s partner profile as seen on Nvidia’s website.
Megaspeed went on to buy billions of dollars worth of servers containing advanced Nvidia AI chips, and is the subject of U.S. and Singapore government investigations into whether it smuggled chips to China.
As of November 11, Nvidia continues to list Megaspeed as an official partner on its website.
The New York Times and Financial Times were the first to report, respectively, that U.S. officials suspected Ms Huang worked for China’s state security ministry and had an affair with Jensen Huang. China’s foreign ministry denied that Ms Huang worked for the MSS.
Jensen Huang told Bloomberg there was nothing improper about his relationship with Ms Huang.
Alice Huang and Jensen Huang. Photo via social media
The Nvidia founder subsequently admitted he had been unfaithful to his wife, but did not admit to an affair with Ms Huang.
President Donald Trump said that, in a phone call with Jensen Huang, the Nvidia founder told him he was unaware of any connections Ms Huang might have to China’s intelligence service. The scandal will hang over the president’s Asia trip next week to attend summits in the Philippines and China.
The 7Road deal was just one of many that would propel Ms Huang into the world of AI data centers.
She started her career as a news reporter for state television before moving into finance, according to her bio at an investment firm where she later worked. She eventually became the executive director of the firm, Shanghai Hexi Investment Fund, according to the Asset Management Association of China, a regulatory body.
A document from the Asset Management Association of China noting Alice Huang’s position as executive director of Shanghai Hexi Investment Fund. Credit: AMAC
Funds associated with Hexi invested alongside the Zhejiang Century Huatong Group, a maker of internet video games, as it entered the cloud computing business.
Between 2021 and 2022, Ms Huang served as a director of Shanghai Longjing Information Technology, according to corporate records accessed through WireScreen. The company was founded in December 2020 as a data-center focused subsidiary of Huatong. That same month, Huatong acquired a 10 percent stake in 7Road, securities filings show.
Seducing foreign executives is a common tactic used by China’s Ministry of State Security, especially on their visits to China, says Randal Phillips, a former CIA Beijing station chief.
“The lion’s share of [MSS] resources were devoted to [compromising] private sector interests,” he adds.
WireScreen records show that Shanghai Longjing’s legal representative is Gu Jiong, who worked with Ms Huang at Shanghai Hexi Investment Fund, according to the fund’s website. Gu was also the legal representative of Hangzhou Shengfeng Network Technology, a Chinese video games company that Alice Huang sold to 7Road in 2019. Gu could not be reached for comment.
Shanghai Longjing listed in a Shanghai municipal government announcement on data center projects, May 16, 2023. Credit: Shanghai Municipal Government
In 2023, the Shanghai municipal government announced that Shanghai Longjing would build a data center with 6,000 AI server racks at a larger complex where Tencent is a major tenant.
Tencent rents rack space from Shanghai Longjing that it fills with its own chips, according to people close to Tencent. When it is finished, the complex will provide 10 times as much computing power as the world’s largest supercomputer, according to Shanghai’s Songjiang district government.
A Tencent spokesperson said the company has never had a stake in, or operated, the complex.
It is not clear if Ms Huang held an operational role at Shanghai Longjing. She could not be reached for comment and the firm did not respond to a request for comment.
Huatong and 7Road did not respond to requests for comment.
Ms Huang’s involvement in several financing deals raises questions of whether she was a corporate fixer. Desmond Shum, whose ex-wife Duan Weihong held billions of dollars in shares of insurance company Ping An on behalf of the family of former Chinese premier Wen Jiabao, said Huang appeared to be a “white glove” — an investor whose name appears on documents on behalf of others.
A section of a 7Road announcement filed with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange detailing Shanghai Hexi as the “ultimate holding company”, Sept 26, 2019. Credit: HKEX
In 2025, the China Securities Regulatory Commission fined Kang Wei, the founder of Shanghai Hexi, $375,000 for failing to make proper disclosures after he used complex investment vehicles to acquire an electronics company.
Osmanthus, Ms Huang’s video-game investment vehicle, had been incorporated in the British Virgin Islands less than two months before 7Road bought it, according to securities filings. Shanghai Hexi was the firm’s “ultimate holding company.”
Osmanthus’ biggest operating subsidiary was Hangzhou Shengfeng. According to a corporate filing, a Hexi-backed fund purchased Hangzhou Shengfeng from Century Huatong in 2017 for 500 million yuan (around $75 million). In 2019 the fund transferred Hangzhou Shengfeng to newly formed offshore entities, which were consolidated under Osmanthus, securities filings show.
That acquisition could explain the exponential jump in Osmanthus’ revenues, from $36,000 in 2016 to $36 million in 2018.
It is not clear how Ms Huang came to own 100 percent of Osmanthus.
“A woman whose documented career centered on corporate restructuring, leveraged acquisitions, and offshore holding companies suddenly emerged as the public face of [Megaspeed,] a multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure business,” Shum wrote on Substack.
Records showing the transfer of Megaspeed’s shares to Swiftdata Pte, on November 10, 2023. Credit: Bizfile
Alice Huang served as Megaspeed’s managing director from March to November of 2023, according to corporate records. That November Megaspeed’s shares were transferred to another company, Swiftdata Pte, which had been incorporated just weeks earlier. By the end of 2024, Megaspeed’s assets had jumped to $3 billion, from just $33 million the year prior. The sole current director of Swiftdata is Tan Yong Pong, a Singaporean citizen, corporate records show.
Megaspeed said on Monday that there is “no evidence of any violations concerning the illicit transfer of chips or any illegal activities.” The company did not respond to a request for comment.
A spokesperson for the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, which enforces export controls, declined to comment when asked if it is considering taking any measures targeting Megaspeed.
Nvidia Board of Directors’ November 8, 2026 statement.
Nvidia has long lobbied for weakening the export controls that prevent it from selling AI chips to China. President Trump loosened controls on Nvidia’s H200 chip last year.
Nvidia initially said Jensen Huang’s relationship with Ms Huang was “not unusual.” On Sunday, Nvidia’s board announced that it will open an inquiry into whether Jensen Huang was the target of a “foreign intelligence effort.” Its share price has dropped around 10 percent over the past five days.
The FBI is also looking into a matter related to Jensen Huang, Trump said at a press conference on Monday, without offering specifics.
Seducing foreign executives is a common tactic used by China’s Ministry of State Security, especially on their visits to China, says Randal Phillips, a former CIA Beijing station chief. He recalled frequently warning visiting CEOs that “when you flew over the Pacific, that didn’t make you any better looking.”
The revelations about Ms Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang has led a bipartisan group of senators to call for congressional investigations into Nvidia as well as for tighter controls on sales of AI chips to China.
“The lion’s share of [MSS] resources were devoted to [compromising] private sector interests,” he adds.
Jensen Huang is committed to staying on as Nvidia’s chief executive, according to a company spokesperson. “America’s longstanding policy has always supported the buildout of American infrastructure worldwide, bringing prosperity, influence, and jobs home,” the spokesperson added.
President Trump introduces Chinese officials to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang upon arrival at Beijing International Airport, China, May 13, 2026. Credit: The White House
The revelations about Ms Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang has led a bipartisan group of senators to call for congressional investigations into Nvidia as well as for tighter controls on sales of AI chips to China.
“I’m pushing to investigate Jensen Huang and Nvidia to determine whether our national security was compromised,” Democratic Senator Chris Coons, the incoming head of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, wrote on X on Monday.
Last week the Republican chairmen of three congressional committees requested that Jensen Huang appear at a closed-door briefing on November 18. “It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk,” they wrote.
Noah Berman is a staff writer for The Wire based in New York. He previously wrote about economics and technology at the Council on Foreign Relations. His work has appeared in the Boston Globe and PBS News. He graduated from Georgetown University.
In an extract from their new book, The Bitter Struggle, two former U.S. government officials describe how the Biden administration sought to control outsourcing of leading American AI technologies and prevent their possible leakage to China.
Even before the revelations about Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy, Nvidia has long been at the center of U.S.-China relations, our timeline shows.

图片来源：俾路支省政府投资和贸易委员会
巴基斯坦将于 11 月 12 日至 13 日在伊斯兰堡主办 2026 年巴基斯坦矿产投资论坛 (PMIF-26)。该论坛将汇集国际投资者、全球领先矿业公司的高管、金融机构、技术专家和高级政府官员，讨论巴基斯坦矿产行业的范围和环境。
此次活动是近年来类似高层举措的成果，其中最著名的是 2023 年 8 月举行的首届巴基斯坦矿产峰会以及随后于 2025 年举行的投资者论坛。这些活动可以说是为了改变人们对巴基斯坦自然资源潜力的看法。此外，它们还旨在向国际社会表明巴基斯坦政府完全致力于提高投资者信心。
本次论坛的范围和时机之所以重要，有三个原因，凸显了伊斯兰堡目前就其自然资源所追求的战略轨迹。
首先，该倡议表明巴基斯坦认识到关键矿产是支持国家经济增长的可行途径。在 PMIF-26 上，专家小组将看到参与者审查下一代采矿项目，包括有效许可证的发现以及将项目投入生产的策略。
在政府的全力支持下，论坛的运作重点非常重要。除其他外，它表明伊斯兰堡正试图超越仅以该国矿产储量的存在为中心的一般勘探和讨论。例如，通过关注生产计划、主动许可和早期项目融资，巴基斯坦政府似乎旨在将其资源与全球工业供应链连接起来。值得注意的是，如果该国打算在未来几年将这些资产转变为稳定的收入来源，那么从投机性估计转向具体的项目管理是关键一步。
其次，巴基斯坦的军民领导层似乎与 PIMF 倡议保持一致。总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫、高级内阁部长和高级军事领导人预计将出席论坛并发表讲话，强调巩固的机构立场。在这一主题上的军民协调对潜在投资者具有政治和经济影响力。一方面，它向国际社会发出了明确的信息：国家的大力支持和政策的连续性。可以说，采矿业等资本密集型行业需要长达数十年的长期承诺。在这方面，国内主要机构的明显支持可以大有帮助。

Pakistan is set to host the Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 (PMIF-26) in Islamabad on November 12 and 13. The forum will bring together international investors, executives from leading global mining companies, financial institutions, technical experts, and senior government officials to discuss the scope and environment of Pakistan’s mineral sector.
The event is the outcome of similar high-level initiatives in recent years, most notably the first Pakistan Minerals Summit held in August 2023 and subsequent investor forums in 2025. These events have arguably been planned to shift perceptions about Pakistan’s natural resource potential. Moreover, they are aimed at signaling to the international community that the Pakistani state is fully committed to improving investor confidence.
There are three reasons why this forum’s scope and timing are significant, highlighting the strategic trajectory Islamabad is now pursuing regarding its natural resources.
First, the initiative shows that Pakistan recognizes critical minerals as a viable avenue to support national economic growth. At PMIF-26, panels will see participants examining next-generation mining projects, including discoveries from active licenses and strategies for bringing projects into production.
This operational focus at a forum that is fully supported by the government is important. Among other things, it demonstrates that Islamabad is trying to move beyond general exploration and discussions that center merely on the existence of mineral reserves in the country. For instance, by focusing on production schedules, active licensing and early-stage project financing, the Pakistani government seems to be aiming at connecting its resources to global industrial supply chains. Notably, moving from speculative estimates to pitching concrete project management is a key step if the country aims to transform these assets into steady revenue streams in the coming years.
Second, Pakistan’s civil-military leadership appears aligned behind the PIMF initiative. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, senior Cabinet ministers, and top military leaders are expected to attend and address the forum, highlighting a consolidated institutional position. The civil-military alignment on this subject carries political and economic weight for potential investors. For one, it sends a clear message to the international community that there is strong state support and policy continuity. Arguably, capital-intensive sectors like mining require long-term commitment, spanning several decades. In this regard, visible backing from key domestic institutions can go a long way in reassuring foreign companies that the Pakistani state’s support and commitments will remain stable across political shifts in the coming years. Furthermore, this joint front indicates that the state is prepared to carry out necessary legislative, security, and administrative adjustments to streamline approvals and protect long-term investments.
Third, Pakistan has been working to position its mining sector beyond raw material extraction in order to attract foreign direct investment and technical expertise that can support local industrial development. A clear example of this approach is the multi-billion-dollar Reko Diq copper-gold project in Balochistan. The project, which is being developed by Barrick Gold, is a combination of foreign direct investment, technology transfer, and local employment to establish long-term economic capacity rather than a simple extraction deal.
In recent years, Pakistan has been trying to engage international firms and technical experts to evaluate its major reserves, particularly in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. In this regard, forum discussions about logistics and infrastructure connections to regional transport networks offer Pakistan a way to raise the overall competitiveness of its domestic economy. Over time, these frameworks may help lower sovereign risk perceptions and build local operational capacity. This also has the potential to create a direct link between resource development, export revenues and broader economic stability.
More importantly, addressing issues like local stability and security should be a key priority for the Pakistani government in regions where mineral deposits are located. This is important because major mineral deposits are largely concentrated across parts of Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, which remain restive. In this regard, providing a safe operational environment, protecting supply routes, and fostering strong community engagement will be essential for building long-term confidence among investors.
While it is encouraging to see high-level events like PMIF-26 demonstrating unified support across state institutions, the long-term success of this effort will depend on factors beyond government backing. Pakistan can benefit more if steady structural reforms are implemented and political stability is perceived by foreign investors as a continuous factor beyond the current government.
While high-level forums can open doors, foreign investors also look for long-term stability. It is precisely this stable environment that Pakistan’s civil-military leadership is increasingly keen to demonstrate.
Moreover, converting investor interest into multi-decade capital deployment requires deep institutional predictability. This is a reality that government stakeholders in Pakistan are likely aware of as they work toward broader sectoral implementation. It will be interesting to watch how Pakistan navigates the commercial and operational opportunities these plans bring.

title: 立陶宛据报要求台湾代表处更名，台湾：不予评论，目前无更名打算

content:
资料照片：驻立陶宛台湾代表处摆放的台湾与立陶宛旗帜。(2022年1月20日)
台湾外交部星期二(11月10日)对有媒体报道称，立陶宛外交部曾在9月要台湾驻立陶宛代表处更名一事不予评论。台湾外交部次长陈明祺说，目前没有更名计划。不过有立陶宛议会外委会成员称，该国外交部官员要求台湾代表处更名的行为或涉违法，要求召开特别会议展开调查。
立陶宛网络媒体Delfi星期一报导，立陶宛外交部副部长维德曼塔斯·韦尔比茨卡斯(Vidmantas Verbickas)曾在9月24日递交一份非正式文件给台湾驻立陶宛代表王雪虹，要求驻立陶宛台湾代表处在一个星期内更名。
报道说，该份文件称，驻立陶宛台湾代表处现行名称阻碍该国与台湾关系发展，要求台湾代表处在10月1日前更名；作为交换，立陶宛将提供台湾签署双边投资前景协议的机会，并启动避免双重课税及贸易协议谈判。此外，该文件也设想了在外交部内设立台湾事务特使一职的可能性。
Delfi另一篇报道说，在有关立陶宛外交部敦促台湾更改代表处名称一事被报道后，立陶宛议会外交事务委员会副主席、保守派议员齐吉曼塔斯·帕维奥尼斯(Zygimantas Pavilionis)要求召开委员会特别会议，以审查外交部长凯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯(Kestutis Budrys)的作为。
“今天，我将请求所有外交事务委员会成员召开一个特别会议来讨论部长的行动——我认为这个行动是违法的，”帕维奥尼斯星期一在其脸书上贴文中写道。
台湾外交部次长陈明祺星期一到立法院备询前接受媒体联访时针对立陶宛媒体关于台湾代表处更名一事的报道表示，他对外界传闻没有任何评论，“尤其是基于假消息的一些推论”，有伤台立双方的互动及双边关系。
“当初这个名称也是双方基于要深化双边关系之后，才做的这样一个决定，”陈明祺说，“我方目前没有任何打算要更动我国驻立陶宛代表处的名称。”
与此同时，立陶宛国家广播电视网(LRT)星期一报道，中国外交官预计11月11至12日访问立陶宛，与外交部官员和一些“寻求与北京恢复外交关系的议会成员会面”，议员伊格纳斯·韦盖莱(Ignas Vegele)上星期五宣布了此一计划中的访问。
报道提到今年6月才成为立陶宛总理的明道加斯·辛克维丘斯(Mindaugas Sinkevicius)曾表明，他希望年底前能在与中国的谈判中取得突破，“恢复大使级外交代表关系已被纳入其政府的施政项目中。”
根据报道，立陶宛外交部长凯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯星期一对媒体关于外交部要求台湾代表处改名一事的报道回应说：“我不会评论这个信息。首先，它被错误报道。我们与不同互动伙伴有各种讨论，我当然不会去谈细节。”
他说：“我可以证实的是，我们与台湾方面谈到双边关系的各种层面。”
报道说，立陶宛总理明道加斯·辛克维丘斯的发言人盖达斯·萨利加(Gedas Saylyga)星期一也告诉媒体，“正如政府纲领的规划，外交部的目标是将与中国的外交关系恢复到与其他欧盟国家相同的水平。总理想看到的是最后的结果，而不是对过程发表评论。”
“行动计划的选择是外交部长的责任。立陶宛旨在与台湾保持互利的经济与务实的合作，”萨利加补充道。
中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆6月曾对中国与立陶宛的关系表示，当前中立关系的困难和症结在于立方违反一个中国原则，背弃了立方在两国建交公报中的政治承诺。“中方同立方沟通的大门始终敞开”，希望立方尽早采取行动，“果断纠正错误”，回到一个中国原则的正确轨道上来，为中立关系正常化创造条件。
台湾政府2021年在维尔纽斯设立“驻立陶宛台湾代表处”，这是台湾在欧洲第一个以“台湾”，而非“台北”为名所设的代表处，立国为此面对有正式外交关系的北京当局强大压力，中国以召回大使作为抗议，将关系单方面降至“代办”级别，并对立陶宛施加经济报复。
台湾外交部发言人萧光伟星期二在台北的例行记者会上，针对媒体关于立陶宛以非正式文件要台湾代表处改名一事的提问表示，外交部对报道所称的文件及相关臆测不予评论。
他说，驻立陶宛台湾代表处的名称“是台立两国政府基于共享的普世价值，坚信民主、维护自由，以及共同深化双边关系的意愿，经审慎协商达成的共识。”
萧光伟指出，立陶宛总统吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达(Gitanas Nausėda)曾在今年10月27日表示，立陶宛推动与中国关系正常化“不应与台湾代表处名称直接挂钩”，此外，立陶宛总理明道加斯·辛克维丘斯也曾表示，有机会在不更改代表处名称的情况下改善与中国的关系。
萧光伟强调，自台湾与立陶宛互设代表处以来，台湾政府持续与该国历任政府推动经贸投资、科技产业、教育文化与人道援助等领域的实质合作，双方并共同投入资源持续推动援助乌克兰及重建合作计划，以具体行动支持乌克兰，实践民主前线国家面对威权国家扩张、捍卫民主自由价值的共同承诺。
台湾外交部呼吁民主伙伴坚守共同理念与原则，相互支持，携手因应威权国家的胁迫与挑战，台湾愿意与立陶宛在诚信、尊重、互助及互惠的基础上持续深化双边关系。

content:
资料照片：民众在台北参与台湾非营利民防组织黑熊学院举办的急救训练。(2025年3月22日)
随着中国对台湾的压迫日益加剧，台湾执政的民进党立法委员这个星期在华盛顿呼吁美国及国际民主盟友，协助台湾提升民主及社会韧性，反制中国对台湾的各种威胁。有两名被中国制裁的代表团成员在分享个人经历时表示，面对中国威胁，最重要的是必须有“不能投降”的心态。
由民进党立法院党团总召集人蔡奇昌率领的代表团，这个星期在华盛顿与特朗普政府官员、跨党派国会议员和智库会面，就台海安全、美台经贸关系及地区局势交流看法。
星期五(7月24日)，代表团成员、两位立法院外交与国防委员会成员王定宇和沈伯洋在保守派智库哈德逊研究所，针对台湾如何以全社会动员应对中国威胁的做法，与该研究所高级研究院及中国中心主任余茂春进行对谈。
王定宇说，沈伯洋、他自己和哈德逊研究所有一个共同点，那就是他们都受到中国的制裁，尤其是沈伯洋还被列在中国的通缉名单上，但他认为“被那种专制政权制裁是一个荣耀”，台湾面对中国巨大威胁已经数十年，“即便我们只是要追求民主、自由、人权与平等这些东西。”
他说，对世界来说，台湾是重要的、有价值的，但对台湾人来说，那是他们的家园，必须保卫它。
“要保卫你的家园，你永远不能依赖别人的肩膀，那是我们自己的责任，即便你理解台湾的重要性。看看地图就知道它的战略重要性。无论谁让台湾站在他们那一边，谁就能主宰西太平洋。”
哈德逊研究所在2023年举办全球领导力奖晚会，邀请当时在美国纽约过境的时任台湾总统蔡英文参加，并颁给蔡英文“全球领导力奖”遭到北京当局制裁。
余茂春则是中国外交部在2022年以美方“借口所谓‘西藏人权’问题，对两名中方官员进行非法制裁”，因而遭到中国对他的反制裁措施。
沈伯洋说，他认为自己是因为成立黑熊学院，教导台湾一般民众如何自我防卫而遭到中国制裁，后来还将他列入通缉名单，甚至还公布他住所的卫星图，并宣布如果他到海外旅行将逮捕他。
“但我的回应是：我去买了一张机票是吧？我实际上还旅行到德国、荷兰、法国和韩国,而现在我人就在美国。我认为那就是我们对威权国家、他们的行动做出回应的方式。那也是我们应该与彼此团结的方式。”
沈伯洋说，他只是中国跨境镇压的一个例子，但有更多人都面临这种威胁，包括活动人士、人权捍卫者、记者，甚至一般民众，因为中国几个月前才通过《民族团结进步促进法》，许多人必须在中国这种法律战之下受到保护。
他说，中国制裁他和其他人的目的就是为了要他们噤声，要他们躲起来，但要反制这种制度性压迫最好的办法就是站出来，与政府、智库及非政府组织共同合作，寻找一种制度性方式来反制这种法律战。
他认为要应对中国的威胁，台湾必须从五方面来加强全社会韧性包括有专业的军队；强化基础设施，确保医疗、能源、粮食与水供应无虞，海底电缆受到保护；增强经济及供应链韧性；生存技能，如何止血、疏散和自卫技巧等；但最重要的是必须有“不能投降”的心态，那包括如何区分谣言与事实，因为在战争中网络会充斥着各种信息，民众必须有能力辨别什么才是事实。
北京当局正不断加大对被其视为领土一部分台湾的全面压力，不仅以军舰、军机在台湾周边海、空域活动，执行“联合战备警巡”，其海警和科研船也多次进入台湾限制水域，并开始到台湾东部海域进行所谓的“执法巡查”，要求往来外籍船只提供航行信息，并与台湾海巡发生对峙。这个星期，解放军在台湾海峡部分水域实施实弹射击，引来台湾政府的谴责，指其无预警实弹演习影响航行安全、破坏地区安全稳定。
台北拒绝北京的主权主张，面对中国这种非战争行为的灰色地带侵扰以及可能的封锁威胁，台湾政府也在加强提升整体及社会韧性。下个月，台湾将举行汉光42号年度演习，同时也将展开城镇韧性及防空演习，并在演习中首度新增网络战场景，教育民众对一旦台湾被封锁或遭到攻击时如何应对的知识和准备。
民进党立法院党团星期五在其社交媒体平台脸书上贴文说，代表团星期四在国会山与美国国会两党多位联邦参、众议员会面，除了感谢美国国会对台湾的支持外也就台海安全、民主合作、经贸发展及区域局势等议题进行交流，“展现民进党与美方跨党派友谊持续深化，彰显双方共同守护自由民主价值的坚定决心。”
贴文提到，与代表团会面的国会成员，包括共和党籍的众院议长麦克·强森(Mike Johnson)、众院外委会主席布莱恩·马斯特(Brian Mast)、联邦参议员比尔·哈格蒂(Bill Hagerty)，以及民主党籍的众院荣誉议长南希·佩洛西(Nancy Pelosi)。代表团还代表台湾总统赖清德，前往最近过世的参议员林赛·格雷厄姆(Lindsey Graham)办公室鲜花致意，感谢他生前长期对台湾民主、安全及美台关系的坚定支持。
访团成员除蔡奇昌、王定宇和沈伯洋外，还有党团副干事长陈培瑜及民进党政策会执行长吴思瑶。

MAGGIE HABERMAN, JONATHAN SWAN, JULIAN E. BARNES, ANA SWANSON, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月11日
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在5月特朗普总统对北京进行国事访问期间。他最初并未被列入代表团名单，但在最后一刻应特朗普的邀请加入了代表团。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
据知情人士透露，今年5月，特朗普总统在乘坐“空军一号”前往中国的途中被告知，美国获得了敏感情报，显示英伟达首席执行官与一名据信为中国间谍的女性有恋爱关系。
这一消息由国务卿兼国家安全顾问鲁比奥传达，时间就在英伟达掌门人黄仁勋应特朗普邀请加入总统访华行程前不久。这是在七个月内，总统至少第二次被告知有关黄仁勋与该女性有牵连的情报。
这次向特朗普的通报此前并未被报道，它与总统周一的说法相矛盾。特朗普当时称，在访华时他并不知道黄仁勋与该女性的关系。美国官员已认定该女性为中国国家安全部工作。
当在新闻发布会上被问及前去与中国领导人习近平举行峰会时是否知道黄仁勋与该女性的关系时，特朗普说：“不，我当时没听说。”
有关这段关系的披露震动了英伟达，并压低了其股价。此事使外界重新关注美中争夺人工智能主导权竞争的激烈程度——在这场竞争中，英伟达的先进芯片是美国当前保持优势的关键所在。这也再次凸显了黄仁勋对特朗普及政府在人工智能政策和对英伟达相关问题上的影响力。
今年5月，特朗普抵达北京时，黄仁勋与国务卿鲁比奥从“空军一号”上走下来。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
自美国官员去年首次警告特朗普，与黄仁勋有婚外情的女性被认为为中国情报机构工作以来，特朗普一直淡化或无视这些担忧。据《纽约时报》上个月报道，去年晚秋首次听取该问题简报时，特朗普选择不采取任何行动。
周一，当被追问去年是否收到过有关该问题的简报时，特朗普表示他需要核实一下。特朗普一直将英伟达视为美国技术竞争力的关键，以及过去几年股市上涨的推动力。
“我当然会向情报人员核实，”他说。“他们可能提到过。当然，这对我没有产生多大影响。”
特朗普定于下周再次访问中国。他最初暗示可能再次邀请黄仁勋，但周一，他表示这位英伟达高管不会随行。
但总统继续大力为黄仁勋辩护，称他曾与黄仁勋谈过，并问他是否知道这个名为黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）的女性是间谍。特朗普说，黄仁勋表示自己并不知情。总统说，他并不打算在下周会见中国领导人习近平时提及此事。
“我只是非常了解黄仁勋，”特朗普周一说。“我只是认为他是一个非常正直的人。”
自有关英伟达高管与黄乐关系被披露以来，特朗普今年5月对中国的上次访问再次受到审视。黄乐曾是一家名为Megaspeed的新加坡公司的高管，该公司购买英伟达先进芯片。美国从2022年底开始限制直接向中国出售先进芯片，但仍允许中国公司在东南亚的数据中心租用这种算力，比如Megaspeed运营的数据中心。
在此行前几周，鲁比奥负责监督起草了一份关于黄仁勋的备忘录，并分发给少数政府高级官员。据一名知情人士说，这份备忘录并非为特朗普准备，也没有在“空军一号”上给他看。
鲁比奥今年5月在北京出席国宴时的照片。得知黄仁勋将随行出访时，他向特朗普总统简要汇报了关于黄仁勋的情报分析结果，但特朗普仍允许黄仁勋随行。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
作为人工智能领域最关键人物之一的黄仁勋最初并未被列入5月赴华的商界和科技界领袖邀请名单。这一事实在特朗普离开美国前就已引发媒体关注。特朗普几乎未作任何预告，便邀请黄仁勋在“空军一号”于阿拉斯加进行空中加油停靠期间与之会面。鲁比奥是“空军一号”上的十多名政府官员之一。
一位因未获授权公开讨论此事而要求匿名的美国政府官员证实，当鲁比奥得知黄仁勋将在阿拉斯加加入行程时，他“就这一问题向总统作了简报”。
知情人士说，特朗普对国家安全顾问的汇报并未特别在意，仍然坚持接上黄仁勋的计划。
这名官员说，黄仁勋登上“空军一号”后“非常短暂地”见了总统，但“几乎整个行程都待在飞机的另一个区域”。
国务院拒绝置评。白宫新闻办公室被要求置评时，拒绝正式表态。该办公室通过电子邮件发送了一份背景声明，援引了特朗普周一的讲话。该邮件对本文报道提出异议，但没有详细说明。
在《纽约时报》上个月报道美国官员认定黄乐是中国情报人员、且与黄仁勋有恋爱关系后，英伟达高管和黄仁勋都坚称这段关系是与客户的日常接触。周日，黄仁勋承认与黄乐有恋爱关系。不久后，英伟达宣布公司将进行独立调查。
5月，特朗普与中国领导人习近平主席在天坛外合影。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times
早在特朗普2025年重返白宫之前，黄仁勋就长期主张更宽松的芯片销售政策。他的支持者经常指出，他公开表示，美国必须在人工智能竞赛中领先中国。在围绕人工智能全球风险分歧日益加剧之际，特朗普在很大程度上站在黄仁勋和其他科技高管及投资者一边。
今年早些时候，在一次投资者会议上，黄仁勋重申，中国不应获得英伟达的顶级产品，美国应该拥有“第一、最多和最好”。但他还说，“与此同时，所有美国公司都应该在全球竞争。”
目前不清楚鲁比奥去年春天的备忘录是否导致黄仁勋被排除在随后访华行程的初步邀请名单之外。
当时，总统正在考虑向中国开放销售英伟达最先进的Blackwell芯片。黄仁勋和其他一些主要科技领袖支持此举，尽管特朗普的许多顾问对此持反对意见。政府尚未批准向中国出售Blackwell芯片，但美国政府最终允许向获批买家出售较不先进的H200芯片。

title: Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
zh_title: Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露
summary: Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露 Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露 Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露 Baker Tilly 咨询小组正在通知客户，数据泄露已经泄露了有关他们及其家属的某些个人信息。该公司表示，暴露的数据存储在第三方服务提供商 Baker Tilly 运营的平台上，该平台用于为客户提供服务。 Baker Tilly于9月6日获悉该事件，并于10月28日完成对受影响数据的审查
content:
Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露
Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露
Baker Tilly 通知客户第三方提供商的数据泄露
Baker Tilly Advisory Group 通知客户，数据泄露已经泄露了他们及其家属的某些个人信息。
该公司表示，暴露的数据存储在第三方服务提供商 Baker Tilly 运营的平台上，该平台用于为客户提供服务。
Baker Tilly 于 9 月 6 日获悉该事件，并于 10 月 28 日完成对受影响数据的审查，并确定了涉及的信息。
“2026 年 9 月 6 日，Baker Tilly 意识到存在潜在的网络安全事件，涉及存储在 Baker Tilly 所使用的与我们向客户提供的服务相关的第三方服务提供商运营的平台上的某些信息，”向客户发出的通知中写道。
该公司补充说：“未经授权的行为者能够获取与某些 Baker Tilly 客户相关的数据。”
违规通知不提供受影响客户端的计数，不命名服务提供商，并将特定数据类型作为占位符公开。
德克萨斯州总检察长办公室的数据报告称，仅德克萨斯州就有 10,456 人受到 Baker Tilly 影响。该门户将社会安全号码 (SSN)、全名、​​地址和其他信息列为公开数据类型。
Baker Tilly 是美国一家大型会计师事务所，提供审计、税务规划、合规、咨询和业务运营服务。该公司在全球 147 个国家开展业务，年收入达 68 亿美元。
该公司表示，发现这一事件后，立即采取措施遏制事件，聘请外部专家进行调查，并通知执法​​部门。
此外，该公司表示，目前没有证据表明其自己的网络上存在未经授权的活动，并补充说，它没有收到与泄露客户信息相关的身份盗窃或欺诈报告。
为了降低该事件产生的风险，该公司通过 Experian 为受影响的个人提供 24 个月的信用和身份监控。
BleepingComputer 已联系 Baker Tilly，了解有关数据泄露、其来源、受影响的客户数量以及泄露数据类型的更多信息，但截至发稿时我们尚未收到回复。
BleepingComputer 没有发现勒索软件组织声称遭受此次攻击的任何公告。

【原文 English Original】
Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
The Baker Tilly Advisory Group is notifying clients that a data breach has compromised certain personal information about them and their dependents.
The company said the exposed data was stored on a platform operated by a third-party service provider Baker Tilly uses to serve clients.
Baker Tilly learned of the incident on September 6 and completed its review of the affected data on October 28, when it identified whose information was involved.
“On September 6, 2026, Baker Tilly became aware of a potential cybersecurity incident involving certain information stored on a platform operated by a third-party service provider used by Baker Tilly in connection with services we provide to clients,” reads the notification to customers.
“The unauthorized actor was able to obtain data relating to certain Baker Tilly clients,” the company added.
The breach notification does not provide a count of impacted clients, does not name the service provider, and leaves the specific data types exposed as a placeholder.
Data from the Office of the Texas Attorney General reports that Baker Tilly impacted 10,456 individuals in the state of Texas alone. The portal lists Social Security numbers (SSNs), full names, addresses, and other information as exposed data types.
Baker Tilly is a major accounting firm in the U.S., providing auditing, tax planning, compliance, advisory, and business operations services. Globally, the company operates in 147 countries and reports an annual revenue of $6.8 billion.
After discovering the incident, the company says it took immediate steps to contain it, contracted external experts to investigate, and notified law enforcement authorities.
Furthermore, it says it currently has no evidence of unauthorized activity on its own network, and added that it has no reports of identity theft or fraud linked to the exposure of customer information.
To mitigate the risks arising from the incident, the firm offers affected individuals 24 months of credit and identity monitoring through Experian.
BleepingComputer has contacted Baker Tilly for more information about the data breach, its source, the number of affected customers, and the type of data compromised, but we have not received a reply by the time of publishing.
BleepingComputer did not find any announcements from ransomware groups claiming the attack.

title: Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
zh_title: 马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元
summary: 马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元 马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元 马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元 航运巨头马士基证实，一名威胁行为者破坏了其先前收购的一家公司的系统并窃取了数据。勒索软件组织 WhiteArmor 在周末声称对此次攻击负责，并威胁称将公布据称从该公司物流和供应链平台窃取的约 100GB 信息。事件调查正在进行中
content:
马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元
马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元
马士基确认数据泄露，WhiteArmor 勒索软件索要 500 万美元
航运巨头马士基证实，一名威胁行为者入侵了其之前收购的一家公司的系统并窃取了数据。
勒索软件组织 WhiteArmor 在周末声称对此次攻击负责，并威胁称将公布据称从该公司物流和供应链平台窃取的约 100GB 信息。
对该事件的调查仍在进行中，但该航运公司表示，目前的证据表明“没有泄露任何敏感数据”。
马士基补充说，预计运营不会中断，并向客户保证他们可以像往常一样继续通过其系统预订和管理货运。
马士基表示：“该事件与本地系统无关，我们没有发现任何迹象表明对其他马士基系统或通过 API 和 EDI 等集成连接到马士基的客户和合作伙伴系统有任何影响。”
A.P.穆勒-马士基是一家丹麦航运和物流集团，也是全球船队运力最大的集装箱承运商之一。该公司在 130 个国家/地区经营海运货轮、港口码头、仓库以及空运和陆运服务。
它拥有 700 艘集装箱船，约占全球船队运力的 13.5%，在 35 个国家拥有 60 个码头，拥有 10 万名员工。去年，马士基报告收入为 540 亿美元，净利润为 29 亿美元。
马士基表示，该事件已被隔离，但没有透露有关受影响系统、受损数据类型或入侵发生时间的详细信息。
BleepingComputer 向马士基提出了其他问题，但截至发稿尚未收到回复。
周末，WhiteArmor 勒索软件团伙将马士基列入其数据泄露网站，并公开要求支付 500 万美元的赎金。
“你们的合同物流部门，前 LF Logistics，为许多世界上最大的消费品牌提供履行服务。500 万美元大约相当于 EBITDA 的 4 小时，”威胁行为者说道。
WhiteArmor 的公开消息中写道：“您有 30 天的时间联系我们并支付 5,000,000 美元的比特币。”
WhiteArmor 声称持有约 100 GB 的数据，据称这些数据是从马士基的 OCF/LF 物流平台窃取的，该组织正在利用该平台来支持其勒索要求。
2022年，马士基从利丰集团收购了OCF/LF Logistics平台的原始开发商LF Logistics。
据威胁行为者称，他们持有的数据包括近 30,000 条驾驶员记录、明文密码、33 个 SUPER_ADMIN 帐户（系统上权限最高的帐户）、签名的交货收据以及包含采购订单和提前发货通知 (ASN) 的 14.44 个库存行。
黑客还声称拥有 27,842 条移动设备日志，其中包括电话号码、电子邮件和 IMEI（国际移动设备识别码）号码。
WhiteArmor勒索软件列出马士基，索要500万美元
马士基在今天的披露中指出，“该事件与本地系统无关”，“随着更多相关信息的出现，以及我们是否认为需要向受影响的各方通报任何进一步的调查结果”，它将通知客户。
该公司表示：“与往常一样，请谨慎对待任何声称与此事有关的意外通信，并通过您平时的马士基联系人进行验证。”

【原文 English Original】
Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
Shipping giant Maersk has confirmed that a threat actor breached systems belonging to a company it previously acquired and stole data.
Ransomware group WhiteArmor claimed the attack over the weekend, threatening that it would release about 100GB of information allegedly exfiltrated from the company's logistics and supply-chain platform.
The investigation into the incident is ongoing, but the shipping firm says that current evidence indicates that "no sensitive data has been disclosed."
Maersk added that it does not expect disruptions to operations, and assures customers that they can continue booking and managing shipments through its systems as usual.
“The incident is isolated to a local system, and we have found no indication that there has been any impact on other Maersk systems or customer and partner systems that connect to Maersk through integrations such as APIs and EDI,” Maersk states.
A.P. Moller–Maersk is a Danish shipping and logistics group and one of the world’s largest container carriers by fleet capacity. The company operates ocean freighters, port terminals, warehouses, and air and land transport services across 130 countries.
It has 700 container ships, roughly 13.5% of the global fleet capacity, 60 terminals in 35 countries, and employs 100,000 people. Last year, Maersk reported $54 billion in revenue and $2.9 billion in net profit.
Maersk said the incident has been isolated, but did not share details about the affected system, the compromised data types, or when the intrusion occurred.
BleepingComputer reached out to Maersk with additional questions, but we have not heard back as of publishing.
Over the weekend, the WhiteArmor ransomware gang listed Maersk on its data leak site and publicly asked for a ransom payment of $5million.
"Your contract-logistics arm, the former LF Logistics, runs fulfilment for many of the world's largest consumer brands. Five million dollars is roughly four hours of that EBITDA," the threat actor said.
"You have 30 days to contact us and pay USD 5,000,000 in bitcoin," reads WhiteArmor's public message.
WhiteArmor claims to hold approximately 100 GB of data allegedly stolen from Maersk's OCF/LF Logistics platform, which the group is using to support its extortion demands.
In 2022, Maersk acquired LF Logistics, the original developer of the OCF/LF Logistics platform, from the Li & Fung Group.
According to the threat actor, the data they hold includes nearly 30,000 drivers records, plaintext passwords, 33 SUPER_ADMIN accounts (the most privileged on a system), signed delivery receipts, and 14.44 inventory rows with purchase orders and Advance Shipping Notice (ASNs).
The hacker also claims to hold 27,842 mobile device logs that include phone numbers, emails, and IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) numbers.
WhiteArmor ransomware lists Maersk, asks for $5 million
Maersk noted in the disclosure today that "the incident is isolated to a local system" and that it would notify customers "as more relevant information becomes available, and if we identify any need to inform impacted parties of any further findings."
"As always, please treat any unexpected communications claiming to relate to this matter with caution and verify them through your usual Maersk contact," the company advises.
In 2017, Maersk was hit by NotPetya ransomware, forcing it to rebuild an infrastructure of over 4,000 servers and 45,000 workstations from scratch.
At the time, the company was forced to operate without IT for ten days, incurring damages of up to $300 million.

title: Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
zh_title: 黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理
summary: 黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理 黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理 黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理 攻击者使用阿里云托管开源代理渗透测试平台 AntiFox 的自我管理实例，以针对 Web 服务和 AWS 环境。托管 AntiFox 的基础设施被用于各种恶意活动，包括漏洞利用、Webshel​​l 部署、凭证验证、配置发现和 AWS 秘密收集。最初创建为一个分叉
content:
黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理
黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理
黑客在 AWS 凭证盗窃攻击中使用 AntiFox AI 代理
攻击者正在使用阿里云托管开源代理渗透测试平台 AntiFox 的自我管理实例，以针对 Web 服务和 AWS 环境。
托管 AntiFox 的基础设施被用于各种恶意活动，包括漏洞利用、Webshel​​l 部署、凭证验证、配置发现和 AWS 秘密收集。
AntiFox 最初是作为 ARTEX 0.1.1 的一个分支创建的，具有中文界面，允许用户部署人工智能代理并自动执行常见的渗透测试任务，例如映射暴露的服务和探测目标端点的漏洞。
Arctic Wolf 的安全研究人员观察到，阿里云上托管的与 AntiFox 相关的恶意基础设施使用有效的 AWS 身份（包括 IAM 用户，在某些情况下还假设了 EC2 角色）向 Amazon Web Services API 发出经过身份验证的请求。
Arctic Wolf 表示：“在最近观察到的几起入侵事件中，托管 AntiFox 接口的阿里云系统与针对面向互联网的 Web 服务和相关 AWS 环境的已确认的恶意行为有关。”
报告中强调的一个案例涉及在暴露于互联网的 IIS 服务器上部署 ASPX Webshel​​l、执行操作系统命令、访问应用程序设置和数据库连接字符串以及将配置和日志文件复制到可通过 Web 访问的目录。
攻击者还使用有效的 IAM 凭证和 EC2 角色来探测 Amazon Web Services (AWS) 端点。研究人员指出，在一次入侵中，他们循环使用了多个身份，并在大约 30 分钟内发出了数百个 API 请求。
尽管大多数尝试都被阻止，但攻击者在某些情况下成功并获得了生产秘密。
在另一起事件中，攻击者使用有效的 AWS 身份读取、复制和删除 S3 对象。
Arctic Wolf 的报告包括针对防御者的狩猎指南和建议，其中包括将 IIS Webshel​​l 活动与异常的 AWS 访问相关联，以及在拒绝爆发时审查成功的 API 调用。
研究人员还建议撤销受影响的 AWS 会话和密钥，并轮换通过应用程序文件公开的凭证。
AntiFox 的调查结果是在最近涉及 ARTEX AI 的攻击之后发布的，ARTEX AI 是中国开发的另一个代理渗透测试框架，在用于攻击韩国银行后，该框架已被封闭。
CrowdStrike 还将 ARTEX 与一项网络间谍活动联系起来，在该活动中，中国黑客组织 Vapor Panda 针对 14 个国家的 200 多个组织进行了攻击。
目前，AntiFox 仍可在 GitHub 上使用，并已更新至 2.0 版本，改进了该工具记录和报告结果的方式。
其发布者禁止在现实世界的渗透测试或安全练习中使用该工具来攻击实时系统，或者用于破坏性或非法活动，但他们没有描述任何强制执行这些限制的技术控制措施。

【原文 English Original】
Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
Attackers are using Alibaba Cloud to host self-managed instances of AntiFox, an open-source agentic penetration testing platform, to target web services and AWS environments.
The infrastructure hosting AntiFox was used for various malicious activities, including vulnerability exploitation, webshell deployment, credential validation, configuration discovery, and AWS secret harvesting.
Initially created as a fork of ARTEX 0.1.1, AntiFox has a Chinese-language interface and lets users deploy AI agents and automate common penetration-testing tasks, such as mapping exposed services and probing target endpoints for vulnerabilities.
Security researchers at Arctic Wolf observed malicious AntiFox-linked infrastructure hosted on Alibaba Cloud using valid AWS identities, including IAM users and, in some cases, assumed EC2 roles, to make authenticated requests to Amazon Web Services APIs.
“In several recently observed intrusions, Alibaba Cloud systems hosting AntiFox interfaces were associated with confirmed malicious actions against internet-facing web services and associated AWS environments,” Arctic Wolf says.
One case highlighted in the report involved deploying an ASPX webshell on an internet-exposed IIS server, executing OS commands, accessing application settings and database connection strings, and copying configuration and log files to a web-accessible directory.
The attacker also used valid IAM credentials and EC2 roles to probe Amazon Web Services (AWS) endpoints. In one intrusion, they cycled through multiple identities and made hundreds of API requests in about 30 minutes, the researchers note.
Although most of these attempts were blocked, the attacker was successful in some cases and obtained production secrets.
In a separate incident, the attackers used a valid AWS identity to read, copy, and delete S3 objects.
Arctic Wolf's report includes hunting guidance and recommendations for defenders that include correlating IIS webshell activity with unusual AWS access and reviewing successful API calls within bursts of denials.
The researchers also recommend revoking affected AWS sessions and keys and rotating credentials exposed through application files.
The AntiFox findings follow recent attacks involving ARTEX AI, another agentic penetration-testing framework developed in China that went closed-source after it was used in attacks on South Korean banks.
CrowdStrike also linked ARTEX to a cyberespionage campaign in which the Chinese hacking group Vapor Panda targeted more than 200 organizations across 14 countries.
For now, AntiFox remains available on GitHub, where it has been updated to version 2.0, which improves how the tool documents and reports findings.
Its publishers prohibit using the tool against live systems, in real-world penetration tests or security exercises, or for destructive or illegal activity, but they do not describe any technical controls that enforce those restrictions.

title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
zh_title: CISA 将 Cisco BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用
summary: CISA 将思科 BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用 CISA 将思科 BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用 CISA 将思科 BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用 美国网络安全和基础设施安全局 (CISA) 周二警告称，黑客现在正在利用思科 BroadWorks 的高严重性漏洞进行攻击。 Cisco BroadWorks 是一个云统一通信 (UC) 软件平台和底层引擎，允许电信运营商和托管服务提供商 (MSP) 提供品牌云 PBX、语音和协作服务
content:
CISA 将 Cisco BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用
CISA 将 Cisco BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用
CISA 将 Cisco BroadWorks 缺陷标记为在攻击中被积极利用
美国网络安全和基础设施安全局 (CISA) 周二警告称，黑客目前正在利用思科 BroadWorks 的一个高严重性漏洞进行攻击。
Cisco BroadWorks 是一个云统一通信 (UC) 软件平台和底层引擎，允许电信运营商和托管服务提供商 (MSP) 向企业客户提供品牌云 PBX、语音和协作服务。
该安全漏洞被追踪为 CVE-2026-20320，源于开放客户端接口 (OCI) XML 解析器中对 XML 外部实体 (XXE) 引用漏洞的不当限制，该漏洞可能允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者通过发送恶意制作的 XML 消息从易受攻击的系统中读取敏感配置信息。
“此漏洞的存在是因为默认情况下允许外部实体解析，导致 XML 条目解析不正确。攻击者可以通过向开放客户端接口 - 配置 (OCI-P) 服务发送精心设计的 XML 消息来利用此漏洞，”思科在 8 月份修补该漏洞时解释道。
CISA 于周二将 CVE-2026-20320 标记为被积极利用的漏洞，并将其添加到其已知被利用的漏洞 (KEV) 目录中，并命令联邦民事行政部门 (FCEB) 机构根据《约束性操作指令》(BOD) 26-04 的规定，在 11 月 24 日之前的两周内确保其系统的安全。
尽管 BOD 26-04 仅针对联邦机构，但 CISA 敦促所有安全团队（包括私营部门的安全团队）优先考虑针对此漏洞的补丁，以保护其网络免受持续攻击。
它警告说：“这些类型的漏洞是恶意网络行为者的常见攻击媒介，并对联邦企业构成重大风险。” “虽然 BOD 26-04 仅适用于 FCEB 机构，但 CISA 鼓励所有组织采用基于风险的漏洞管理并优先修复 KEV 目录漏洞。”
虽然 CISA 没有透露攻击者在野外利用 CVE-2026-20320 的更多细节，但威胁情报公司 Malbear Labs 周末表示，一名中文威胁参与者在越狱的 DeepSeek Flash 人工智能模型的帮助下利用了该漏洞，对一家欧洲电信提供商和 13 个使用其数据中心和云基础设施的组织进行了攻击。
此次攻击主要针对电信提供商的 BroadWorks XSP（扩展服务平台），Malbear Labs 发现 BroadWorks 配置服务器（存储所有用户的订户配置）也通过未经身份验证的目录列表暴露。
Malbear Labs 表示：“该代理利用了 CVE-2026-20320，这是 BroadWorks OCI XML 解析器中未经身份验证的 XXE。对端口 2208 的精心设计的 OCI 请求会导致 XML 解析器从服务器文件系统读取任意文件，并且不需要事先进行身份验证。”
“代理从 XSP 主机恢复了系统身份私钥、三个 SSL 凭证集和三个已确认证书匹配的附加私钥。BroadWorks 平台使用系统身份密钥在其自己的组件之间进行身份验证；拥有它可以在组件间通信中模拟 XSP。”
自2021年11月以来，CISA新增了103个思科漏洞

【原文 English Original】
CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks.
Cisco BroadWorks is a cloud unified communications (UC) software platform and the underlying engine allowing telecom carriers and managed service providers (MSPs) to provide branded cloud PBX, voice, and collaboration services to business customers.
Tracked as CVE-2026-20320, the security flaw stems from an improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) reference weakness in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser that can allow unauthenticated, remote attackers to read sensitive configuration information from vulnerable systems by sending maliciously crafted XML messages.
"This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface - Provisioning (OCI-P) service," Cisco explained when it patched the bug in August.
CISA flagged CVE-2026-20320 as actively exploited and added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog on Tuesday, ordering Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to secure their systems within two weeks, by November 24, as mandated by Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04.
Although BOD 26-04 targets only federal agencies, CISA urged all security teams, including those in the private sector, to prioritize patches for this vulnerability to defend their networks against ongoing attacks.
"These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise," it warned. "While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities."
While CISA didn't share more details on attackers exploiting CVE-2026-20320 in the wild, threat intelligence firm Malbear Labs said over the weekend that a Chinese-speaking threat actor has exploited the flaw with the help of a jailbroken DeepSeek Flash artificial intelligence model in attacks targeting a European telecommunications provider and thirteen organizations that used its data centers and cloud infrastructure.
The attack focused on the telecom provider's BroadWorks XSP (eXtended Services Platform), and Malbear Labs found that the BroadWorks Provisioning Server (which stores subscriber configuration for all users) was also exposed via an unauthenticated directory listing.
"The agent exploited CVE-2026-20320, an unauthenticated XXE in the BroadWorks OCI XML parser. A crafted OCI request to port 2208 causes the XML parser to read arbitrary files from the server filesystem and no prior authentication required," Malbear Labs said.
"From the XSP host, the agent recovered the system identity private key, three SSL credential sets, and three additional private keys with certificate matches confirmed. The system identity key is used by the BroadWorks platform to authenticate between its own components; possessing it allows impersonation of the XSP in inter-component communication."
Since November 2021, CISA has added 103 Cisco vulnerabilities to its list of actively exploited flaws, seven of which have also been abused by ransomware gangs.

title: Australian Army’s littoral transformation is the right move, experts say
zh_title: 专家表示，澳大利亚陆军的沿海转型是正确的举措
summary: 专家称，澳大利亚陆军的沿海转型是正确的举措 - Breaking Defense 澳大利亚陆军推土机在昆士兰北部考利海滩训练区登上机械化登陆艇 (LCM-8)，为 2026 年 Keris Womera 演习做准备。（照片：澳大利亚国防部） 新加坡 — 专家告诉 Breaking Defense，澳大利亚陆军最近成立的沿海机动大队是该国武装部队的正确举措，尤其是在紧张局势持续存在的情况下在印度-太平洋地区。澳大利亚宣布计划将其地面部队转变为一支以沿海为重点的部队
content:
专家称，澳大利亚陆军的沿海转型是正确的举措 - Breaking Defense
澳大利亚陆军推土机在昆士兰北部考利海滩训练区登上机械化登陆艇 (LCM-8)，为 2026 年 Keris Womera 演习做准备。（照片：澳大利亚国防部）
新加坡——专家告诉《Breaking Defense》，澳大利亚军队最近成立的濒海机动大队对该国武装部队来说是正确的举动，特别是在印太地区紧张局势持续存在的情况下。
澳大利亚在其2024年国防战略中宣布计划将其地面部队转变为一支以沿海为重点的部队，其中呼吁军队“针对沿海机动进行优化，具有远程陆地和海上打击能力”。
今年三月，澳大利亚陆军成立了濒海机动大队，以加强该军种“在沿海和岛屿地区调动、部署和支持地面部队的能力”。
但随着一些项目的预算削减迫在眉睫，为 AUKUS 支出腾出空间，专家警告说，该部门需要获得充足的资源，以确保其能够履行这一职责。
在三边协议承诺支出增加之后，该国正在进行预算审查，以腾出资金用于采购核潜艇，尽管该国承诺在未来几年将国防支出提高到国内生产总值的3%。
上个月，濒海机动大队在与印度尼西亚的一次训练活动中完成了大规模两栖演习。
澳大利亚国立大学国际安全和情报研究教授约翰·布拉克斯兰（John Blaxland）告诉《突破防务》，这样的演习表明澳大利亚设想与盟国和伙伴合作部署部队来观察和保护关键的沿海地点，并在冲突中控制海上咽喉要道。
布莱克斯兰说：“濒海机动大队是澳大利亚的一个激进的组织设计概念，反映了对能够快速部署和支持与伙伴一起远距离作战的部队的重大重新定位。”他补充说，该大队可以追溯到第二次世界大战，当时澳大利亚军队展示了对沿海联合兵种作战的掌握。
澳大利亚独立海军评论员亚历克斯·勒克（Alex Luck）对此表示同意，称关注沿海行动是“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”。
“鉴于中国军事能力不断增强，扩展到更广阔的太平洋和印度洋战区，澳大利亚在其周边地区面临着严峻的地理挑战。因此，澳大利亚陆军将不得不依赖强大的海军机动能力，以灵活覆盖包括澳大利亚直接控制的岛屿和澳大利亚领土周围的海上通道在内的海域，”他补充道。
他还强调需要与美国和新西兰等澳大利亚邻国和合作伙伴合作，“确保澳大利亚周围的海洋特征，特别是太平洋岛屿空间的安全。”
濒海机动大队将包括三个登陆艇营，每个营拥有四艘中型登陆艇和两艘重型登陆艇。布拉克斯兰和拉克都同意为该小组配备这些登陆艇至关重要。

Australian Army's littoral transformation is the right move, experts say - Breaking Defense
An Australian Army dozer embarks a Landing Craft Mechanized (LCM-8) at Cowley beach training area in Northern Queensland in preparation for Exercise Keris Woomera 2026. (Photo: Australian Department of Defence)
SINGAPORE — The Australian army’s recently created Littoral Manoeuvre Group is the correct move for the country’s armed forces, experts told Breaking Defense, especially as tensions continue in the Indo-Pacific.
Australia announced plans to transform its ground forces into a littoral-focused force in its 2024 National Defence Strategy, which called for an army “optimised for littoral manoeuvre with a long range land and maritime strike capability.”
In March, Australian Army established the Littoral Manoeuvre Group to strengthen the service’s “ability to move, deploy and support land forces across coastal and island regions.”
But as budget cuts to some programs loom to make room for AUKUS spending, experts warn that the unit needs to be adequately resourced to ensure it can fulfil that role.
In the wake of increased spending on commitments for the trilateral agreement, the country is conducting a budget review to free up funds for the acquisition of nuclear submarines, even as the country is pledging to bring defense spending up to three percent of its gross domestic product in the coming years.
Last month, the Littoral Manoeuvre Group completed a large-scale amphibious exercise during a training event with Indonesia.
John Blaxland, a professor of international security and intelligence studies at Australian National University, told Breaking Defense that an exercise like that suggests that Australia envisages working with allies and partners to deploy forces to observe and safeguard key littoral sites, as well as control maritime chokepoints in a conflict.
“The Littoral Manoeuvre Group is a radical organisational design concept for Australia which reflects a significant reorientation towards being able to rapidly deploy and support forces operating over considerable distances alongside partners,” Blaxland said, adding that the group harks back to World War II, when Australian forces demonstrated mastery of combined arms warfare in the littorals.
Independent Australian naval commentator Alex Luck agreed, calling the focus on littoral operations “a step in the right direction.”
“Australia faces a difficult geographic challenge in its near abroad, in light of a rising Chinese military capability expanding into the wider Pacific and Indian Ocean theatres. Therefore the Australian Army will have to rely on significant naval mobility allowing for flexible coverage of maritime spaces including islands directly under Australian control and maritime approaches around Australian territory,” he added.
He also stressed the need to work with Australia’s neighbors and partners such as the US and New Zealand “in securing maritime features around Australia, but particularly across Pacific Island spaces.”
The Littoral Manoeuvre Group will include three landing craft battalions, each operating four medium and two heavy landing craft. Both Blaxland and Luck agree that outfitting the group with these landing craft is crucial.
Australia awarded contracts to Austal Australia for Land Craft Medium in December 2025 and for Landing Craft Heavy in February. LCM will have a cargo capacity of 80 tonnes (88 tons) while the LCH will be able to transport 200 soldiers and six M1 Abrams tanks or nine Redback infantry vehicles.
Luck said the introduction of the two new classes of landing craft would introduce capabilities that the Australian Army has not operated in recent times.
“The LCH in particular, in conjunction with the Royal Australian Navy’s own amphibious assets, represents an unprecedented new resource the Australian Army will need time to further refine and develop,” he said.
“It is therefore important to apply a step by step approach maturing these new amphibious capabilities to allow for further refinement, including allocation of additional resources further strengthening the new LMG concept,” he continued.
And while Australia’s plans to equip the new group as outlined in Australia’s defense Integrated Investment Program appear to be sufficient, Blaxland cautioned that those plans would take time to come to fruition and was dependent on whether funding is available to follow through.
“The plan appears to be to expand significantly to help move whole battalion groups and supporting elements to work alongside partner forces in the ‘littorals’ across the archipelago. But with significant funding constraints, this is not likely to reach full operational capacity for some years yet,” he said.

AntiFox AI 渗透测试平台与访问 AWS 生产机密的攻击有关
AntiFox AI 渗透测试平台与访问 AWS 生产机密的攻击有关
Ravie Lakshmanan著作2026年11月11日人工智能/网络安全
网络安全研究人员披露了一项活动的详细信息，其中一种名为 AntiFox 的新兴代理渗透测试平台被用来窃取 Amazon Web Services (AWS) 凭证并横向转移到受感染的环境中。
Arctic Wolf Labs 在与 The Hacker News 分享的一份报告中表示：“在最近观察到的几起入侵事件中，托管 AntiFox 接口的阿里云系统与针对面向互联网的 Web 服务和相关 AWS 环境的已确认的恶意行为有关。”
据观察，该活动将 Web 开发和 Web shell 部署链接在一起，以促进配置发现、凭证验证、云服务枚举、秘密访问和存储操作。
AntiFox 可从 GitHub 下载，被描述为人工智能 (AI) 驱动的自主渗透测试平台。截至撰写本文时，该项目已被分叉 251 次，并被加星 474 次。
在其自述文件页面上，项目维护者指出 -
给定授权目标，计划者/工作人员/主代理多代理系统在双图核心（全局资产图+每个任务探索图）上运行全面参与——侦察→攻击面发现→利用→发现捕获→报告交付——完全可观察、交互式和可交付
与大多数“擅长发现，但止步于发现”的自动化渗透测试工具不同，AntiFox 更注重交付——将人工智能发现的内容转化为工程师可以理解、重现、提供证据的报告，然后直接交给客户。
据 Arctic Wolf 称，一些初始访问活动与受损的面向互联网的互联网信息服务 (IIS) 应用程序相关。然后利用该访问权限使用 IIS 工作进程“w3wp.exe”创建 ASPX Web shell，并运行操作系统命令来执行以下操作 -
运行 PowerShell 命令来查找 web.config 文件和配置备份
读取应用程序设置和数据库连接字符串
枚举调试和错误日志目录
尝试使用从应用程序配置中提取的凭据连接到内部生产数据库
将配置和日志文件复制到可通过 Web 访问的上传目录中
Arctic Wolf 表示：“在受感染的 IIS 服务器上，通过 w3wp.exe 运行的命令使用 whoami 识别执行上下文，枚举应用程序目录，使用 icacls 检查权限，并测试将文件写入 Web 根目录的能力。”
“w3wp.exe 创建 ASPX Web shell，然后通过同一 IIS 工作进程执行命令，这表明受影响的 Web 应用程序受到了损害。”
用于在 IIS 服务器上执行代码的具体漏洞尚不清楚。在其他攻击中，据说威胁行为者是从通过尚未确定的方式获得的有效 AWS 凭证开始的。
具体来说，这涉及滥用有效的 IAM 身份来验证凭证并枚举数十种服务，包括 IAM、EC2、S3、Lambda、Secrets Manager、KMS、RDS、ECS、EKS、Redshift、Athena、Glue、Systems Manager、API Gateway、CloudWatch、CloudFormation、DynamoDB 和 Amazon Bedrock。

【原文 English Original】
AntiFox AI Pentesting Platform Linked to Attacks That Accessed AWS Production Secrets
AntiFox AI Pentesting Platform Linked to Attacks That Accessed AWS Production Secrets
Ravie LakshmananNov 11, 2026Artificial Intelligence / Web Security
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a campaign in which an emerging agentic penetration testing platform called AntiFox has been used to steal Amazon Web Services (AWS) credentials and pivot laterally into compromised environments.
"In several recently observed intrusions, Alibaba Cloud systems hosting AntiFox interfaces were associated with confirmed malicious actions against internet-facing web services and associated AWS environments," Arctic Wolf Labs said in a report shared with The Hacker News.
The activity has been observed chaining together web exploitation and web shell deployment to facilitate configuration discovery, credential validation, cloud-service enumeration, secret access, and storage operations.
AntiFox, available for download from GitHub, has been described as an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven autonomous penetration testing platform. As of writing, the project has been forked 251 times and starred 474 times.
On its README page, the project maintainer states -
Given an authorized target, a planner / worker / main-agent multi-agent system runs the full engagement over a dual-graph core (a global asset graph + a per-task exploration graph) — recon → attack-surface discovery → exploitation → finding capture → report delivery — fully observable, interactive, and deliverable
Unlike most automated pentest tools that are "great at discovery, but stop at discovery," AntiFox puts its weight on delivery — turning what the AI finds into a report that an engineer can understand, reproduce, back with evidence, and hand straight to the client.
According to Arctic Wolf, some of the initial access activity is associated with a compromised internet-facing Internet Information Services (IIS) application. The access is then leveraged to create an ASPX web shell using "w3wp.exe," the IIS worker process, and run operating system commands to perform the following actions -
Run PowerShell commands to locate web.config files and configuration backups
Read application settings and database connection strings
Enumerate debug and error-log directories
Attempts to connect to an internal production database using a credential extracted from the application configuration
Copy configuration and log files into a web-accessible upload directory
"On a compromised IIS server, commands run through w3wp.exe identified the execution context with whoami, enumerated the application directory, checked permissions with icacls, and tested the ability to write files into the web root," Arctic Wolf said.
"The creation of an ASPX web shell by w3wp.exe, followed by command execution through the same IIS worker process, suggests compromise through the affected web application."
The precise vulnerability used to achieve code execution on the IIS server is not known. In other attacks, the threat actor is said to have started with a valid AWS credential obtained through as-yet-undetermined means.
Specifically, this involved abusing valid IAM identities to validate credentials and enumerate dozens of services, including IAM, EC2, S3, Lambda, Secrets Manager, KMS, RDS, ECS, EKS, Redshift, Athena, Glue, Systems Manager, API Gateway, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, and Amazon Bedrock.
While a majority of these authenticated cross-service API requests ended up with an "AccessDenied" error, some of the discovery and secret-access operations were successful, according to the cybersecurity company.
In at least some instances, the activity has been observed progressing beyond Secrets Manager enumeration to a successful GetSecretValue request against a production secret. Elsewhere, a valid AWS identity was used for S3 discovery and object operations via API calls.
"Agentic frameworks such as these make penetration testing techniques more accessible to threat actors, while increasing the speed and consistency with which these techniques can be applied in live attacks," Arctic Wolf said.
The disclosure comes as threat actors are increasingly weaponizing AI-powered penetration testing tools like ARTEX to conduct broad-scale attacks across the world, enabling them to automate various stages of an intrusion with minimal human intervention.
The integration of AI has allowed adversaries, both large and small, to adapt established tradecraft and deploy them at machine speed, making it possible to progress from scanning GitHub for secrets to exfiltrating data from an Azure Key Vault in five minutes.
Earlier this week, VECERT disclosed details of a campaign dubbed Operation Ghost-Campus orchestrated by a Chinese threat actor that uses AI agents to maintain perpetual, cost-free access to large language models (LLMs) and eventually perform automated academic fraud and steal data belonging to over 5,000 students enrolled at the Fengxian Campus.
"The agent industrializes the creation of accounts on the search engine fofa.info, scans the global cyberspace for misconfigured servers, extracts API keys for OpenAI and DeepSeek, automatically verifies their financial balances, and injects them into the attacker's development environment," VECERT said.
"This stolen computing power fuels an interactive GoTTY terminal ('Pi — AI Coding Assistant') and, by extension, provides intelligence to the scripts that sustain academic fraud bots ('heartbeat' bots) and extractors of financial data and personally identifiable information (PII) belonging to thousands of students at the Fengxian Campus."
According to data from Censys, there are 1,465 hosts running an exposed ARTEX console as of November 4, 2026, with most of them located in the U.S., Hong Kong, China, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea. However, it's worth noting that not every instance is necessarily malicious in nature.
In a separate report, Check Point Research said it identified 2,557 systems that hosted ARTEX, including 10 misconfigured instances exposing their full databases.
"In many observed cases, ARTEX required remarkably little interaction from its operators once an objective had been established," Check Point said. "Rather than continuously directing attacks step by step, operators frequently issued a goal and left the agent fleet to work toward it. Human interactions were largely limited to checking progress, asking whether a target had been compromised or occasionally adjusting priorities."
The vast majority of the attacks are designed to siphon cryptocurrency, steal Apple code-signing certificates, compromise gaming accounts, and conduct denial-of-service (DoS) attacks against gambling websites. The activity has been found to exploit vulnerabilities related to weak or hard-coded passwords, missing authentication, insecure direct object references, and remote code execution.
In the campaign targeting Apple code-signing certificates, ARTEX agents searched compromised systems for certificate databases, followed by validating the stolen certificates by checking passwords, private keys, Apple revocation status, expiration dates, and associated provisioning profiles.
Ultimately, the activity is estimated to have harvested more than 300 certificates and their passwords, out of which three certificates passed the full validation process and could be used to sign arbitrary iOS applications.
The biggest change brought by agentic hacking to the cyber threat landscape is scale and speed, Check Point cautioned, as a cybercriminal with limited technical skills can task AI agents with investigating a number of targets in parallel and exploiting them using known and zero-day vulnerabilities with less manual effort.
"Its relevance to us lies in its scale, speed and persistence," CERT-EU said in an alert. "ARTEX can test large numbers of low-complexity misconfigurations, including those a human tester would notice but not have time to check, and it can work through long attack chains without the fatigue that limits manual testing."
"The same is true of complex payload crafting. Exploitation paths that need carefully tailored payloads often take more effort than the severity of the finding justifies, so a manual assessment may leave them untested."
Tools like AntiFox and ARTEX are part of a broader set of about 45 open-source agentic attack frameworks that are engineered to connect to an LLM and can act on outputs autonomously. They fall under five broad categories -
Network kill chain capable of end-to-end reconnaissance, exploitation, and post-exploitation: PentAGI, RedAmon, and DarkMoon
Web-app and API: Strix, Shannon, and PentestGPT
C2-integrated: Sage, echidna, Pojun, and FORANG
Harnesses: RAPTOR, CyberStrike, cyber-harness, Nebula and Cybermes
Research prototypes: Incalmo, hackingBuddyGPT, VulnBot, HackSynth, AutoPT, and Ares
"Each framework has public source code and wires a model into a loop that runs tools and acts on their output," GitGuardian said.
"Agentic AI pentesting tools hand their agent a shell and web access, so the model can assemble a pipeline at runtime. A GitHub search, a scanner download, and a found key passed to the next call are all one prompt away, even though none of it ships in the repository."

content:
黄仁勋又曝新婚外情 传英伟达董事会拟罢免(图) 鲍威尔 | 医疗保健 | 时事 || 看中国网
2017年，英伟达（Nvidia）创办人、总裁兼首席执行官黄仁勋在国际消费电子展（CES）上展示最新消费科技产品。（图片来源：Ethan Miller/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月12日讯】（看中国记者高芸编译/综合报导）英伟达（Nvidia）首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）再度卷入婚外情风波。据《华尔街日报》（The Wall Street Journal）报道，在两段婚外关系相继曝光后，英伟达董事会正准备罢免黄仁勋的首席执行官职务。其中一段关系涉及一名被指控为中国间谍的女性，另一段则涉及直接向黄仁勋汇报工作的英伟达高级主管。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
《华尔街日报》援引知情人士的话称，董事会最早可能在周三（11月11日）召开会议，决定黄仁勋的去留。
这场风波的最新进展，来自《纽时》11月11日发表的一篇报道。
该报援引五名曾在英伟达工作的知情人士称，63岁的黄仁勋与48岁的英伟达医疗保健业务副总裁金伯莉・鲍威尔（Kimberly Powell）存在婚外关系，而鲍威尔正是直接向黄仁勋汇报工作的高级主管。
据其中两名知情人士透露，今年3月，在圣何塞（San Jose）举行的英伟达GTC开发者大会期间，有人目击黄仁勋和鲍威尔在当地一家酒店表现亲密。
另有消息称，两人的亲密互动被拍摄下来。不过，该报称，尚未看到这段视频。
目前，有关两人关系的说法尚未得到英伟达、黄仁勋或鲍威尔的证实。英伟达拒绝发表声明，鲍威尔也没有立即回应置评请求。
这段关系之所以引发关注，不仅因为涉及婚外情，还因为鲍威尔是黄仁勋的直属下属。
根据英伟达的企业行为准则，员工必须避免可能引发公司内部利益冲突的情况，其中包括私人关系。
就在报道发表后，鲍威尔取消了原定参加米尔肯研究院未来健康峰会（Milken Institute Future of Health Summit）的计划。
这一消息由美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）医疗记者梅格・蒂雷尔（Meg Tirrell）披露。
蒂雷尔在社交平台X上表示，鲍威尔原定于周四上午参加峰会开幕环节的一场小组讨论，而这场讨论正是由蒂雷尔主持。
蒂雷尔写道：“我刚刚从主办方那里得知，她已经取消了原定的出席计划。”
这场未来健康峰会于11月11日至13日在华盛顿特区的萨拉曼德酒店（Salamander Hotel）举行，参加者包括医疗健康行业的企业首席执行官、政策制定者、研究人员和投资者。
鲍威尔原本是峰会的演讲嘉宾之一。她于2008年加入英伟达，长期负责推动公司芯片技术在医疗影像、生命科学和医疗保健领域的应用。
根据米尔肯研究院的介绍，鲍威尔在计算机技术与医疗保健的交叉领域工作了近20年，并参与推动英伟达将业务拓展至BioNeMo等领域。BioNeMo是英伟达用于人工智能驱动的生物学研究和药物发现的平台。
作为英伟达医疗保健业务的重要代表人物，鲍威尔经常出席摩根大通医疗健康大会（J.P.Morgan Healthcare Conference）及米尔肯研究院峰会等活动。
她此次退出峰会，也使英伟达失去了一次展示其医疗健康业务进展的机会。原本，英伟达与制药企业及初创公司的合作，很可能成为峰会讨论的话题。
此前，黄仁勋已经退出多场公开活动，包括原定在纽约举行的ElevenLabs峰会（ElevenLabs Summit）。
他的女儿、英伟达高级总监麦迪逊・黄（Madison Huang），也以“家庭事务”为由，取消了原定前往韩国参加英伟达活动的行程。
这些行程变动发生之际，黄仁勋正因另一段婚外关系接受调查。
本周早些时候，黄仁勋承认与一名名叫黄乐（Alice Huang）的女性发生婚外情。
黄乐是Megaspeed的一名高管，她被怀疑是中国国家安全部的情报人员。
据报道，美国情报评估早在数月前就已发出警告，指出北京的情报机构已经招募了她。
11月8日，黄仁勋在发给员工的一份备忘录中承认，自己曾对妻子不忠。
随后，英伟达董事会启动独立调查，以确定黄仁勋是否成为涉及黄乐的中国情报行动的目标。
有关鲍威尔的最新报道，以及董事会可能罢免黄仁勋的消息传出后，英伟达股价在盘后交易中下跌近8%。

title: 西班牙400万人举行全国大罢工 多地爆发警民冲突(图)
summary: 西班牙400万人举行全国大罢工 多地爆发警民冲突(图) 住房危机 | 马德里 | 巴塞罗那 | 欧洲 || 看中国网 2026年11月11日，西班牙马德里民众举行示威，抗议住房危机和生活成本上涨。当天，西班牙两大工会发起全国24小时总罢工。（图片来源：Pablo Blazquez Dominguez/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。 【看中国2026年11月12日讯】（看中国记者高芸编译/综合报导）周三（11月11日），西班牙爆发
content:
西班牙400万人举行全国大罢工 多地爆发警民冲突(图) 住房危机 | 马德里 | 巴塞罗那 | 欧洲 || 看中国网
2026年11月11日，西班牙马德里民众举行示威，抗议住房危机和生活成本上涨。当天，西班牙两大工会发起全国24小时总罢工。（图片来源：Pablo Blazquez Dominguez/Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月12日讯】（看中国记者高芸编译/综合报导）周三（11月11日），西班牙爆发14年来首次全国总罢工，约400万名工人参与，占全国劳动力总数的五分之一。民众抗议的主要原因是住房危机。当天，全国多个城市举行大规模游行，到了晚上，马德里和巴塞罗那部分地区爆发警民冲突。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据路透社报导，尽管受到恶劣天气影响，工人们仍然设置罢工纠察线，在马德里、巴塞罗那及其他城市举行抗议活动。距离西班牙11月29日提前举行全国大选，已不到三周。
此次罢工得到了西班牙两大工会——劳动者总联盟（General Union of Workers，UGT）和工人委员会（Workers'Commissions，CCOO）的支持。这两个工会代表超过100万名工人。此外，对租金上涨和驱逐租户问题感到不满的租户协会也支持此次行动。
这是自2012年欧元区债务危机期间，西班牙工人为反对紧缩措施而举行罢工以来，该国首次发生全国总罢工。
🇪🇸🇪🇺 SPAIN ERUPTS IN MASS PROTESTS—4 MILLION PEOPLE TAKE TO THE STREETS! Spaniards today massively expressed their dissatisfaction with their government, which cares more about illegal Muslim migrants than the true citizens of Spain. 4 million people came out today to demand their basic rights, such as access to housing and higher wages. Perhaps it is high time for Spain to pay attention to its own citizens instead of allowing the people's tax money to be used by Brussels for a war that has no end.
— @PatriotVoice (@USA_Patriot_GOP) November 11, 2026
当天的罢工活动总体保持和平，但到了晚间，部分地区的局势开始升级。
在巴塞罗那，部分抗议者与警方爆发冲突。路透社拍摄的画面显示，主要游行活动结束后，街道上的家具被点燃。
马德里的紧张局势也进一步升级。路透社一名目击者表示，防暴警察在市中心的西班牙广场（Plaza de España）周边使用泡沫弹、催泪瓦斯和胡椒喷雾驱散抗议者。
警方表示，截至格林尼治标准时间晚上9点，全国至少有73人被捕，并记录了至少1,044起与罢工有关的事件，包括封锁办公场所和工业园区，以及焚烧垃圾箱等行为。
工会表示，将针对警方所谓的“过度”执法行动提出刑事控告。工会称，警方在行动中使用催泪瓦斯和警棍，造成20名抗议者受伤。
在马德里主要购物街之一的格兰维亚大道（Gran Via），包括普利马克（Primark）、H&M和Pull&Bear在内的商店纷纷拉下卷帘门，现场部署了大量防暴警察。
巴塞罗那的许多商店也关闭营业，并用木板封住门窗，以防可能发生的骚乱。
根据劳动者总联盟和工人委员会的数据，港口和汽车行业的罢工参与率达到90%。位于纳瓦拉（Navarre）的大众汽车（Volkswagen）工厂，以及巴塞罗那的西雅特（SEAT）工厂等多家工厂，均出现全面停工的情况。
西班牙电网运营商西班牙电网公司（Red Electrica）的数据显示，当地时间上午10点至11点，电力需求降幅一度达到15.5%。
公共交通同样受到影响。巴塞罗那地铁表示，除上下班高峰时段外，地铁列车将全部停运。马德里地铁则表示，与上周同期相比，高峰时段的乘客使用量下降了42%。
此外，两场被命名为查尔斯（Charles）和布鲁娜（Bruna）的强烈风暴，也影响了当天的抗议安排。工会暂停了南部港口城市加的斯（Cadiz）及其他南部城市的示威活动。
尽管各地参与程度不一，工会仍将此次罢工描述为一次成功的行动。其中，住房压力尤其严重的沿海地区，罢工支持力度最强。
租户工会表示，预计到当天结束时，参与罢工的人数将达到500万。根据西班牙国家统计局的数据，该国约有2,300万名劳动者。
此次大规模罢工的核心问题，是西班牙日益严重的住房危机。
根据西班牙中央银行的数据，该国目前的住房缺口约为75万套，预计到2028年将扩大至100万套以上。
随着越来越多的人无力购买住房，租房需求急剧增加，进一步推高了租赁市场的压力。
西班牙青年委员会（Youth Council of Spain）的数据显示，该国平均月租金为1,176欧元，约合1,315美元，相当于年轻人平均月薪的98.7%。
在医院信息技术部门工作的马德里居民赫苏斯・冈萨雷斯（Jesus Gonzalez）支持此次罢工。
他说：“我已经36岁了，却仍然没办法搬出去独立生活。房租不断上涨，房价也不断上涨，这根本不可能。”
不过，西班牙主要商业组织西班牙企业组织联合会（CEOE）副主席安赫拉・德米格尔（Angela de Miguel）认为，此次罢工适得其反。
她指出，小企业同样受到住房危机影响，因为住房短缺使企业更难招聘员工。
德米格尔在接受西班牙国家电视台（TVE）采访时表示，解决办法是建造更多住房，并降低建筑施工和购房过程中的税收。
据英国《卫报》报道，在周三全国总罢工开始前，西班牙格拉纳达（Granada）的租户工会就已经采取行动。
工会成员前往当地游客最集中的地区，破坏了约300个短期出租住房使用的钥匙盒，导致这些钥匙盒无法继续使用。
该组织随后在社交媒体上发布了遭到破坏的钥匙盒照片，并写道：“不要资本家，不要靠收租牟利的人，也不要他们的帮凶。”
此次全国总罢工之前，西班牙已经连续数周发生住房问题示威。
抗议活动的导火索，是马德里一名87岁老妇遭到驱逐，并随后死亡的事件。
与此同时，西班牙议会上个月否决了政府旨在遏制驱逐租户行为、缓解租金压力的相关法令。
这些事件和持续的抗议活动，促使西班牙首相佩德罗・桑切斯（Pedro Sanchez）决定提前举行全国大选。
桑切斯希望在11月29日的选举中，利用选民对住房问题的不满，将公众注意力从休达（Ceuta）发生的一起致命移民事件，以及上个月的一起列车事故上转移开来。
桑切斯政府一直为其处理这些灾难事件的方式进行辩护。不过，截至目前，他领导的社会党在民意调查中仍然落后。

content:
川普对华谈判会变弱？华尔街日报：中共误判(图) 亞太經濟合作組織 | 川普訪華 | 習近平 | 中期選舉 | 时事 || 看中国网
2026年5月15日，美国总统川普在北京中南海园林参观期间，与中共国家主席习近平会面。（图片来源：Evan Vucci/POOL/AFP via Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月12日讯】（看中国记者林晨综合报导）美国总统川普将于下周前往深圳，出席亚太经济合作组织(Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation)峰会。《华尔街日报》11月11日刊文表示，北京方面可能将美国中期选举结果视为迫使川普让步的机会，但这会是个严重的战略误判。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
《华尔街日报》的这篇报导由其首席中国记者魏玲灵撰稿。报导提及2014年的历史例子。2014年11月，民主党在中期选举中惨败。几天后，时任美国总统奥巴马前往北京，出席环太平洋地区领导人年会并进行国事访问。中共党魁习近平察觉到奥巴马处境转弱，竟用了数个小时向他讲授中国历史与治国之道。
如何解读这一举动？报导引述胡佛研究所(Hoover Institution)访问学者马特．特平(Matt Turpin)说，“习近平当时确信，奥巴马领导下的美国不会与中华人民共和国正面对抗，”因为当时中国经济表现良好，保持着超过7%的增速。西方经济却在金融危机后举步维艰，当时的美国政府也支持和热衷于对华自由贸易。当时的大势对习近平有利。特平曾在川普第一任期内任职于美国国家安全委员会(National Security Council)。
看中国评论员成岭认为，这可以理解，因为当时的习近平深信“东升西落”之说。即中国作为制造业大国正在迅猛崛起，打造了几乎控制世界的红色供应链；当时的美国制造业空心化已经很严重。
这一次，川普刚刚遭遇一场比奥巴马当年更为惨重的中期选举失利。民主党在美国中期选举中大胜，不仅取得了国会参众两院的控制权，还将控制过半数的州议会。
报导认为两次访问固然有许多相似之处，但如今两国之间的博弈格局，已和2014年截然不同。报导写道：“习近平似乎还是忍不住要利用手中的筹码施压。但从北京眼下的举动来看，这把牌恐怕打得有些过头了。”
下周在深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织峰会可能促成这场美、中、俄三方历史性会谈。如果能成行，将是美、中、俄三国元首首次正式举行三方会谈。习近平的施压表现之一就是，中共要求在川普、习近平和普京的三方峰会上严格按照预定的脚本走。但是美国已经表示拒绝。
特平指出，中共决策体系内部缺乏主张对美缓和的力量，几乎只有“对美鹰派”，没有真正的“对美鸽派”。随着习近平持续集中权力，对美强硬逐渐成为体制内的主流立场。
更糟糕的是，北京可能并不充分理解美国总统与国会之间的权力关系。“中共领导人确实不理解总统与国会之间的关系，”特平说，“他们在很大程度上是以己度人，认定美国政治体制的运作方式与中国一样。”
他提到，拜登政府任期最后几年，共和党控制的众议院曾与民主党执掌的白宫合作，建立两党对华共识。
现在民主党新获得的多数席位可能会让中共面临更大困难。近期英伟达（Nvidia）执行长黄仁勋与具有中共国安背景的商人黄乐的婚外情曝光，这引发美国国会议员关注。中共长期以来一直寻求取消美国对高科技产品销售的限制。在这种政治氛围下，美国放宽对中国高科技产品出口限制将很难获得支持。
报导认为，另外一个因素是，中共在美国中期选举中的小动作可能让川普总统很恼火。
自一年前在韩国釜山达成贸易协议以来，中共未能充分履行农业采购和稀土出口方面的承诺。此外，中国还在美国中期选举前几周收紧了柴油出口。尽管中共表示这是处于保障国内供应的需求，但显然，这加剧了全球能源压力，使得川普政治处境更艰难。
“我猜川普觉得，习近平是故意在中期选举上给他使绊子，”特平说。他认为，如果川普形成这种看法，就更没有理由向北京让步。所以这次见面，习近平面对的是一位正暗自怀疑是对手害他痛失国会的美国总统。双方谈判的筹码包括台湾问题。今年稍早，北京曾试图促使美国暂停对台军售，并要求华盛顿调整对台政策措辞。但是川普总统应当没有多少动力向习近平让步。
事实上，美国各界更多地在督促总统尽快推动140亿美元对台军售。美国华盛顿智库“德国马歇尔基金会”（GMF）9日刊载亚洲计划主任葛来仪（Bonnie Glaser）与约翰‧霍普金斯大学高级国际研究院（Johns Hopkins SAIS）国际关系研究者孟诺涯（Noah Munk）共同撰写的题为“美国暂缓对台军售”的文章。文章不认可川普的“谈判筹码”做法，督促政府尽快交货。
此外，川普近期任命强硬移民政策推手斯蒂芬．米勒（Stephen Miller）接替苏西．威尔斯(Susie Wiles)出任白宫幕僚长，也显示他在选举失利后未必会转向温和路线，反而可能进一步强化强硬政策。
报导认为，川普在第二任期以来对北京的态度是软硬兼施，来回摇摆，时而加征关税，时而又释出谈判讯号。“这种做法收效甚微，未来一年也不太可能带来突破，”特平说，“但这是川普总统钟爱的套路，而据我所知，哪怕是行不通，到了80岁这个年纪也没几个人愿意改掉自己的积习。”
至于习近平，他手中的牌也不多，中国经济的状况远逊于12年前，失业潮席卷这个国家。同时，习近平还需要为2027年中共二十一大及高层人事安排作准备，想必他不希望美中关系出现重大动荡。
