ICAC charges contractor supervisor over bribes from migrant workers at Kai Tak hospital project | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
ICAC charges contractor supervisor over bribes from migrant workers at Kai Tak hospital project
Hong Kong's ICAC has charged a subcontractor supervisor with 10 counts of accepting bribes totalling HK$75,100 from five electricians. The bribes were demanded to secure and retain their jobs at the Kai Tak hospital construction site under the Construction Industry Migrant Worker Scheme.
Hong Kong's Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) has charged a 52-year-old subcontractor supervisor with 10 counts of accepting advantages, in violation of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance. The case, involving alleged bribes totalling HK$75,100 from five electricians, was heard at Tuen Mun Magistrates' Court on 12 November 2026.
The defendant, employed as a 'foreman' by Yat Tak Lee Electrical Engineering Limited, was a subcontractor's supervisor on the Kai Tak Hospital construction project. The main contractor, China Construction Engineering (Hong Kong) Company Limited, had engaged subcontractors under the Construction Industry Migrant Worker Scheme to hire foreign workers, including the five electricians the defendant allegedly helped recruit.
According to ICAC, the defendant demanded and received 10 bribes from the five electricians between September and November 2026. The payments, ranging from HK$9,000 to HK$23,600 per worker, were made to secure their employment as electricians on the project and to ensure their continued hiring. The electricians, who were paid a daily wage of HK$1,300, reportedly paid the bribes out of fear of losing their jobs.
An ICAC spokesperson stressed the commission's zero-tolerance approach to corruption, urging construction workers who are solicited for bribes in exchange for employment to immediately refuse and report the matter. To strengthen migrant workers' awareness of Hong Kong's anti-corruption laws, the ICAC said it would arrange anti-corruption education talks for workers within eight weeks of their arrival in the city, and continue to disseminate relevant information.
The spokesperson added that both China Construction Engineering (Hong Kong) and Yat Tak Lee had provided full assistance during the investigation. Both companies have also prohibited their employees or agents from soliciting or accepting benefits in connection with their business or operations.

科技股回落、芯片制造商反弹，恒生指数下跌 0.8% |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
科技股回落、芯片制造商反弹，恒生指数下跌 0.8%
11 月 12 日，香港股市低开，恒生指数下跌 0.8%。主要科技公司股价下跌，而芯片制造商上涨。由于涉及美国芯片巨头的调查和诉讼，与 Nvidia 相关的反向产品飙升 14%。
由于大型科技公司回落，而芯片制造商上涨，香港股市周四开盘走低。基准恒生指数下跌 194 点，或 0.8%，至 24,121 点。科技股指数也下跌 0.8%，至 3,995 点。
主要科技股大多出现亏损，其中重量级阿里巴巴下跌 2.19%，成为表现最差的蓝筹股，腾讯下跌 1.37%。小米和京东也分别下跌0.73%和1.89%。联想开盘上涨 1.2%。
相比之下，华虹宏力半导体上涨2.5%，成为表现最好的蓝筹股，中芯国际上涨0.7%。 CSOP NVIDIA Daily (-2x) 反向产品的表现是 Nvidia 每日业绩的负两倍，该产品飙升 14%，原因是董事会牵头对 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋潜在的外国情报目标进行调查、股东诉讼以及更广泛的市场和政治影响。
另外，据报道，长和因当前市场状况而搁置了分拆屈臣氏在伦敦和香港双重上市的计划，并可能在明年市场环境较好的情况下重启该计划。该消息令其股价承压，开盘下跌 1.46%。汇丰银行下跌0.6%。
该市还迎来了两起首次公开募股(IPO)。中国半导体和全栈机器人解决方案供应商中微科技开盘飙升 66%，至 16.41 港元，每手 500 股，账面收益 3,255 港元。其零售部分超额认购12.95倍。半导体及内存产品公司HOSIN Global Electronics上涨0.4%，至73.1港元，每手100股实现账面收益27港元。其零售部分超额认购1.37倍。

Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hang Seng Index falls 0.8% as tech stocks retreat, chipmakers rally
Hong Kong shares opened lower on 12 November with the Hang Seng Index falling 0.8 per cent. Major tech names declined while chipmakers rose. An Nvidia-linked inverse product surged 14 per cent amid investigations and lawsuits involving the US chip giant.
Hong Kong shares opened lower on Thursday as big tech names retreated, while chipmakers rallied. The benchmark Hang Seng Index fell 194 points, or 0.8 per cent, to 24,121 points. The tech gauge also dropped 0.8 per cent to 3,995 points.
Major tech names were largely in the red, with heavyweight Alibaba declining 2.19 per cent as the worst-performing blue chip, and Tencent dipping 1.37 per cent. Xiaomi and JD.com also fell 0.73 per cent and 1.89 per cent, respectively. Lenovo opened 1.2 per cent higher.
In contrast, Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor rose 2.5 per cent as the best-performing blue chip, while Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation rose 0.7 per cent. The CSOP NVIDIA Daily (-2x) Inverse Product, which delivers minus two times Nvidia's daily performance, surged 14 per cent amid news of a board-led investigation into potential foreign-intelligence targeting of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang, a shareholder lawsuit and broader market and political fallout.
Separately, CK Hutchison reportedly shelved its plan to spin off Watsons through a dual listing in London and Hong Kong due to current market conditions, and may restart the plan next year in a better market environment. The news weighed on its shares, which opened down 1.46 per cent. HSBC fell 0.6 per cent.
The city also welcomed two IPO debuts. Chinese semiconductor and full-stack robotics solution provider Amicro Technology surged 66 per cent to HK$16.41 at market open, with each board lot requiring 500 shares, delivering a paper gain of HK$3,255. Its retail tranche was oversubscribed 12.95 times. Semiconductor and memory product company HOSIN Global Electronics rose 0.4 per cent to HK$73.1, delivering a paper gain of HK$27 with 100 shares per board lot. Its retail tranche was oversubscribed 1.37 times.

星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港呼吁启德体育场观众使用铁路 避免非法出租车
香港政府呼吁启德体育场观众使用铁路离开，避免非法出租车。当局协调加强地铁和巴士服务，以迎接 2026 年 11 月 12 日的活动，并提供跨境选择，包括铁路至罗湖和预订巴士。
2026年11月12日演出结束后，香港政府呼吁离开启德体育场的观众使用铁路，避免搭乘非法的士。运输署与本地及跨境公共交通营办商协调，加强离场期间的服务。
港铁将增加屯马线的班次。计划于当日返回中国内地的观众应安排好行程，并乘坐港铁至罗湖站。从宋皇台站经大围转乘前往罗湖的末班列车于晚上 10 时 59 分出发，从启德站出发的末班列车则于晚上 11 时 01 分出发。建议乘客尽早前往站台。
返回内地的观众也可在出发期间乘坐启德体育公园安排的跨境巴士。门票必须提前在运营商的在线平台上购买；现场不售票。此外，专营巴士公司提供11条特别巴士路线，由宋皇台道落客区前往港岛、九龙及新界各主要地区。启德体育场的士落客处将会开放，但等候时间可能较长。
政府提醒旅客不要乘坐非法出租车。一旦发生交通事故，提供违法服务的车辆的第三方责任保险可能失效，给乘客带来风险。政府发言人强调，使用跨境的士的旅客应确保车辆持有有效的出租汽车许可证、挡风玻璃左侧及车尾贴有“跨境出租汽车”识别标签，并附有指定的车牌号码。旅客应在运输署网上查询系统www.gov.hk/hirecarpermit输入车辆登记号码，核实许可证。
市民应留意现场公告及「轻松离开」平台easyleave.police.gov.hk的实时资讯，以及运输署网站www.td.gov.hk、「香港游易」流动应用程式、电台及电视台的最新交通消息。

Hong Kong urges Kai Tak Stadium audience to use rail, avoid illegal taxis
Hong Kong government calls on Kai Tak Stadium audience to use rail for departure, avoid illegal taxis. Authorities coordinate enhanced MTR and bus services for the 12 November 2026 event, with cross-border options including rail to Lo Wu and pre-booked coaches.
The Hong Kong government has urged audiences leaving the Kai Tak Stadium to use the railway and avoid illegal taxis, following a performance on 12 November 2026. The Transport Department coordinated with local and cross-border public transport operators to strengthen services during the departure period.
The MTR will increase the frequency of the Tuen Ma Line. Spectators planning to return to mainland China on the same day should plan their journeys and use the MTR to Lo Wu station. The last train from Sung Wong Toi station to Lo Wu via Tai Wau transfer departs at 10:59 pm, and from Kai Tak station at 11:01 pm. Passengers are advised to go to the platform early.
Audience returning to the mainland can also take cross-border coaches arranged by the Kai Tak Sports Park during the departure period. Tickets must be purchased in advance on the operator's online platform; no tickets will be sold on site. In addition, franchised bus companies provide 11 special bus routes from the drop-off area on Sung Wong Toi Road to major districts across Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories. The taxi drop-off area at the Kai Tak Stadium will be open, but waiting times may be long.
The government reminded travellers not to take illegal taxis. In the event of a traffic accident, the third-party liability insurance of vehicles providing illegal services may become invalid, putting passengers at risk. A government spokesman emphasised that travellers using cross-border taxis should ensure the vehicle has a valid hire car permit, a "Cross Boundary Hire Car" identification sticker on the left side of the windscreen and the rear, and an assigned vehicle number. Travellers should verify the permit on the Transport Department's online enquiry system at www.gov.hk/hirecarpermit by entering the vehicle registration number.
Audience should follow on-site announcements and real-time information on the "Easy Leave" platform at easyleave.police.gov.hk, as well as the latest traffic news on the Transport Department website at www.td.gov.hk, the "Hong Kong Travel Easy" mobile app, radio and television.

summary: 汇丰银行考虑扩大新加坡自主权以减少对中国的依赖：报告|中国劳工公告牌 星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 汇丰银行考虑给予新加坡更大的自治权以减少对中国的依赖：据彭博社报道，汇丰银行正在探索给予其新加坡业务更多的独立性，以减少对中国（包括香港）的依赖。此举可能会在香港之外建立第二个区域基地。汇丰银行一直在探索如何减轻对包括香港在内的中国内地的依赖，并赋予其S业务更多的独立性。

汇丰银行考虑扩大新加坡自主权以减少对中国的依赖：报告|中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
汇丰银行考虑给予新加坡更大的自主权以减少对中国的依赖：报告
据彭博社报道，汇丰银行正在探索赋予其新加坡业务更多独立性，以减少对包括香港在内的中国的依赖。此举可能会在香港之外建立第二个区域基地。
彭博社周四援引知情人士的话报道称，汇丰银行一直在探索如何减轻对包括香港在内的中国大陆的依赖，并赋予其新加坡业务更多的独立性。
报道援引汇丰银行亚洲和中东联合首席执行官苏伦德拉·罗沙(Surendra Rosha)的一份声明，确认该银行将合并其在新加坡的独立部门，作为简化行动的一部分，但除此之外没有进一步的计划。
报道称，下一步可能采取的行动是将其他区域业务纳入新加坡子公司旗下，最终目标是在香港旁边建立第二个区域基地。
这一决定突显了汇丰银行在全公司范围内自上而下扩大财富业务的努力，特别是在转向亚洲市场方面。新加坡长期以来一直被视为首要的财富和银行中心，其政治稳定增加了其吸引力。

Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HSBC considers greater Singapore autonomy to reduce China reliance: report
HSBC is exploring giving its Singapore operations more independence to lessen dependence on China, including Hong Kong, according to a Bloomberg News report. The move could establish a second regional base alongside Hong Kong.
HSBC has been exploring ways to ease its reliance on China, including Hong Kong, and give more independence to its Singapore operations, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The report cited a statement from Surendra Rosha, HSBC's co-CEO for Asia and the Middle East, confirming that the bank will combine its separate units in Singapore as part of a simplification drive, but that it has no further plans beyond that.
A possible next move would be to bring in other regional operations under the Singapore subsidiary, with the ultimate goal of establishing a second regional base alongside Hong Kong, according to the report.
The decision underlines the company-wide, top-down drive to expand HSBC's wealth business, particularly in a pivot to Asian markets. Singapore has long been regarded as a premier wealth and banking hub, with its political stability adding to its appeal.

content:
香港永福推出含腌制食材的冬日菜单 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港永福推出含腌制食材的冬日菜单
香港永福餐厅推出了冬日菜单，这是行政主厨刘震最后的时令菜肴。菜单以腌制和发酵食材为主，价格为每人 2,888 港元，可供至少 4 人用餐，供应期截至 12 月 8 日。
香港可能还没有脱掉外套，但冬天的最初迹象已经开始悄然来临。干燥的东北季风带来凉爽的早晨和更清新的东北风，气温降至22摄氏度左右——恰逢中国传统日历进入冬季。
11月7日是立冬，中国二十四节气中的第十九个节气。在香港永福，季节变化已经进入餐桌，推出了全新的冬日菜单，完成了行政总厨刘震受春、夏、秋、冬四个季节标记启发的全年系列。
最后一章的灵感来自中国人的“冬藏”理念——储存和保存过冬。刘并没有简单地让所有东西变得更重，而是转向使用随着时间的推移而积累味道的食材：来自东海的海鲜、从土里抽出来的冬笋、腌肉、酒糟和干货。
开盘决定了节奏。轻度腌制的墨鱼搭配透明的鱼子酱果冻，其干净的盐度与海鲜的弹性质地形成鲜明对比。越南式醉鸡采用经过 300 天放养的鸡，用陈酿米酒糟腌制而成，时令无花果的甜味令人提味。与此同时，冬笋与藏猪肉和葱一起慢慢煮熟，吸收了它们的浓郁而不失其精致的新鲜感。开胃菜以宁波风味的红烧牛尾结束，最后以沉香烟熏的方式呈现出持久的木香。
从那时起，味道逐渐浓郁。黄鱼放在由鱼骨制成的乳白色汤中，倒在精致的鱼片上，静置 50 秒，然后搭配山药“猫耳”面条和新鲜豆腐片。安康鱼肝的口感更加丰富，先铺上章鱼，然后再打成糊状，煎至外脆内软。最令人放纵的组合之一是将来自宁波的新鲜去皮虾与土黄油（浓缩的大闸蟹鱼子和脂肪）结合在一起，最后搭配时令的意大利白松露。
然后将风干野鸭的温热汤与干竹笋和芋头一起在木炭上慢火慢炖，让鸭子的浓味加深汤汁，竹子带来新鲜​​感，芋头增添柔软的奶油质感。米饭以青蟹为特色，用平底锅煮熟以释放其汁液，而从腿上摘下的肉则与米饭、土豆、豆类和腌猪肉一起炒，然后将整道菜一起烘烤。最后以九年百合、芡实、干莲子和鲟鱼筋的甜汤结束，伴随着桂花的香味。
永福香港的冬日菜单供应至12月8日，价格为每人2,888港元，另加10%服务费，可供至少四人用餐。

【原文 English Original】
Yong Fu Hong Kong launches Start of Winter menu with preserved ingredients | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Yong Fu Hong Kong launches Start of Winter menu with preserved ingredients
Yong Fu Hong Kong has introduced its Start of Winter menu, executive chef Liu Zhen's final seasonal offering. The menu emphasises preserved and fermented ingredients, priced at HK$2,888 per person for a minimum of four diners, available through 8 December.
Hong Kong may not have its coats out just yet, but the first signs of winter are beginning to creep in. A dry northeast monsoon has brought cooler mornings and fresher northeasterly winds, with temperatures dipping to around 22 degrees Celsius — just as the traditional Chinese calendar turns toward winter.
November 7 marked Start of Winter, or Lidong, the 19th of China's 24 solar terms. At Yong Fu Hong Kong, the seasonal shift has made its way to the table with a new Start of Winter menu, completing executive chef Liu Zhen's year-long series inspired by the four seasonal markers of spring, summer, autumn and winter.
This final chapter takes its cue from the Chinese idea of dong cang — storing and preserving through winter. Rather than simply making everything heavier, Liu turns to ingredients that have gathered flavor over time: seafood from the East China Sea, winter bamboo shoots drawn from the earth, cured meats, fermented rice lees and dried produce.
The opening plates set the rhythm. Lightly cured cuttlefish is paired with a clear caviar jelly, its clean salinity contrasting with the seafood's springy texture. A Vietnamese-style drunken chicken, made with a 300-day free-range bird marinated in aged fermented rice lees, is lifted by the sweetness of seasonal figs. Winter bamboo shoots, meanwhile, are slowly cooked with Tibetan pork and scallion, absorbing their richness without losing their own delicate freshness. The appetizers conclude on a deeper note with Ningbo-style braised oxtail, finished over agarwood smoke for a lingering woody aroma.
From there, the flavors gradually intensify. Yellow croaker arrives in a milky broth made from its bones, poured over delicate fish slices and left for 50 seconds before being served with yam “cat-ear” noodles and fresh bean curd sheets. Monkfish liver takes a richer turn, layered with octopus before being battered and fried until crisp outside and yielding within. One of the most indulgent combinations brings together freshly peeled shrimp from Ningbo with tu huang you — the concentrated roe and fat of hairy crab — finished with seasonal Italian white truffle.
A warming soup of wind-dried wild duck is then gently simmered over charcoal with dried bamboo shoots and taro, allowing the duck's concentrated savoriness to deepen the broth while the bamboo lends freshness and the taro adds a soft, creamy texture. The rice course features blue swimming crab pan-cooked to release its juices, while meat picked from the legs is stir-fried with rice, potato, beans and cured pork before the whole dish is baked together. The meal ends with a sweet soup of nine-year lily bulbs, gorgon fruit, dried lotus seeds and sturgeon tendon, finished with the fragrance of osmanthus.
Yong Fu Hong Kong's Start of Winter menu is available through December 8, priced at HK$2,888 per person plus 10 per cent service charge, for a minimum of four diners.

content:
意大利DJ Joseph Capriati 将于White Party 首次香港亮相 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
意大利 DJ Joseph Capriati 将于 White Party 首次香港亮相
意大利 DJ Joseph Capriati 将于 11 月 20 日首次来港演出，地点为 Pier 1929，主打“Electric Wonderland – The White Party”。活动从晚上 8 点持续到凌晨，内容包括 house、tech house、melodic house 和 techno。卡普里亚蒂曾在 70 多个国家/地区演出过。
主办方宣布，意大利 DJ 兼制作人 Joseph Capriati 将于 11 月 20 日在香港首次亮相，担任 Electric Wonderland – The White Party 的主角。该活动将于湾仔海滨 1929 号码头举行，这将是他在大中华地区的唯一一次亮相，活动从晚上 8 点持续到凌晨，节目内容涵盖 house、tech house、melodic house 和 techno。
经过近二十年的职业生涯，卡普里亚蒂已成为国际 house 和 techno 巡回演出中的一个熟悉的名字。他曾在六大洲 70 多个国家演出，并出现在 Tomorrowland、Ultra Music Festival、EDC Las Vegas、Coachella、Awakenings 和柏林 Berghain 等音乐节和场所。他的作品经常借鉴 Deep House 和 Tech House 的风格，同时保持长期、逐步构建的方法。
卡普里亚蒂录制的作品包括专辑《Save My Soul》（2010 年）、《Self Portrait》（2012 年）和《Metamorfosi》（2020 年），以及与 Carl Cox、Adam Beyer、Danny Tenaglia、DJ Pierre 和 Louie Vega 等艺术家的合作。近年来，他的大部分工作都集中在 Metamorfosi，这是他于 2022 年在伊维萨岛推出的一系列活动，此后该活动已扩展到国际范围并催生了 Metamorfosi Records。
对于香港来说，1929 号码头的环境可以俯瞰维多利亚港，为 Capriati 的大型演出和 DJ 阵容提供了紧凑的背景。该活动采用全白着装要求，组织者将晚会定位在电子音乐表演和海滨之夜之间。这种形式反映了城市中俱乐部文化、大型舞蹈活动和以生活方式为主导的聚会之间的界限日益模糊，围绕舞池打造了连续的夜晚。
Electric Wonderland – 白色派对将于 11 月 20 日晚上 8 点至凌晨 3:30 或更晚举行。需要穿白色服装。

Italian DJ Joseph Capriati to make Hong Kong debut at White Party
Italian DJ Joseph Capriati will perform in Hong Kong for the first time on 20 November at Pier 1929, headlining Electric Wonderland – The White Party. The event runs from 8pm into the early hours, featuring house, tech house, melodic house and techno. Capriati has played in over 70 countries.
Italian DJ and producer Joseph Capriati will make his Hong Kong debut on 20 November as the headliner of Electric Wonderland – The White Party, organisers have announced. The event, to be held at Pier 1929 on the Wan Chai Harbourfront, will mark his only Greater China appearance and run from 8pm into the early hours, featuring a programme spanning house, tech house, melodic house and techno.
Nearly two decades into his career, Capriati has become a familiar name on the international house and techno circuit. He has performed in more than 70 countries across six continents and appeared at festivals and venues including Tomorrowland, Ultra Music Festival, EDC Las Vegas, Coachella, Awakenings and Berlin's Berghain. His sets often draw on deep house and tech house while maintaining a long-form, gradually building approach.
Capriati's recorded work includes the albums Save My Soul (2010), Self Portrait (2012) and Metamorfosi (2020), alongside collaborations with artists including Carl Cox, Adam Beyer, Danny Tenaglia, DJ Pierre and Louie Vega. In recent years, much of his work has centred on Metamorfosi, the event series he launched in Ibiza in 2022, which has since expanded internationally and spawned Metamorfosi Records.
For Hong Kong, the setting at Pier 1929 overlooks Victoria Harbour, offering a compact backdrop for Capriati's extended set and a supporting DJ lineup. The event adopts an all-white dress code, with organisers positioning the evening between an electronic music show and a waterfront night out. The format reflects the increasingly blurred line between club culture, large-scale dance events and lifestyle-led gatherings in the city, with a continuous night built around the dance floor.
Electric Wonderland – The White Party takes place on 20 November from 8pm to 3:30am or later. White attire is required.

title: 川習釜山協議一年後 北京供美稀土不增反減
summary: 圖為資料照。圖為2025年5月12日，在瑞士日內瓦舉行的美中貿易談判後，美國財政部長斯科特·貝森特（Scott Bessent，右）和美國貿易代表賈米森·格里爾（Jamieson Greer，左）舉行新聞發布會，介紹美中談判結果。(Fabrice Coffrini/AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者高杉編譯報導）一份最新分析報告指出，自川普（特朗普）與習近平2025年在釜山達成貿易休戰協議，中方承諾增加對美稀土出口近一年
content:
圖為資料照。圖為2025年5月12日，在瑞士日內瓦舉行的美中貿易談判後，美國財政部長斯科特·貝森特（Scott Bessent，右）和美國貿易代表賈米森·格里爾（Jamieson Greer，左）舉行新聞發布會，介紹美中談判結果。(Fabrice Coffrini/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者高杉編譯報導）一份最新分析報告指出，自川普（特朗普）與習近平2025年在釜山達成貿易休戰協議，中方承諾增加對美稀土出口近一年後，北京實際上卻大幅減少了對美國的稀土出口。
據美國戰略與國際研究中心（CSIS）週二發布的分析報告，2024年6月至2025年3月，美國平均每月從中國進口76.8噸稀土化合物和金屬。在川習釜山會晤達成協議後，自2025年11月至2026年9月的11個月裡，月均稀土進口量降至19.3噸，降幅近75%。
報告說，美國對部分重稀土的進口受影響尤其嚴重。以釔為例，在中方2025年4月實施管制前，美國8個月內進口333噸；在管制後的8個月裡，進口量只有17噸，降幅約95%。釔被用於保護噴射發動機和其它高溫部件的特種塗層中。
2026年2月，據報導，兩家北美航太塗層供應商因釔短缺而暫時停產。另一家供應商的庫存已耗盡，並停止銷售含氧化釔的產品。報告指，這些中斷表明，供應限制不再是預期風險，而是引起了實際的生產中斷。
美國的汽車、航空航天、半導體和國防產業，至今仍面臨相關稀土材料短缺。
釜山協議簽署後的10個月內，中國相關稀土材料的出口總量僅下降了2.5% ，但對美日出口合計下降了58%。同時，對世界其它地區的出口成長了約146%。
報告分析指出，這顯示北京在人為調控哪些國家能拿到稀土關鍵物資。
據美國財政部日前發表的聲明，財政部長斯科特·貝森特（Scott Bessent）和貿易代表傑米森·格里爾（Jamieson Greer）週五（11月6日）與中共副總理何立峰通電話，要求中方立即全面履行去年在釜山達成的承諾，尤其是稀土和其它關鍵礦產的供應。
財政部在聲明中表示：「貝森特部長強調，中方必須全面、立即履行其在釜山作出的承諾，並對中方近期的一些行為表示關切。」
貝森特重申「持續進展取決於具體成果，美方將密切評估中方對該協議的執行情況」。
格里爾在另一份聲明中強調，「中方必須採取實際行動，全面履行其以往的承諾，尤其是在農產品採購、稀土和其它關鍵礦產方面」。
2025年10月30日，川普與中共領導人習近平在韓國釜山會晤並達成貿易休戰協議。此前美中雙方經歷了數月的關稅、出口管制和報復措施升級。
根據該協議，中方同意把新實施的稀土出口限制措施暫停一年，美方則降低對華關稅，並暫停部分半導體出口管制。
不過，中方原有的出口許可制度並未取消。原定將於2026年11月到期的貿易休戰截止日期，已在2026年9月延長至2027年1月10日。
分析報告認為，目前的核心問題在於，華盛頓能否逼迫中共履行承諾，把外交協議轉化為穩定的稀土供應，還是中方會繼續利用貿易談判拖延時間，繼續把關鍵礦產供應鏈當作籌碼。
隨著休戰期限將於2027年1月10日來臨，這一問題愈發受到關注。

title: 疑似中共間諜 黃仁勳婚外情女主黃樂在北京
summary: 2025年5月22日，在台灣頂級科技展台北國際電腦展（Computex）期間，與數據中心公司Megaspeed有關聯的中國高管黃樂（Alice Huang，又譯黃愛麗，右）與英偉達（Nvidia）首席執行官兼聯合創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang，左背對鏡頭穿黑衣者）出席在台北一家餐廳舉行的晚宴。（Various Sources/AFP) 【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者夏雨綜合報導）彭博社獨家報導，據知情人士透露，被認為是英偉達首席執行官黃仁勳婚外情案中的
content:
2025年5月22日，在台灣頂級科技展台北國際電腦展（Computex）期間，與數據中心公司Megaspeed有關聯的中國高管黃樂（Alice Huang，又譯黃愛麗，右）與英偉達（Nvidia）首席執行官兼聯合創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang，左背對鏡頭穿黑衣者）出席在台北一家餐廳舉行的晚宴。（Various Sources/AFP)
【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者夏雨綜合報導）彭博社獨家報導，據知情人士透露，被認為是英偉達首席執行官黃仁勳婚外情案中的女主角，也被懷疑是中共間諜的女子黃樂已返回中國，目前身在北京。
其中一位知情人士表示，Megaspeed International高管黃樂（Alice Huang）目前居住在北京，且此事已為安全部門所知。由於涉及敏感情況，該知情人士要求匿名。據了解，目前尚不清楚她何時前往北京、為何前往，也不清楚她目前在從事什麼活動。
《金融時報》等媒體相繼報導，一份呈交川普（特朗普）政府高層的情報備忘錄稱，黃仁勳和一名總部位於新加坡的公司高管黃樂（Alice Huang）有「浪漫關係」（romantic relationship）。而美國情報機構認定黃樂是中共國家安全部招募的情報人員。
上週日黃仁勳承認存在婚外情，但未透露女主身分，英偉達董事會也開始展開調查，黃樂的行蹤便引發廣泛猜測，這起緋聞也迅速演變為一宗牽動美國國家安全與全球AI產業的爆炸性事件。
黃樂是中國公民，現年約42歲，湖南人，曾赴香港浸會大學攻讀碩士，後取得香港永久居民資格。她曾是一名記者，後來成為一名「權力掮客」，向中國頂尖企業出租英偉達高端芯片。
美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）的調查報導稱，黃樂自2017年起曾持中國護照進入美國十次。
Megaspeed於2023年從中國遊戲集團第七大道（7Road）剝離出來。就在分拆前幾個月，美國前總統喬·拜登（Joe Biden）對向中國出口先進人工智能（AI）芯片實施了全面限制。第七大道首先將其新加坡子公司出售給了一家名為「Huang Le Ltd.」（註冊於英屬維爾京群島）的實體，隨後由該公司接管了控制權。
2023年11月，「Huang Le Ltd.」將Megaspeed出售給一家新加坡空殼公司。交易完成幾天後，該公司便被指定為英偉達的官方「雲合作夥伴」（Cloud Partner）。這一身分備受追捧，使其能夠優先獲得英偉達提供的芯片；而在該行業，英偉達擁有決定企業成敗的關鍵影響力。
根據新加坡的公司備案文件，黃樂是在2023年11月前被列為該公司董事的幾名中國公民之一。
Megaspeed隨後成為英偉達在東南亞最大的芯片買家，而東南亞也是將英偉達高端硬件走私進入中國的主要通道，該公司主要客戶是阿里巴巴等中國AI企業。
「The Information」11月10日報導，黃樂利用與黃仁勳及英偉達分銷商的關係，建立橫跨中國和東南亞的企業網絡，協助將逾70億美元的英偉達芯片供應給中國企業。
北京方面否認黃樂是間諜。中共外交部未立即回應彭博社置評請求。
中共外交部發言人郭嘉昆週二對黃樂身在何處避而不答。

content:
中国情报部门可以从英伟达首席执行官的事件中学到什么？ |网络安全新闻|半岛电视台
中国情报部门可以从英伟达首席执行官事件中学到什么？在社交媒体上
2025 年 5 月 22 日，黄仁勋（右）与黄爱丽丝（中）一起出席台湾台北的晚宴 [Screengrab/CTi via AFP]
美国立法者正在敦促英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋给出答案，因为人们越来越担心他的事件是否损害了国家安全。
63 岁的黄仁勋承认在领导美国大型科技公司英伟达期间有过婚外情。媒体报道称，涉案女性是新加坡科技公司 Megaspeed 的前高管 Alice Huang，她被指控为中国情报部门工作。
清单 1（共 3）特朗普表示 FBI 正在调查 Nvidia 首席执行官黄与涉嫌间谍的恋情
3Nvidia间谍丑闻清单2引发对中国芯片出口的争论
list 3 of 3Anthropic 的目标是在大规模股票市场首次亮相时估值达到 1.4 万亿美元
随着丑闻继续困扰华盛顿，众议院三个委员会的共和党领导人已要求黄出席闭门简报会，就双方关系作证。
众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特表示，如果黄在周三结束前没有做出回应，他准备传唤黄。
据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，黄爱丽被中国情报部门招募，目的是收集有关英伟达首席执行官的信息，并影响他推动放宽对中国芯片销售的限制。
在周日的一份声明中，黄仁勋就此事向家人和英伟达员工道歉。
他的公司也发起了独立调查，称没有理由相信“国家安全或 NVIDIA 机密遭到泄露”。尽管如此，到了周三，有媒体报道称，英伟达正准备因争议而与黄仁勋分道扬镳。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一证实，联邦调查局正在调查此事，但他一直支持黄，称他是一个“值得尊敬的人”。
但周二，共和党参议员凯文·克莱默 (Kevin Cramer) 要求黄先生辞职，黄先生面临的压力更大。
克莱默在接受 Politico 采访时表示：“勒索的可能性非常大，像 Nvidia 芯片这样敏感的东西，我认为他必须下台。”
但 30 多年前共同创立 Nvidia 的黄仁勋并没有表现出任何响应这一呼吁的迹象。
尽管该公司做出了保证，但专家表示，这一事件引发了人们的担忧，即爱丽丝·黄可能掌握了哪些信息，以及这种关系在英伟达首席执行官的决策中可能发挥了什么作用。
围绕英伟达的国家安全问题有哪些？
英伟达的先进芯片为当今人工智能的大部分提供动力，使该公司处于中美科技主导地位竞赛的中心。
自 2022 年以来，华盛顿限制向中国出售一些最先进的芯片，因为担心这些芯片可能被中国军方或情报机构使用。
据《纽约时报》援引美国情报官员的说法，爱丽丝·黄的任务是让黄仁勋游说放宽芯片出口限制。
这位英伟达首席执行官一直在推动放宽规则，认为如果没有更好地获得美国产品，中国国内芯片产业将会变得更强大。
但一些专家表示，值得关注的是艾莉克如何

What could Chinese intelligence have learned from Nvidia CEO’s affair? | Cybersecurity News | Al Jazeera
Share What could Chinese intelligence have learned from Nvidia CEO’s affair? on social media
Jensen Huang, right, attends a dinner in Taipei, Taiwan, with Alice Huang, centre, on May 22, 2025 [Screengrab/CTi via AFP]
United States lawmakers are pushing for answers from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid growing concerns over whether an affair he had compromised national security.
Huang, 63, has admitted to having extramarital relations during his time leading Nvidia, a major US tech firm. Media reports indicate the woman involved was Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based tech company Megaspeed who is accused of working for Chinese intelligence.
list 1 of 3Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang’s affair with alleged spy
list 2 of 3Nvidia spy scandal fuels debate over chip exports to China
list 3 of 3Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in massive stock market debut
As the scandal continues to grip Washington, Republican leaders of three committees in the House of Representatives have asked Huang to appear at a closed-door briefing to testify about the relationship.
House Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast said he was prepared to subpoena Huang if he did not respond by the end of Wednesday.
According to The New York Times, US intelligence officials believe Alice Huang was recruited by Chinese intelligence to gather information about the Nvidia CEO and influence him to push for looser restrictions on chip sales to China.
In a statement on Sunday, Jensen Huang apologised to his family and Nvidia employees about the affair.
His company also launched an independent investigation, saying it had no reason to believe that “either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised”. Still, by Wednesday, media reports emerged that Nvidia was preparing to part ways with Huang over the controversy.
US President Donald Trump confirmed on Monday that the Federal Bureau of Investigation was looking into the matter, but he has stood by Huang, calling him an “honourable guy”.
But the pressure on Huang intensified on Tuesday when Republican Senator Kevin Cramer called for him to resign.
“The potential for extortion is so tremendous that something as sensitive as Nvidia chips, I just think he’s got to go,” Cramer said in an interview with Politico.
But Huang, who co-founded Nvidia more than 30 years ago, has shown no signs of heeding that call.
Despite the company’s assurances, experts say the affair raises concerns about what information Alice Huang may have been privy to and what role the relationship may have played in the Nvidia CEO’s decisions.
What are the national security concerns surrounding Nvidia?
Nvidia’s advanced chips, which power much of today’s artificial intelligence, have put the company at the centre of the race for tech dominance between China and the US.
Since 2022, Washington has restricted sales of some of the most advanced chips to China over concerns that they could be used by the country’s military or intelligence agencies.
According to US intelligence officials cited by The New York Times, Alice Huang was tasked with getting Jensen Huang to lobby for looser restrictions on chip exports.
The Nvidia CEO had already been pushing for an easing of the rules, arguing that China’s domestic chip industry would get stronger without better access to US products.
But some experts say it is worth looking at how Alice Huang may have influenced decisions Nvidia made specifically about her former employer Megaspeed, which bought more than $4.8bn worth of Nvidia chips over the span of about two years.
Megaspeed has also been investigated over allegations that it helped Chinese companies get access to restricted chips. Megaspeed denies the allegation.
Ryan Fedasiuk, a fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation who studies Chinese technology and intelligence activities, pointed to reports from Bloomberg and The New York Times that Nvidia contacted the US Commerce Department about its investigation into Megaspeed.
He also noted that, in disclosures to the government, Nvidia appeared to vastly undercount the value of the chips it sold to the company.
“The question at hand is whether Nvidia took specific actions with respect to Megaspeed that it might not otherwise have done,” Fedasiuk told Al Jazeera, “possibly as a result of the personal relationship between the two executives.”
What sensitive information could have been a risk?
There are also questions about what sensitive information Alice Huang may have had access to through her relationship with Jensen Huang.
In an analysis published by the Council on Foreign Relations, a think tank, senior fellow Jessica Brandt pointed to information about how Nvidia designs its China-specific chips.
“Information about its conversations with policymakers could be helpful for anticipating where those controls and other policies are headed,” she said. “Understanding where it disagrees with government could expose fault lines to exploit. And that’s before we get into anything touching R&D [research and development].”
Fedasiuk raised similar concerns about what Alice Huang could have learned about Nvidia’s internal operations and plans for future products, as well as its customer base, which includes American and foreign tech companies.
He also pointed to Jensen Huang’s close ties to Trump and other senior White House officials.
“I have to wonder what kind of information about those people and about those relationships may have inadvertently made its way to Ms Huang or to Chinese intelligence,” he said.
So far, however, there is no publicly available evidence that Alice Huang got access to sensitive information from Nvidia or influenced Jensen Huang’s decisions. US intelligence also has not made public any evidence that Alice Huang was working for Chinese intelligence.
China has flatly denied the allegations of espionage.
“The claim of so-called ‘Chinese spies’ is completely groundless and is nothing but a smear campaign against China,” said Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun on Monday.

这位穿着皮夹克的科技高管的职位也使他处于美国和中国之间地缘政治竞争的中心，两国陷入了人工智能霸主之战。

如果英伟达董事会驱逐 63 岁的黄仁勋，这将标志着这家芯片巨头的一个重大时刻。

Chip giant Nvidia’s stock price has tumbled amid reports that its board of directors is meeting to consider the future of CEO Jensen Huang.
Nvidia shares fell 8.6 percent in after-hours trading on Wednesday as questions swirled over Huang’s position at the top of the $4.2 trillion company.

The plunge comes after The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal and the Financial Times reported that Nvidia’s board of directors would discuss Huang’s position over allegations that he engaged in an extramarital relationship with an Nvidia employee, in addition to an affair with a woman accused of working with Chinese intelligence services.
Nvidia, which launched an investigation into Huang on Sunday, did not immediately respond to Al Jazeera’s requests for comment.
Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993, is one of the most visible faces of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom, spearheading the development of high-end graphics processing units used to train and run frontier models.
The leather jacket-sporting tech executive’s position has also placed him at the centre of the geopolitical rivalry between the United States and China, which are locked in a battle for supremacy in AI.
As a confidant of US President Donald Trump, Huang has lobbied for the easing of restrictions on exports of high-end chips to China, putting him at odds with national security hawks in Washington who argue that Beijing must be blocked from access to cutting-edge US tech.
If Nvidia’s board were to oust Huang, 63, it would mark a seismic moment for the chip giant.
Viewed as integral to Nvidia’s meteoric rise to the ranks of the world’s most valuable companies, Huang is known for a centralised leadership style that places him at the centre of the company’s day-to-day operations and strategic decisions.
“Jensen is Nvidia; without him, the company loses its central, animating spirit,” Jay Goldberg, a senior analyst at Seaport Research Partners in San Francisco, told Al Jazeera.
“The organisation is built around him and replacing him will be very painful organisationally, and impossible to do personality-wise.”
It is unclear whether Nvidia has a succession plan, and analysts see few obvious candidates to take Huang’s place.
Dan Ives, senior managing director at Yorkville Ives, said Huang has been the “hearts and lungs” of Nvidia and that investors will closely scrutinise the executive’s possible replacement.
“We believe Nvidia’s value is $300 per share with Jensen as CEO and $225 per share without Jensen as CEO,” Ives said in a note to clients, adding that the company would navigate the turmoil and “remain a core foundational piece of the AI Revolution.”
“Jensen is not replaceable by another CEO or group of interim executives, but Nvidia likely now has to move on without Jensen at the helm, which seemed like a Twilight Zone episode narrative before Sunday afternoon when the news broke,” Ives said.
Nvidia has been the focus of international intrigue over the past week amid reports that Huang had a relationship with a Chinese woman who US intelligence officials determined had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security.
US officials have not provided evidence for the claims about the woman, a Chinese tech executive named Alice Huang.
Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed, has not publicly commented on the allegations.
China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has denied the claims, calling them “entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China”.
Nvidia’s board of directors said on Sunday it had opened a probe into whether Huang had been targeted in a foreign intelligence operation, while also expressing confidence in the executive.
Huang, who admitted to being “unfaithful” to his wife and apologised to his family, pledged to cooperate fully with the inquiry and said he was committed to protecting Nvidia and US national security.

content:
6 分钟阅读

资料来源：TkKurikawa，来自 Getty Images

中国政府正在通过人工智能驱动的大数据挖掘计划密切关注海外华人。在某些情况下，该计划正在帮助政府设计针对人工智能（AI）行业高层人士的影响力行动。

自人工智能热潮开始以来，世界领导人一直在探索如何利用它来巩固自己的权力。虽然华盛顿的重点一直放在短期人工智能项目上——[追踪移民](https://therevolvingdoorproject.org/tracking-uses-of-ai-in-the-trump-administration/)和政治抗议者、确定要削减的社会服务等——但中国共产党(CCP)一直在建设更持久的东西：一个数据中心，促进从社交媒体和其他公共来源进行大规模网络抓取，将结果输入机器学习算法，并输出可操作的结果北京官员的情报。
这是根据泄露给中国监管机构 NetAskari 的文件得出的。在与 Dark Reading 和 Sky News UK 分享的[报告](https://netasari.substack.com/p/ef03ebf1-9615-4422-97c8-86183629af60?postPreview=paid&updated=2026-11-08T09:30:29.111Z&audience=only_paid&free_preview=false&freemail=)中在该出版物中，NetAskari 详细介绍了一项在直接的政府公关与令人讨厌的监视之间取得平衡的计划。有时，数据收集是围绕[剑桥分析风格](https://www.darkreading.com/cybersecurity-analytics/how-to-access-the-voter-information-dirt-cambridge-analytica-has-on-you)有针对性的宣传活动而设计的。在更邪恶的情况下，它被用来识别政治和[经济利益领域](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/4-chinese-apts-taiwan-semiconductor-industry)中的个人，他们有一天可能成为间谍活动中的好间谍或不知情的资产。

相关：[恶意Linux植入模仿亚洲邮件安全产品](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/malicious-linux-implants-mimic-asian-mail-security)
NetAskari 分析师在接受 Dark Reading over Signal 采访时解释道：“一个具有相当不民主倾向的外国正在开展广泛的人工智能分析和信息抓取操作，以寻找影响其他国家内部社会、经济和政治格局的方法。” “这个系统特别针对海外华人，看看是否可以利用[外国公民]来实现这些雄心，即使他们可能没有意识到这一点，这是相当令人震惊的。”

## 中国密谋针对芯片行业的重要人物

11 月 8 日，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋——世界上最重要行业中为数不多的最重要人物之一——给他的员工发了电子邮件，承认与一名新被揭露的间谍有染。国家安全部 (MSS) 特工爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 将 Nvidia 半导体转移到中国，在那里它们被禁止，并将首席执行官的情报转交给中共。

在国安部领导黄的同时，统战部 (UFWD) 采取了自己的、不那么引人注目的方法来应对破坏台湾[半导体行业](https://www.manufacturingdive.com/news/semiconductor-cybersecurity-tsmc-semi-consortium/753133/)的挑战。

UFWD的主要游戏是在国内外的[影响力行动](https://www.darkreading.com/vulnerability-threats/bundestag-bungle-political-microtargeting-of-facebook-users-draws-ire)。据 NetAskari 报道。其任务包括测量和

【原文 English Original】
6 Min Read

Source: TkKurikawa via Getty Images

The Chinese government is keeping tabs on ethnic Chinese people abroad via an AI-powered Big Data mining program. In some cases, the program is helping the government design influence operations targeting high-ranking individuals in the artificial intelligence (AI) industry.

Since the AI boom began, world leaders have been feeling out how to exploit it to cement their power. While Washington's emphasis has been on shorter-term AI ventures — [tracking immigrants](https://therevolvingdoorproject.org/tracking-uses-of-ai-in-the-trump-administration/) and political protestors, identifying social services to cut, etc. — the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has been building something more durable: a data center that facilitates gargantuan Web scraping from social media and other public sources, feeds the results into machine learning algorithms, and outputs actionable intelligence for the apparatchiks in Beijing.

That's according to documents leaked to China watchdog NetAskari. In a [report](https://netaskari.substack.com/p/ef03ebf1-9615-4422-97c8-86183629af60?postPreview=paid&updated=2026-11-08T09:30:29.111Z&audience=only_paid&free_preview=false&freemail=) shared with Dark Reading and Sky News UK ahead of publication, NetAskari detailed a program that balances straightforward government PR with unsavory surveillance. Sometimes the data gathering has been designed around [Cambridge Analytica-style](https://www.darkreading.com/cybersecurity-analytics/how-to-access-the-voter-information-dirt-cambridge-analytica-has-on-you) targeted propaganda campaigns. In more nefarious cases, it has been used to identify individuals in political and [economic spheres of interest](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/4-chinese-apts-taiwan-semiconductor-industry) who might one day make good spies or unwitting assets in spy campaigns.

Related:[Malicious Linux Implants Mimic Asian Mail Security Products](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/malicious-linux-implants-mimic-asian-mail-security)

"A foreign nation with rather undemocratic tendencies is running an extensive, AI-charged analysis and information-scraping operation to find ways to influence other nations' internal social, economic, and political landscapes," a NetAskari analyst explains in an interview with Dark Reading over Signal. "That this system is particularly aiming at the Chinese diaspora, to see if [foreign citizens] can be used to further these ambitions, even if they might not be aware of it, is rather shocking."

## Chinese Plots Against Chip Industry VIPs

On Nov. 8, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang — one of the few most important people in the most important industry in the world — emailed his staff, admitting to an affair with a newly outed spy. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) agent, Alice Huang, redirected Nvidia semiconductors to China, where they're banned, and translated intelligence from the CEO to the CCP.

While the MSS ran Huang, the United Front Work Department (UFWD) took its own, less dramatic approach to the challenge of breaching Taiwan's [semiconductor industry](https://www.manufacturingdive.com/news/semiconductor-cybersecurity-tsmc-semi-consortium/753133/).

The UFWD's main game is [influence operations](https://www.darkreading.com/vulnerabilities-threats/bundestag-bungle-political-microtargeting-of-facebook-users-draws-ire), at home and abroad. according to NetAskari. Its mission includes gauging and shaping media narratives about China abroad, engaging Chinese diaspora communities — to their benefit or detriment, depending on the situation — and, in certain cases, attempting to gain influence over powerful or otherwise useful individuals and organizations in China and abroad.

Related:[UAE, Saudi Arabia Face Onslaught of Increasingly Complex Cyberattacks](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/uae-saudi-arabia-face-onslaught-of-increasingly-sophisticated-automated-cyberattacks)

In this instance, the UFWD appears to have been scoping out ethnic Chinese individuals involved in the semiconductor industry. A leaked report titled "Profiles of Ethnic-Chinese Leading Talent in the Chip Field, Their Circle Characteristics, and Work Recommendations" identifies executives of the Taiwanese AI company Skymizer, high-performing students at a top Taiwanese research university, and an AI research center director at Microsoft, among others, as individuals of note. It then details strategies for getting closer to these VIPs, like "leverage non-official organizations — hometown associations, alumni associations, professional societies — for relationship-building and cooperation."

The system used to generate this report is called the "Overseas Chinese Affairs Big Data Platform."

## The Overseas Chinese Affairs Big Data Platform ("Smart Eye")

The platform's brain is a 500-square-meter Big Data laboratory at Jinan University in Guangzhou, built to comfortably house rows of server racks and at least 100 employees.

Related:[Cybercriminals Hack Brazilian Government Servers to Host Phishing Sites](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/cybercriminals-hack-brazilian-government-servers-host-phishing-sites)

Basically, it's built to ingest massive amounts of online information about overseas Chinese communities, identify people, relationships, and public sentiments, and convert it all into actionable reports for CCP leadership, according to NetAskari.

Social media provides much of the content. The platform scrapes liberally from platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and X, plus Chinese platforms like Weibo and WeChat. As a rule, the actual scrapers are run on machines located in foreign countries. As with Chinese hacking campaigns more broadly, the machines doing the crimes are also shielded behind [rotating proxy networks](https://www.darkreading.com/cybersecurity-operations/chinese-orb-networks-conceal-apts-make-tracking-iocs-irrelevant). The goal of this obfuscation, one leaked document explains, is to “ensure the security of data collection and prevent the collection system from being traced and discovered" by targeted platforms.

The data then makes its way to China for processing. Foreign languages are translated into Chinese, keywords are extracted, and meaningful links drawn. UFWD then cross-references these data with preexisting records of notable people identified as being involved in the media, sciences, politics, etc., as well as blacklisted and "two-faced people." These two sources feed a "business system" — the layer that seems to draw meaningful connections about public sentiments, the results of influence operations, and more.

Sometimes, the final reports outputted by this multitiered system simply concern public relations trends. Sometimes they've been used to identify ethnic Chinese individuals of note around the world — be they Taiwanese engineers, social media influencers, or something in between — and unearth strategies for how to utilize them to further the ends of the Chinese Communist Party.

## Using AI to Expand CCP Influence

Overall, the NetAskari analyst describes the Overseas Chinese Affairs Big Data Platform as "a worldwide dragnet that uses open source intelligence (OSINT) and Big Data analysis to identify and find potential collaborators, partners, and affiliates that the UFWD can work with to further their goal [of] extending the Communist Party's influence abroad and creating a 'China-friendly' environment in other nations' political, economic, and social settings."

It's nothing the UFWD wasn't doing before, to be sure. Instead, the analyst adds, "What used to be done manually, at a much slower speed, is now supercharged via AI and modern technology."

That, ultimately, is the rub. The leaked documents contain only outdated references, from 2021, about how machine learning (ML) and [natural language processing](https://www.techtarget.com/news/What-is-natural-language-processing-NLP/834259/) (NLP) algorithms fit into this picture. It's unclear whether, and how, more modern large language models have been incorporated into — and potentially supercharged — the system. The better the AI gets, the more wide-ranging and granular the Overseas Chinese Affairs Big Data Platform can become, with real consequences for people who may not know they are being targeted by a foreign nation.

"A surveillance state can't accept that its own citizens are escaping to other nations, outside the reach of Beijing's grasp. For the best part of the last 20 years, most people had the luxury to ignore this part of the Chinese-state. Often practical and physical limitations restricted Chinese organiations to expand too quickly abroad or even get a foothold. But with remote methods like the ones we have seen applied in the Big-Data center of Jinan University, these 'natural boundaries' don't apply anymore," the analysti laments.

"Pair it now with ever growing globalization, China's stepping out onto the world stage, and crises of democracy in many Western nations, and it is not hard to see why such operations should concern even average citizens in the US or Europe," he says. "Even if they have no personal ties to China."

## About the Author

[![Image 2: Nate Nelson](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6d90778a997de1cd/blt8edb70f1c73f8a5a/6978c3c26fdea754c9f2e2e9/Nate_Nelson_bio_pic_2-crop_2.jpg?width=400&auto=webp&quality=80&disable=upscale)](https://www.darkreading.com/author/nate-nelson)

Contributing Writer

Nate Nelson is a journalist and award-winning scriptwriter. In addition to Dark Reading he writes for Darknet Diaries, the most popular show in cybersecurity across all media.

He began his career as a freelancer, ghostwriting Forbes and CNBC op-eds for executives in tech and finance. Then he transitioned to journalism at Threatpost, where he covered cybersecurity news and trends. Throughout those years he co-created a cybersecurity podcast, Malicious Life, which in its day climbed into the Top 20 technology podcasts charts on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

He holds degrees from New York University and Bard College. As a born and bred New Yorker, he enjoys a superiority complex, but is polite enough to keep it to himself.

七国集团外长称中国在台湾以东的行动威胁稳定
七国集团声明称部长们强调维护台海和平与稳定的重要性
发布 - 2026 年 11 月 12 日上午 08:43（美国标准时间）- 台北
乌克兰外长西比加、德国外长瓦德菲尔、英国外长米利班德、美国国务卿卢比奥、法国外长巴罗、加拿大外长阿南德、意大利副总理、外长塔贾尼、日本外相茂木敏充、欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表兼副主席卡亚卡拉斯。 |图片来源：路透社
七国集团外长在巴黎会议后于周三晚间（2026 年 11 月 11 日）发布的联合声明中表示，中国在台湾以东海域日益强硬的行动威胁到地区稳定和航行自由。
中国将台湾视为自己的领土，自六月以来加强了台湾东海岸的活动，定期进行海岸警卫队巡逻。拒绝北京主权主张的台湾官员表示，他们相信中国正在利用重叠的军事、准军事和民用资产进行潜在的海上封锁。
台湾称中国东海岸巡逻骚扰航运
七国集团声明称，部长们强调维护台海和平与稳定的重要性。
声明称，中国在台湾以东海域日益咄咄逼人的活动“威胁到地区稳定、航行自由和国际航运安全”。
“我们重申反对任何单方面改变现状的企图，特别是通过武力或胁迫或威胁的方式。”
中国外交部​没有立即回应置评请求。中国不承认台湾的任何主权主张。
台湾称驱逐16艘参与“海上骚扰”的中国船只
在中国海警上个月在东海岸进行最新一次巡逻后，台湾表示中国正在骚扰航运并试图施加虚构的管辖权。
台北认为，在发生封锁或冲突时，其东海岸附近的地区对于盟国的战时补给路线至关重要。
美国、英国、法国和德国此前都曾对中国在台湾东海岸的行动表示担忧。
中国军队也每天在台湾周边活动。
台湾称中国使用民兵船扩大西太平洋“战场准备”
据报道，中国活动有所增加后，台湾国防部长顾维钧周二（11 月 10 日）表示，中国正在西太平洋进行“区域封锁”演习，涉及其一艘航空母舰和其他海军编队。
中国从未放弃使用武力将台湾置于其控制之下，尽管它表示更愿意“和平统一”。

G7 Foreign Ministers say China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability
The G7 statement said the Ministers ⁠stressed the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait
Published - November 12, 2026 08:43 am IST - TAIPEI
Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiga, Germany's Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, Britain's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, France's Foreign Affairs Minister Jean-Noel Barrot, Canada's Foreign Minister Anita Anand, Italy's Deputy Prime Minister, and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani, Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi and EU High Representative and Vice-President for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas. | Photo Credit: Reuters
China's increasingly assertive actions in the waters east of Taiwan threaten regional stability and ​freedom of navigation, G7 Foreign Ministers said in a joint ‌declaration published late on Wednesday (November 11, 2026) following a meeting ​in Paris.
China, which views Taiwan as ⁠its own territory, has stepped up activity off the island's east coast since June with regular coast guard patrols. Officials ‌in Taiwan, which rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, say they believe China is practising for a ‌potential maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and ‌civilian ⁠assets.
Taiwan says China harassing shipping with east coast patrol
The G7 statement said the Ministers ⁠stressed the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.
China's increasingly assertive activities in the waters east of Taiwan "threaten regional ​stability, freedom of ‌navigation and the safety of international shipping", the statement said.
"We reaffirmed our opposition to any unilateral attempts to change the status quo, particularly by force ‌or coercion, or the threat thereof."
China's Foreign Ministry ​did not immediately respond to a request for comment. China recognises no claims of ⁠sovereignty by Taiwan.
Taiwan says drives away 16 Chinese ships involved in 'maritime harassment'
Following the Chinese Coast Guard's latest patrol off the east coast last month, Taiwan said China ‌was harassing shipping and trying to exert a fictional jurisdiction.
Taipei regards the area off its east coast as critical to wartime supply routes from allies in the event of a blockade or conflict.
The United States, Britain, France and Germany have all previously expressed ‌their concern about China's actions off Taiwan's east coast.
China's military ​also operates around Taiwan on a daily basis.
Taiwan says China using militia boats to expand 'battlefield preparation' in western Pacific
China is carrying out "area denial" drills in the ⁠Western Pacific involving one of its aircraft carriers and ⁠other naval formations, Taiwan Defence Minister Wellington Koo said on Tuesday (November 10), following a reported rise in ‌Chinese activities.
China has never renounced the use of force to bring Taiwan under its control, though ​it says it would prefer "peaceful reunification".

|谈到日本，中国很难想清楚
谈到日本，中国很难想清楚
自日本首相高市早苗于 2025 年 11 月承认对台湾使用武力“可能对日本构成威胁生存的局面”以来，中日关系已陷入深度冻结一年多，这种言辞暗示日本将进行军事干预。
中国迅速做出反应，发起猛烈批评，甚至声称（在新窗口中打开）日本计划重返1930年代的军国主义并重新殖民台湾。北京和东京之间的政治接触、文化联系、旅游和贸易（包括中国出口的稀土磁铁和具有潜在军事用途的物品）都被中断。
中国没有表现出软化立场的迹象。 2026年11月6日，外交部发言人再次要求日方“纠正在台湾问题上的错误言行，在历史问题上采取正确态度，形成客观理性的对华认知”。
日本首相高市早苗于 2025 年 11 月承认，对台湾使用武力“可能对日本构成生存威胁” (@takaichi_sanae/X)
从某种程度上来说，高一的言论并不出奇，尽管比日本领导人通常更坦率。美国政界人士也曾说过类似的话。但当谈到日本时，中国却很难思考清楚。其反应的强度可以用几个因素来解释：
高市是一位新领导人（当时上任不到三周），女性，具有鹰派声誉。北京希望尽早确立主导地位，并在可能的情况下迫使其让步。
当谈到台湾时，日本引起了特别的敏感。 1895年清朝被日本击败，割让台湾成为日本殖民地。
动荡的中美关系最近趋于稳定，为北京惩罚东京提供了较低的风险环境。
北京反对并希望削弱日本目前增加国防开支和增强自身能力的努力（回应中国自身的大规模军备建设）。
日本并没有做出任何让步。东京冷静地坚守立场，同时为对话敞开大门。
中国没有表现出继续前进的兴趣。它长期以来一直将日本1930年代侵略的遗产作为双边压力点，利用东京在承认其过去方面的尴尬，并敦促韩国和现在的俄罗斯等其他国家加入。
中国的宣传机器在回声室中运作。它擅长针对受害者，但不适合自我意识或自我纠正。关于军国主义死灰复燃的言论已经结束

When it comes to Japan, China finds it hard to think straight
Japan’s blunt words on Taiwan froze relations with China a year ago, and Beijing still won’t blink.

|When it comes to Japan, China finds it hard to think straight
When it comes to Japan, China finds it hard to think straight
China–Japan ties have been in deep freeze for more than a year now since Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi acknowledged (Opens in new window) in November 2025 that the use of force against Taiwan “could constitute a survival-threatening situation” for Japan, a form of words implying Japan would intervene militarily.
China reacted quickly, launching a campaign of vehement criticism, even claiming (Opens in new window) Japan was planning to return to the militarism of the 1930s and recolonise Taiwan. Political contact between Beijing and Tokyo was disrupted, as were cultural ties, tourism and trade, including Chinese exports of rare earth magnets and items with potential military uses.
China shows no sign of softening its position. On 6 November 2026, its Foreign Ministry spokesperson reiterated (Opens in new window) demands that Japan “correct the erroneous words and deeds on the Taiwan question, adopt a correct attitude on historical issues, and form an objective and rational perception on China”.
Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi acknowledged in November 2025 that the use of force against Taiwan “could constitute a survival-threatening situation” for Japan (@takaichi_sanae/X)
On one level, what Takaichi said was unremarkable, albeit more candid than is usual for a Japanese leader. US politicians have said similar things. But China has difficulty thinking straight when it comes to Japan. The intensity of its reaction can be explained by several factors:
Takaichi was a new leader (in office less than three weeks at the time), female, with a hawkish reputation. Beijing wanted to establish early dominance and, if possible, force a backdown.
Japan arouses particular sensitivities when it comes to Taiwan. It was the Qing Dynasty’s defeat by Japan in 1895 that ceded Taiwan to become a Japanese colony.
The volatile China–US relationship had recently stabilised, providing a lower risk environment in which Beijing could punish Tokyo.
Beijing opposes and hopes to weaken Japan’s current efforts (responding to China’s own massive military buildup) to increase defence spending and enhance its own capabilities.
No Japanese backdown has materialised. Tokyo has calmly stood its ground, while leaving open the door for dialogue.
China shows no interest in moving on. It has long sustained the legacy of Japan’s 1930s aggression as a bilateral pressure point, exploiting Tokyo’s awkwardness in acknowledging its past, and prodding South Korea and now others, like Russia, to join in.
China’s propaganda machinery operates in an echo chamber. It is adept at targeting a victim, but not suited to self-awareness or self-correction. Its rhetoric about resurgent militarism is overblown and ridiculous. The Japanese leaders who ought to have done more in facing up to the past have long since departed. It is futile to expect their successors to go any further, especially when their accusers hint at revenge while concealing their own more contemporary atrocities.
Beijing may have decided to wait Takaichi out. This is not without risk: while Japanese prime ministers usually turn over within two years, there are exceptions, notably Shinzo Abe, whose policy and ideological mantle Takaichi has inherited. Who is to say that Beijing’s pressure campaign will not serve to strengthen her politically? In the meantime, with a weakened US administration, Beijing would better win over this important neighbour, rather than humiliate it.
The upcoming regional summits – East Asia (16–17 November), APEC (18–19 November) and G20 (14–15 December) – offer potential for an initial rapprochement between leaders. The East Asia Summit might be more likely, since China is represented there by its premier, rather than its president, allowing President Xi Jinping to keep his distance from a potentially unproductive encounter. Otherwise, no immediate circuit-breaker is in sight.
A highway without off-ramps is no better than a cul-de-sac.
Words matter. Just because something is true does not mean it needs to be said, especially by a national leader. There are less damaging ways for Tokyo to convey to Beijing its determination regarding security in its immediate region. Takaichi’s explicitness was unnecessary and an unforced misstep.
A highway without off-ramps is no better than a cul-de-sac. Beijing’s hardline rhetoric may play well domestically, but its intransigence seems to rule out the kind of accommodation it claims to seek with Japan. Backdowns are difficult for any government, especially in a democracy. Japan–China ties look set to remain permanently prickly.
Graham Fletcher is Senior Fellow for East Asia at the Lowy Institute and a former Australian Ambassador to China.

US, China stress importance of potential trilateral talks with Russia
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi stated that the leader-level conversations must address peace and denuclearization
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi
WASHINGTON, November 12. /TASS/. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi agreed during a phone call on the importance of holding potential high-level talks with Russia to address peace and nuclear arms reduction, the US State Department's press office said.
"They agreed on the importance of meaningful leader-level conversations to advance goals such as peace and denuclearization, including at any potential trilateral leaders meeting with Russia," the department said in a statement posted on its X account.
Rubio and Wang discussed the APEC summit, scheduled to take place in Shenzhen, China, on November 18-19, as well as the G20 summit, scheduled for December 14-15 in Miami. They also discussed "bilateral leader-level commitment to a constructive relationship of strategic stability on the basis of respect, fairness, and reciprocity." The call took place at China's request.
