中国人民解放军 (PLA) 拥有一支日益多样化的直升机机队，涵盖从基本飞行员训练和战场运输到空中预警、反潜战和专门攻击任务等各个领域。这支部队反映了数十年的发展，通常从从法国购买直升机开始，后来经许可生产，然后逐渐转向本土设计。其结果是，经过大规模现代化改造的旧飞机和根据中国不断扩大的军事需求而设计的新平台，包括不断壮大的航母和两栖攻击舰队。 Z-10 攻击直升机。摄影：VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-8 系列最初源自冷战时期的法国 Super Frelon，是这种演变的一个特别好的例子。它催生了各种专门的变体，包括搜索和救援、运输、电子战和机载指挥所直升机。与此同时，Z-20（经常被称为西科斯基 S-70/H-60 克隆版）已成为具有陆基、海军和攻击型的现代中型运输平台，而 Z-10 和更新的 Z-21 则代表了中国对专用攻击直升机的日益重视。 2024 年，中国南方广东省珠海市的珠海航展上，一架 Z-8C 飞机进行空中攻击演示。
CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images 本指南探讨了解放军运营的主要直升机类型、它们的发展以及它们预期发挥的作用。同时，应该指出的是，就目前情况而言，解放军在各种应用中仍然严重依赖外国采购的直升机。俄罗斯制造的直升机为解放军提供了运输和特种海军能力的结合。 Mi-17/171 Hip 系列支持部队和货物运输、搜索和救援、特种作战以及选择高空或特定任务角色。在海上，Ka-28 Helix 提供反潜战能力，而 Ka-31 的雷达则支持机载舰队监视。这些飞机仍在服役，其既定能力继续满足作战需求。然而，它们越来越多地得到中国设计的补充，包括某些专门为提供直接替代品而定制的设计。解放军运营的最先进的直升机是用于战斗搜索和救援的 Mi-171Sh。它具有广泛的自我保护设备和武器。摄影：Sun Lin/VCG via Getty Images 实用、训练和轻型直升机 HC-120 HC-120 是一款轻型通用直升机，源自 EC120，EC120 是中国、法国和新加坡在 20 世纪 90 年代共同开发的设计。
该型号于 2005 年进入解放军陆军航空兵服役，为初级直升机训练提供了现代化平台，并取代了老化的 SA316 Alouette III。HC-120 由一台透博梅卡 Arrius 2F 涡轮轴发动机提供动力。它的推出代表了陆军航空训练机队现代化的重要一步，为飞行员在过渡到更大的作战类型之前提供了使用更现代的直升机的经验。一架 HC-120，采用陆军航空训练学校的颜色。来自中国互联网 Z-11 Z-11 是由昌河飞机工业公司（CHAIC）和 602 研究所开发的轻型通用直升机。该设计基于法国 AS350BA Écureuil ，其示例来自于

【原文 English Original】
China’s People’s Liberation Army (PLA) operates an increasingly diverse fleet of helicopters spanning everything from basic pilot training and battlefield transport to airborne early warning, anti-submarine warfare, and dedicated attack missions. The force reflects decades of development, often beginning with helicopters acquired from France and later produced under license, before transitioning to increasingly indigenous designs. The result is a mix of older aircraft that have undergone extensive modernization and newer platforms designed around the requirements of China’s expanding military, including its growing carrier and amphibious assault fleets . A Z-10 attack helicopter. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images The Z-8 family, originally derived from the Cold War-era French Super Frelon , is a particularly good example of this evolution. It has spawned a wide range of specialized variants, including search and rescue, transport, electronic warfare, and airborne command post helicopters. Meanwhile, the Z-20 — frequently alluded to as a Sikorsky S-70/H-60 clone — has emerged as a modern medium-lift platform with land-based, naval, and assault variants, while the Z-10 and newer Z-21 represent China’s growing emphasis on dedicated attack helicopters. A PLAN Z-8C conducts an aerial assault demonstration at the Zhuhai Air Show in Zhuhai, south China’s Guangdong province, in 2024. CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images This guide examines the principal helicopter types operated by the PLA, their development, and the roles they are expected to perform. At the same time, it should be noted that, as it now stands, the PLA remains heavily reliant on foreign-sourced helicopters for a wide variety of applications. Russian-built helicopters give the PLA a mix of transport and specialized naval capabilities. The Mi-17/171 Hip family supports troop and cargo movement, search and rescue, special operations, and select high-altitude or mission-specific roles. At sea, the Ka-28 Helix provides anti-submarine warfare, while the Ka-31’s radar supports airborne fleet surveillance. These aircraft remain in service where their established capabilities continue to meet operational needs. However, they are increasingly supplemented by Chinese designs, including certain designs that have been tailored to provide direct replacements. The most advanced Hip helicopter operated by the PLA is the Mi-171Sh used for combat search and rescue. It features extensive self-protection equipment and armament. Photo by Sun Lin/VCG via Getty Images Utility, Training, and Light Helicopters HC-120 The HC-120 is a light utility helicopter derived from the EC120, a design co-developed by China, France, and Singapore during the 1990s. The type entered service with PLA Army Aviation in 2005, providing a modern platform for primary helicopter training and replacing the aging SA316 Alouette III in that role. The HC-120 is powered by a single Turbomeca Arrius 2F turboshaft engine. Its introduction represented an important step in modernizing the Army Aviation training fleet, giving pilots experience with a more contemporary helicopter before transitioning to larger operational types. An HC-120 in the colors of the Army Aviation Training School. via Chinese internet Z-11 The Z-11 is a light utility helicopter developed by Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation (CHAIC) and the 602 Research Institute. The design is based on the French AS350BA Écureuil , examples of which were acquired for Army Aviation. Deliveries of the Z-11 to Army Aviation began in 1998. The helicopter is powered by a single WZ-8D turboshaft engine and is primarily used for training, liaison, and other light utility duties. A scout and armed reconnaissance derivative, designated as the Z-11WB, was developed with a nose-mounted electro-optical (EO) turret and external weapon pylons capable of carrying rockets, missiles, and gun pods. Its operational status remains unclear, although it provided the basis for the unarmed Z-11A training helicopter used by the Army Aviation Academy. A demonstrator for the Z-11WB scout and armed reconnaissance helicopter. via Chinese internet The Z-8 Family: From French Origins To A Modern Helicopter Lineage Z-8J The Z-8 was developed from the French SA321Ja Super Frelon, 13 examples of which China purchased during the late 1970s. Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation subsequently developed an indigenous version during the 1980s. Powered by three WZ-6 turboshaft engines, the original Z-8 became the foundation for a broad family of helicopters serving the PLA Navy (PLAN), Army Aviation, and People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF). The Z-8J is the naval transport variant, with a boat-like hull. For anti-submarine warfare (ASW) missions, the helicopter can be equipped with a surface-search radar, a French HS-12 dipping sonar, and Whitehead A244S or ET52 torpedoes. Several specialized derivatives were developed from the Z-8J: Z-8S: A naval search and rescue (SAR) version with upgraded avionics, a searchlight, a forward-looking infrared (FLIR) turret, and a rescue hoist. Most Z-8Js have reportedly been upgraded to this configuration. Z-8JH: A medical evacuation and SAR variant. The Z-8J and Z-8JH have both been used aboard Chinese aircraft carriers, providing transport and support capabilities for embarked naval forces. A Z-8JH on the PLAN replenishment ship Kekexilihu at Qingdao Port, Shandong Province of China, in 2023. Photo by Fu Tian/China News Service/VCG via Getty Images Z-8C The Z-8C represents a substantially improved successor to the original naval Z-8J series. The helicopter was first reported in 2016 and incorporates a number of changes intended to improve its performance and operational versatility. The most visible differences include a redesigned nose with a chin-mounted weather radar, a FLIR turret, and a pilot night-vision system (PNVS) mounted above the cockpit. A searchlight is also fitted, while the longer engine compartment accommodates the WZ-6C turboshaft engine. The Z-8C is operated by the PLA Marine Corps, while the Z-8CJ serves as a training variant with the Naval Aviation University. The helicopter has become a principal transport platform for the Type 075 amphibious assault ship, supporting the movement of troops and equipment between ships and shore. Z-8C helicopters conduct aerial display training for the upcoming Airshow China in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province of China, in 2024. Photo by Chen Xiao/VCG via Getty Images Z-8K/KA The PLAAF introduced the Z-8K in 2007 as a dedicated search-and-rescue helicopter. The related Z-8KA is configured for combat search and rescue (CSAR), including the recovery of personnel from hostile or contested environments. Both versions feature a FLIR turret, searchlight, radar-warning receiver (RWR), chaff and flare dispensers, and a rescue hoist. Some aircraft are also equipped with small terrain-following radars beneath the nose to support low-level operations. Selected helicopters have received satellite communications (SATCOM) antennas on top of the tail boom, improving their communications capabilities over longer distances. A further derivative, the Z-8KH, was developed for the PLAAF garrison stationed in Hong Kong. This version is distinguished by chaff and flare dispensers integrated into its flotation equipment. A Z-8KA helicopter during the 2022 Changchun Air Show at Changchun Dafangshen Airport, Jilin Province of China. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-8B The Z-8B entered service with PLA Army Aviation in 2011 as an improved transport helicopter. It shares several characteristics with the Z-8KH but lacks the latter’s flotation equipment. The Z-8B incorporates a glass cockpit and has become a major component of the Army Aviation transport fleet. Some aircraft have subsequently had flotation equipment reinstalled, reflecting the type’s continuing evolution. An optional auxiliary fuel tank can be installed inside the cabin to extend its range. Other upgrades have included SATCOM antennas on the tail boom and, on some aircraft, WZ-6C engines, an EO turret, and a terrain-following radar beneath the nose. A specialized operations variant has also been identified. These helicopters incorporate RWR, laser-warning receivers (LWR), and missile-approach warning system (MAWS) sensors, alongside flare dispensers and ceramic armor protection. A still from a CCTV video shows a Z-8B equipped with RWR, LWR, and MAWS sensors, as well as countermeasures dispensers. via Chinese internet Z-8G Lacking the boat-like hull of the Z-8B, the Z-8G is expected to replace that type in Army Aviation service. The helicopter was evaluated from 2014 and was specifically optimized for operations at high altitudes, including in Tibet. Unlike earlier Z-8 variants, the initial Z-8G configuration uses imported Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6B-67A turboshaft engines. Its redesigned nose is longer and more aerodynamically efficient, while the glass cockpit and terrain-following radar support operations in demanding environments. The helicopter also incorporates SATCOM and BeiDou/GPS antennas to improve communications and navigation during long-range missions. Some Z-8Gs have been equipped for special operations, with combinations of MAWS, RWR, and LWR sensors mounted on the rear fuselage and sponsons, together with chaff and flare dispensers. Armor plates beneath the cockpit windows provide additional protection, and some aircraft carry a 12.7mm machine gun inside a cabin doorway. Several specialized variants have also been identified: A battlefield electronic-warfare helicopter featuring large cylindrical antennas mounted on both sides of the mid-fuselage. Another electronic warfare configuration reportedly uses rectangular plate antenna arrays mounted on both sides of the rear fuselage. An airborne command-post variant featuring a retractable synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) surveillance system inside the rear fuselage, alongside additional electronic-support-measures (ESM) antennas. Some Z-8Gs may also have adopted the indigenous WZ-6C engine. A Z-8G at Airshow China at Zhuhai in 2024. Photo by Costfoto/NurPhoto via Getty Images Z-8L The Z-8L is a wide-body development of the Z-8G that first flew in 2017. Its most prominent feature is a pair of large sponsons mounted along the sides of the fuselage, providing additional space for fuel tanks and other equipment. The wider fuselage also increases internal volume, allowing the helicopter to carry more cargo and equipment. Relocating the internal fuel tanks beneath the cabin floor has further increased usable cabin space. Some aircraft have been observed with RWR and MAWS sensors on both sides of the forward fuselage, a roof-mounted FLIR turret, and a terrain-following radar beneath the nose. Additional defensive equipment, including LWR and RWR sensors and chaff/flare dispensers, can be installed on the sponsons. A SATCOM antenna is mounted on top of the tail boom. The original PT6B-67A engines are reportedly being replaced by the more powerful indigenous WZ-7 turboshaft. The Z-8L provides the Army with a larger and more capable transport helicopter suited to demanding operating environments and specialized missions. A Z-8L (nearest camera) alongside a Z-20 during the 2022 Airshow China in Zhuhai, Guangdong province of China. Photo by Stringer/Anadolu Agency via Getty Images Z-8D The Z-8D is a shipborne derivative of the Z-8L that first appeared in 2023. It combines the wide-body configuration with an extensive self-defense suite intended to improve survivability during operations over water. The helicopter features RWR, LWR, and MAWS sensors, along with chaff and flare dispensers. Four inflatable flotation units provide emergency protection in the event of a forced landing at sea. Power is supplied by either WZ-6C or the newer WZ-7 turboshaft engines. Engine air particle separators (EAPS) are installed ahead of the engine inlets to reduce the risk of damage from airborne debris. The Z-8D is expected to operate from China’s Type 075 amphibious assault ships and the larger Type 076 amphibious assault ship. One of the first clear images of a PLAN Naval Aviation Z-8D. via Chinese internet The Z-18 Series: Naval Utility, Early Warning, and ASW Helicopters Z-18Y Named White Heron, the Z-18Y was developed by the 602 Research Institute and Changhe as a new medium-lift shipborne transport helicopter. It is derived from the AC313 but incorporates a redesigned fuselage and a number of changes intended to improve its naval suitability. The helicopter uses imported PT6B-67A turboshaft engines and provides greater internal volume and payload capacity than the earlier Z-8. Improved performance in hot-and-high conditions is another important feature. The Z-18Y incorporates a nose-mounted weather radar and an FLIR/TV turret, along with additional communication and navigation antennas beneath the fuselage. A SATCOM antenna is installed on top of the tail boom. Folding main and tail rotor blades allow the helicopter to be stored more efficiently aboard ships. The Z-18Y is primarily used for carrier onboard delivery (COD) missions, transporting personnel and supplies between ships and shore. It has also provided the basis for several specialized naval derivatives. A Z-18Y operating from a Type 075 class assault ship. PLA Z-18J Named Bat, the Z-18J is an airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) helicopter developed from the Z-18Y. Its principal feature is a retractable radar antenna housed within a redesigned rear fuselage. The long-range, multimode AESA radar is lowered vertically during operation, providing 360-degree coverage around the helicopter. The Z-18J also incorporates a nose-mounted FLIR turret and additional MAWS and RWR antennas distributed around the nose and rear fuselage. Chaff and flare dispensers are installed in the flotation equipment. The helicopter has been used aboard Chinese aircraft carriers as an interim airborne early-warning platform and has also been observed operating from Type 075 amphibious assault ships. A rescue hoist is installed on the starboard side of the forward fuselage, allowing the aircraft to perform secondary SAR duties. An improved Z-18A features a redesigned engine and gearbox compartment and three indigenous WZ-6C engines. Some Z-18Js and Z-18As have also received SATCOM antennas to improve long-range communications. A Z-18J together with two J-15 fighters onboard the Liaoning . via Chinese internet Z-18F Named Sea Eagle, the Z-18F is an ASW and anti-ship warfare helicopter developed from the Z-18Y. It first appeared in 2014 and represents a substantial improvement over the earlier Z-8-based naval ASW helicopters. The helicopter incorporates a large surface-search radar beneath the nose, while its FLIR/TV turret has been relocated to the starboard side of the fuselage. A dipping sonar provides an additional means of detecting submarines, while MAWS and RWR antennas are installed on the forward and rear fuselage. Additional communications and navigation antennas are mounted beneath the fuselage. Four external pylons can carry torpedoes or anti-ship missiles (AShMs), including the YJ-9. A dispenser near the rear loading ramp allows the helicopter to deploy sonobuoys. The Z-18F operates aboard Chinese aircraft carriers and the Type 075 amphibious assault ship. Several improved derivatives have since appeared: Z-18FA: Incorporates a redesigned engine and gearbox compartment and three domestic WZ-6C turboshaft engines. Z-18FG: Features a new chin-mounted search radar and small side pylons for lightweight ASW torpedoes or AShMs. Z-18FB: A further improved version reportedly powered by three WZ-7 turboshaft engines, replacing the Canadian PT6B-67A. These developments point to a continuing effort to improve the Z-18’s performance and extend the operational life of the broader family. A Z-18F assigned to the aircraft carrier Liaoning . via Chinese internet The Z-9 Family Z-9A/B The Z-9 originated from the French AS365 Dauphin family, with China acquiring aircraft and subsequently producing them under license through Harbin Aircraft Industry Group (HAIG) during the 1990s. The Z-9A became a principal utility helicopter for Army Aviation and was also used for pilot training. The improved Z-9B incorporated a greater proportion of indigenous components, helping establish the foundation for China’s broader Z-9 development program, which also took it in a maritime direction. The helicopter has since become one of China’s most widely used light utility platforms and has also been widely exported in the Z-9E series. Cambodian soldiers stand in front of Z-9s during a handover ceremony at a Royal Cambodian Air Force base in Phnom Penh, in 2013. KHEM SOVANNARA/AFP via Getty Images KHEM SOVANNARA Z-9C The Z-9C is China’s indigenous naval derivative of the French AS565 Panther , examples of which were imported during the late 1980s. The helicopter incorporates a domestically developed surface-search radar and dipping sonar, allowing it to conduct ASW missions. It can carry up to two Yu-7K torpedoes and is equipped with inflatable flotation bags for emergency landings on water. Some Z-9Cs have been converted to SAR duties, receiving a searchlight, an EO turret, and a rescue hoist. The type has also been used for anti-piracy patrols off the Somali coast. In this role, some aircraft have carried a 12.7mm gun pod and a 57mm rocket launcher. A downgraded training version was developed for the Naval Aviation Academy. Z-9 sits aboard the Type 052D destroyer Zhanjiang at Ngong Shuen Chau Naval Base on Stonecutters Island in Hong Kong on July 6, 2025. Photo by AFP Z-9D The Z-9D is an improved derivative of the Z-9C, incorporating a greater emphasis on anti-surface warfare. The helicopter features stub wings capable of carrying up to four AShMs for use against smaller surface targets. A new fire-control radar is housed in a larger nose cone, while the weapon-control officer is positioned in the rear cabin. RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the nose and near the tail rotor. The Z-9D has been observed operating from Type 056 and Type 056A frigates. Some aircraft have also received an EO turret beneath the fuselage, expanding their surveillance and targeting capabilities. A Z-9D carrying a YJ-9 anti-ship missile. via Chinese internet Z-9F The Z-9F is an improved ASW helicopter based on the Z-9D. It was first observed in 2017 and is expected to replace the older Z-9C. The helicopter incorporates a new dipping sonar, a glass cockpit, and an improved surface-search radar. A BeiDou antenna is mounted on top of the cabin. The Z-9F retains the ability to carry up to two ASW torpedoes beneath its stub wings, providing a more modern platform for shipborne submarine-hunting missions. Z-9S The Z-9S is a naval search-and-rescue helicopter developed for operations aboard Chinese aircraft carriers. It features a nose-mounted EO turret, a searchlight, and a rescue hoist installed on the starboard side. The helicopter is also used for training by the Naval Aviation University. A small number of SAR-configured Z-9S helicopters are also operated by Army Aviation. A Z-9S conducts exercises onboard a Type 055 destroyer. via Chinese internet Z-9WA/WZ The Z-9WA is a night-attack development of the Z-9W, incorporating more powerful engines and improved avionics for operations in low-light conditions. The helicopter features stub wings capable of carrying up to eight KD-8 anti-tank guided missiles (ATGMs) or PL-90 air-to-air missiles (AAMs). A nose-mounted low-light TV/IR turret supports night operations, while RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the fuselage. Additional features include cockpit armor, flare dispensers, a datalink, and a redesigned cockpit compatible with night-vision goggles (NVGs). Z-9WZ. via Chinese internet The improved Z-9WZ incorporates a laser designator, allowing it to employ the newer KD-9 ATGM, as well as FN-6 AAMs. It is also powered by WZ-8H engines. Most Z-9WAs are believed to have been upgraded to the WZ standard. The PLAAF operates some Z-9WA/WZ helicopters in the SAR role. A similar derivative, the Z-9ZH, is used by the PLAAF garrison stationed in Hong Kong. Dedicated Attack and Scout Helicopters Z-10 The Z-10 represents China’s first dedicated modern attack helicopter. Developed by the 602 Research Institute, CHAIC, and HAIG, the program also received early input from Russia’s Kamov design bureau. The helicopter features a conventional tandem-seat gunship configuration, with the gunner seated in front and the pilot behind. A five-blade composite main rotor and distinctive scissor-type tail rotor distinguish the design. The Z-10 is powered by WZ-9 turboshaft engines and entered service in 2010, following its first flight in 2003. A Z-10K at the Shek Kong Barracks in Hong Kong, China. Photo by Zhang Xiangyi/China News Service/VCG via Getty Images Its primary armament consists of up to eight KD-9 or KD-10 laser-guided ATGMs, supplemented by a chin-mounted 23mm chain gun. The helicopter can also carry up to eight PL-90 AAMs. The nose-mounted PNVS and target acquisition and designation system (TADS)-equivalent housing incorporates FLIR, a TV camera, a laser rangefinder, and a laser designator. RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the forward and aft fuselage, while LWR sensors are mounted on the pylon tips. The initial prototypes were powered by the Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6C-76C engine. Series-production aircraft instead adopted the less powerful WZ-9, resulting in reductions to armor protection, sensor size, and weapon load compared with the original configuration. Several variants and upgrades have since emerged: Z-10H: Retains the original PNVS/TADS configuration while using WZ-9 engines. Z-10K: A dedicated version for PLAAF airborne units, featuring a new 23mm gun and 19-tube rocket launchers. Some aircraft have SATCOM antennas on top of the tail boom. Z-10A: The definitive production configuration, distinguished by upward-facing engine exhaust nozzles. Later upgrades: Some Z-10 and Z-10K aircraft have received additional ceramic armor, MAWS sensors on the nose, and SATCOM antennas for long-range communications. The helicopter has also gained newer long-range, IIR/CCD-guided ATGMs. These weapons require an additional datalink antenna mounted in front of the PNVS. Later developments include the introduction of millimeter-wave (MMW) radar-guided fire-and-forget missiles, potentially allowing the Z-10 to operate alongside the Z-19 in coordinated attack missions. The export-oriented Z-10ME incorporates further improvements, including a mast-mounted MMW radar. Z-19 The Z-19 is a scout and attack helicopter developed by HAIG using the H425 as its basis. It was intended to replace the Z-9WA while complementing the larger Z-10. The helicopter features a narrow fuselage and tandem cockpit, with the pilot seated in front and the gunner behind. A nose-mounted EO turret incorporates FLIR, a TV camera, and a laser rangefinder, while RWR antennas provide warning of hostile radar emissions. The Z-19 uses the same WZ-8C engines, transmission, and rotor systems as the H425, helping accelerate its development. A Z-19 without the mast-mounted MMW radar. via Chinese internet When fitted with a mast-mounted MMW radar, the Z-19 provides additional target-detection capabilities. The helicopter’s armament is broadly similar to that of the Z-9WA, including KD-9 and KD-10 ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, rocket launchers, and gun pods. Later upgrades include MAWS sensors on the nose and tail, along with LWR sensors on the stub wings. The Z-19 has also been integrated with newer long-range IIR/CCD/laser-guided ATGMs, including the KF-9, KF-10, and KF-11. These weapons require an additional datalink antenna mounted on the nose. Z-21 The Z-21 is a new heavy attack helicopter first identified in 2024. Developed by the 602 Research Institute, Changhe, and Hafei, it appears to be a substantially larger and more heavily protected gunship than the Z-10. The helicopter is believed to use the WZ-10 turboshaft engines and rotor systems developed for the Z-20. It features a conventional tandem-seat configuration, with a gunner in the front and a pilot behind. One of the first photos of the Z-21. via Chinese internet Large cheek fairings on either side of the fuselage incorporate MAWS, LWR, ESM, and electronic countermeasures (ECM) equipment. The nose features a new PNVS above a TADS, while an MMW search radar is mounted above the main rotor mast. Laser-powered directional infrared countermeasures (DIRCM) are installed on the wingtips. Additional defensive equipment includes chaff and flare dispensers on the cheek fairings and tail boom. A BeiDou antenna is mounted on the tail boom, while at least one prototype has been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. Z-21. via Chinese internet The Z-21 is expected to feature a 30mm chain gun beneath the forward fuselage. Each stub wing incorporates three weapon stations capable of carrying the newer KF-series long-range ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, and other emerging weapons. Compared with the Z-20, the Z-21 is expected to offer improved high-altitude performance, greater armor protection, and a heavier payload, making it better suited to demanding attack missions. The Z-20 Family: China’s New Medium Helicopter Z-20 The Z-20 is China’s new medium-lift general-purpose helicopter, developed by the 602 Research Institute, Harbin, and Changhe since the late 1990s. The design is heavily influenced by the Sikorsky S-70 Black Hawk , examples of which China acquired for the PLA during the 1980s. However, the Z-20 incorporates a number of indigenous systems and is intended to replace the Mi-17 series in Army Aviation service. The helicopter features a five-blade main rotor, a glass cockpit, and armor protection around the cockpit. A PNVS is mounted beneath the chin, while RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the forward and rear fuselage. Additional equipment includes LWR sensors on both sides of the nose, SATCOM, ECM antennas on top of the fuselage, and a nose-mounted weather radar and terrain-following radar. A Z-20 during the 7th China Helicopter Exposition in Tianjin Municipality, China, in 2025. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images The Z-20 is powered by two WZ-10 turboshaft engines and can carry up to 13 fully equipped soldiers. An optional fuel tank can be installed in the cargo compartment to extend its range. Stub wings can be fitted to carry rocket launchers, gun pods, and external fuel tanks. The Z-20 first flew in 2013 and entered service with PLA Army Aviation by 2019. Several aircraft have been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. A SAR variant incorporates an EO turret and searchlight beneath the forward fuselage, together with a rescue hoist above the cabin door. Z-20K/KS/KT The Z-20 has also spawned a number of specialized variants for the PLAAF. The Z-20K, identified in 2022, is a transport helicopter intended for airborne assault units. The PLAAF operates the Z-20KS subvariant in the SAR role. This model features an EO turret and searchlight beneath the forward fuselage, while optional stub wings allow it to carry rocket launchers and gun pods. An improved assault variant, the Z-20KT, incorporates a larger SATCOM antenna on top of the tail boom. Its folding tail section indicates that the helicopter is designed to facilitate aerial transport, allowing rapid deployment over long distances. A Z-20K at the Shek Kong Barracks in Hong Kong, China, in 2026. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-20T The Z-20T is a specialized assault helicopter broadly comparable in concept to the MH-60L Direct Action Penetrator used by the U.S. Army. The helicopter features large stub wings capable of carrying KD-9 and KD-10 ATGMs, KF-9A ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, ECM pods, and external fuel tanks. LWR sensors have been relocated to the wingtips, while a TADS has replaced the weather radar in the nose. Additional armor plates provide increased protection for the crew and critical systems. Later examples have also been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. Air Cavalry: Footage shows Z-20T assault helicopters effectively boosting the tactical flexibility of the Chinese PLA Army’s heliborne troops during an air assault training exercise. #Helicopter #AirAssault #Z20T #Z10 #PLA #Army #ChinaMilitary #ChinaMilBugle pic.twitter.com/NcoMbsz9gP — China Military Bugle (@ChinaMilBugle) May 1, 2026 Z-20F The Z-20F is a shipborne ASW helicopter developed to provide the PLAN with a modern equivalent to the MH-60R Seahawk . It first flew in 2018. The helicopter incorporates folding rotor blades and a folding tail boom to facilitate shipboard storage. An emergency flotation system is fitted, while the rear landing gear has been relocated forward to the rear end of the fuselage. The redesigned nose features an EO/laser-ranging turret, with a surface-search radar antenna mounted beneath the chin. A SATCOM antenna is installed on top of the tail boom. Additional ESM antennas are distributed around the nose and rear fuselage. A 25-round sonobuoy launcher is mounted on the port side, while a dipping sonar and rescue hoist provide additional ASW and SAR capabilities. The Z-20F can carry up to four YJ-9 AShMs beneath its stub wings, alongside lightweight ASW torpedoes on rear fuselage pylons. The helicopter is expected to replace the older Z-9C on Type 054 frigates and Type 052 and Type 055 destroyers. It has also been observed aboard the aircraft carrier Fujian and Type 075 amphibious assault ships. A Z-20F on the deck of the carrier Fujian carrying a pair of YJ-9 anti-ship missiles under one stub wing. via Chinese internet Z-20J The Z-20J is a shipborne transport and assault variant designed for the PLAN. Its stub wings can carry up to eight KD-9 ATGMs or four YJ-9 AShMs, as well as rocket launchers, external fuel tanks, and gun pods. MAWS sensors are installed on both sides of the chin and along the rear fuselage, providing additional protection during operations over water. The Z-20J expands the range of missions that can be performed from Chinese surface combatants and amphibious assault ships, complementing the ASW-focused Z-20F. Z-20J. via Chinese internet Conclusion Despite often being overshadowed by the PLA’s latest combat aircraft , missiles , and other high-profile weapons programs, helicopters remain an indispensable part of China’s military modernization. They provide critical capabilities, from moving troops and supplies across difficult terrain to supporting amphibious operations, special forces, search and rescue, and naval warfare. More importantly, the steady development of indigenous helicopter designs reflects China’s determination to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and build a more capable, self-sufficient rotary-wing force. These aircraft may attract less attention than the PLA’s newest fighters, but their growing sophistication and expanding roles make them an essential part of the force’s ability to operate across a wide range of contingencies. title: 黃之鋒勾結境外勢力危害國安罪成 判入獄10年 法官指「罪行重大」

content: 追光者報道 因民主派初選47人案服刑的前香港眾志秘書長黃之鋒，早前承認一項「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全」罪，案件今（5日）在高等法院判刑，黃之鋒被判入獄10年。黃自2020年11月起因其他案件一直還押，在獄中已接近6年。法官指在評估罪行的嚴重程度，須整體考慮案情，法庭認為本案屬「罪行重大」。 黃之鋒今日步入法庭時，戴着黑框眼鏡，手拿筆記和一本書，在犯人欄坐下後向旁聽的公眾人士點頭，並做出OK的手勢。法官強調，黃之鋒並非因《國安法》生效前的行為或政治理念而被判刑，在法例生效後黃之鋒及羅冠聰等人繼續共同履行協議，黃留港繼續支持「國際線」，包括在社交平台分享羅的帖文。而法例生效前的行為和活動，則構成罪行的背景。 法庭認為本案局「罪行重大」，案發時社會動盪、法治面臨重大風險，指黃之鋒和羅冠聰呼籲制裁，加劇港府及中國當時的處境。報道指黃之鋒聽到後表情平靜，繼續低頭抄寫筆記。 黃之鋒被控於2020年7月1日至11月23日間，在香港與羅冠聰及其他身分不詳的人串謀請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施對香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國制裁、封鎖或者採取其他敵對行動。並且在《國安法》實施前後，二人及香港眾志多次呼籲外國對香港特區及中國採取制裁或敵對措施，包括訪問外國、會見政界人士、參與聽證會、發起聯署，以及在社交媒體和外國媒體上倡議「國際線」。 案情又指多國針對中國及香港特區政府採取措施，包括美國通過《香港自治法案》、制裁政府官員及暫停部分協議，英國、德國、法國亦暫停與香港的引渡逃犯協議。 黃之鋒在2025年6月6日因本案被捕，當時他正在獄中就「47人案」而服刑。上月剛踏入30歲的黃之鋒自2020年11月起一直被囚。他於「47人案」被判入獄4年8個月，原預計明年1月出獄，而今次刑期為10年，其中2個月會與「47人案」同期執行，料最快2036年11月才能刑滿出獄。 國際人權組織持續關注案件 黃之鋒被控勾結境外勢力罪一直受到國際人權組織關注，有組織指出港府的指控在2020年取消他的參選資格時，同時指他勾結外國勢力，顯示其後針對他的《國安法》指控早在提出控罪前已決定。港府亦將對法治和人權狀況的監察，定性為對國家主權的攻擊。控方又將黃之鋒在國際的倡議活動，描述為促請外國實施制裁，卻刻意忽略他曾大力聲援2020年8月遭中國海警截獲及拘留的12名抗爭者，意圖抹去其人權背景。 而針對被捕和控罪時間點，案中所涉及的行為可追溯至2020年，但黃直至2025年6月才因相關案件被捕。當時他已就「初選47人案」服了大部分刑期。因此，人權組織認為當局在他預計於明年1月獲釋前夕，對他提出新的檢控。 香港眾志於2016年成立，而黃之鋒及羅冠聰分別曾任秘書長及創黨主席，至2020年6月30日該組織解散，羅冠聰其後離港。案情指黃之鋒在《國安法》生效前串謀勾結外國勢力的行為，黃之鋒、羅冠聰及香港眾志於2016年參與推動美國的《香港人權與民主法案》；2019年出席「美國國會及行政當局中國委員會」聽證會，提及該年社會運動狀況，要求重新審視美國給予香港的特殊待遇地位；同年與德國時任外交部長馬斯見面，促請德國延遲與中國和香港的貿易、停止向香港警察售武。 而在《國安法》生效後的行為包括黃在眾志解散後，在Facebook稱不會刪除舊文、不會放棄其政治立場和意見，亦不會放棄打「國際線」。而其身在海外的戰友，例如羅冠聰將繼續打「國際線」、代替因《國安法》而未能在港提出的主張，認為香港需要有人留守，在本地繼續抗爭、爭取國際社會和外媒關注。

title: North Korean Leader Inspects New Warship Under Construction at Nampho Shipyard
zh_title: 朝鲜领导人视察南浦造船厂正在建造的新军舰

content:
朝鲜领导人金正恩于 2026 年 11 月 2 日在南浦造船厂视察新军舰。官方媒体 朝鲜中央通讯社照片 据官方媒体周三报道，朝鲜领导人金正恩周一在访问朝鲜南浦造船厂期间，视察了一艘比该国 5000 吨级驱逐舰更大的新军舰的建造情况。这艘正在建造的军舰据信是一艘万吨级巡洋舰。官方媒体朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）发布的一张图片显示，金正恩和朝鲜官员在南浦造船厂的一艘船体前。所示的船体明显大于现役的两艘 5000 吨级崔贤级驱逐舰，后者是朝鲜目前最大的水面战舰。朝中社报道称：“金正恩同志看着正在建造的船只，对其庞大而雄伟的外观表示非常满意，这与去年建造的驱逐舰无法比拟。” 6 月 23 日，朝鲜领导人在 5000 吨级驱逐舰 Choe Hyon（51）的入役仪式上谈到了 10000 吨级巡洋舰。金正恩当时表示，朝鲜将“陆续”下水万吨级巡洋舰。朝鲜使用“战略”一词来描述核武器能力。据官方媒体朝中社 (KCNA) 报道，作为崔贤作战效率测试的一部分，2026 年 4 月 12 日发射了两枚战略巡航导弹和三枚反舰导弹。
朝中社照片 朝鲜尚未公布有关计划中的万吨级巡洋舰的细节。根据朝鲜2026-30年海军建设计划，该国将寻求每年建造两艘水面舰艇。与此同时，朝鲜计划建造护航舰艇和特种用途舰艇，并开发水下武器系统。金正恩在之前的讲话中表示，另外两艘崔贤级驱逐舰正在建造中，第三艘驱逐舰计划在朝鲜劳动党10月10日建党纪念日期间下水。朝鲜尚未就第三艘舰的下水发表任何公告。据朝中社报道，朝鲜领导人参观了南浦造船厂设施并发表讲话，他表示，加强朝鲜水面和水下海军部队的战斗力对于捍卫国家主权至关重要。他还表示，建设强大的海军力量，必须有先进、技术含量高的造船基地。金正恩指示造船厂在生产流程的各个环节实现自动化，增建水面船坞，形成同步造修船的能力，并纠正造船厂建筑布局中的不合理之处。他还呼吁造船厂招募更多人员进行船舶设计和建造。
朝鲜导弹管理局于 2026 年 11 月 4 日试射了一枚新设计的先进防空地对空导弹。官方媒体朝中社照片朝鲜最近进行了一系列武器试验，其中包括周六在战术弹道导弹上安装集束弹药弹头。朝中社在第二天的一份报告中称，弹道导弹系统研究所和导弹管理局弹头研究所宣布确认，标准2型集束炸弹弹头能够摧毁12-13公顷的目标区域。 “我们按照规定将集束炸弹弹头分为四类

【原文 English Original】
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspects new warship Nov. 2, 2026, at Nampho Shipyard. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the ongoing construction of a new warship that is larger than the country’s 5,000-ton destroyers on Monday during a visit to North Korea’s Nampho Shipyard, state media reported Wednesday. The under-construction warship is believed to be a 10,000-ton cruiser. An image released by state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) shows Kim and North Korean officials in front of a ship hull at Nampho Shipyard. The hull shown is significantly larger than the two 5,000-ton Choe Hyon-class destroyers in service, which are currently North Korea’s largest surface warships. “Looking at the vessel under construction, Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction with its massive and imposing appearance, which was incomparable to the destroyer built last year,” reads the KCNA report. The North Korean leader spoke on June 23 of a 10,000-ton cruiser during the commissioning ceremony of 5,000-ton destroyer Choe Hyon (51). Kim said at the time that North Korea will launch 10,000-ton cruisers “one after another.” North Korea uses the term “strategic” to describe nuclear weapons capability. Two strategic cruise missiles and three anti-ship missiles were fired April 12, 2026, as part of Choe Hyon’s operational efficiency tests, state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported. Korean Central News Agency photo North Korea has released few details on the planned 10,000-ton cruiser. According to North Korea’s naval construction plan for 2026-30, the country will seek to build two surface ships annually. At the same time, North Korea plans to build escort ships and special purpose ships and develop underwater weapon systems. In previous speeches, Kim said two more Choe Hyon-class destroyers were under construction and that the third ship was scheduled to be launched in conjunction with the Oct. 10 anniversary of the ruling Workers’ Party of Korea. North Korea has not made any announcements regarding the launch of the third ship. The North Korean leader toured the Nampho Shipyard facilities and made a speech where he said that it was critical to strengthen the combat power of North Korea’s surface and underwater naval forces to defend national sovereignty, KCNA reported. He also said that in order to build a powerful naval force, there must be an advanced and highly technological shipbuilding base. Kim instructed the shipyard to implement automation in all elements of the production processes, construct an additional surface dock to create the capacity for simultaneous shipbuilding and repair and correct unreasonable aspects in the shipyard’s building layout. He also called on the shipyard to recruit additional personnel for ship design and construction. The North Korea Missile Administration test fired a newly-designed advanced air defense surface-to-air missile on Nov. 4, 2026. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea recently conducted a series of weapons tests, including a cluster munitions warhead on a tactical ballistic missile on Saturday. In a report the following day, KCNA said the Ballistic Missile System Institute and the Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration announced confirmation that the Standard Type 2 cluster-bomb warhead is capable of devastating a target area of 12-13 hectares. “We classify the cluster-bomb warheads into four categories according to special and standard purposes. Within this year we will enable units to select and use all those types according to operational aims and specific features of targets,” said the Director General of the Missile Administration in the report. Saturday’s test was followed by a test on Monday. The Missile Administration evaluated a strategic cruise missile’s cluster warhead and conducted a vertical strike flight characteristics test of the cruise missile. The Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration said it confirmed that the medium-sized cluster warhead mounted on the cruise missile can completely devastate a target area of 5-6 hectares, KCNA reported. The Cruise Missile System Institute of the Missile Administration said that the test perfected the capability to deliver a vertical strike against the target by improving the terminal maneuverability of the cruise missile, taking into consideration the natural and geographical characteristics of the targeted area. The state media did not report the locations of the tests on Saturday and Monday. North Korea conducted a firepower demonstration exercise on Nov. 4, 2026. State media Korea Central News Agency photo On Wednesday, the Missile Administration test fired a newly-designed advanced air defense surface-to-air missile, KCNA reported Thursday. The test confirmed the technical specifications and reliability of the new material used for the missile and intelligent multiple guidance mode of the missile, target identification and tracking capability of the air-defence missile system and its detection information processing device. KCNA also reported Thursday that North Korea conducted a firepower demonstration exercise on Wednesday. The test was carried out by a sub-unit under the Eastern District Long-Range Strategic Cruise Missile Unit, with the sub-unit mobilized for the training successfully executing a strike mission against a simulated airfield target using long-range strategic cruise missiles. KCNA imagery released shows the target being a runway with aircraft mock-ups. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff on Wednesday said North Korea fired multiple missiles into the Sea of Japan from the Sondok area. South Korea and the United States are conducting a detailed analysis of the exact specifications of the detected North Korean missiles. “Our military is monitoring the North’s various movements under a robust South Korea-U.S. combined defense posture, and maintains the capabilities and readiness to respond overwhelmingly to any provocations,” the JCS said. U.S. Pacific Command issued the following statement on Wednesday: “We are aware of the missile launches by the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea on Nov. 4 (KST) and are consulting closely with our allies and partners. Based on current assessments, this event does not pose an immediate threat to U.S. personnel or territory, or to our allies. The United States remains committed to the defense of the U.S. homeland and our allies in the region.”

title: Hong Kong: Cruel Joshua Wong sentence a grim reminder of city’s disdain for human rights
zh_title: 香港：残酷的黄之锋判决严酷地提醒人们该城市对人权的蔑视
summary: 在回应香港活动人士黄之锋因“勾结外国势力”而被判处 10 年徒刑时，国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“香港当局对黄之锋的迫害仍在继续，最新的国家安全定罪是残酷的——也许是故意的——就在他根据之前的定罪获得释放的几个月前。”黄之锋向权力讲真话的勇气值得赞扬，但在香港，让他成为一个罪犯。今天的这句话再次严峻地提醒我们
content:
在回应香港活动人士黄之锋因“勾结外国势力”而被判处 10 年徒刑时，国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“香港当局对黄之锋的迫害仍在继续，最新的国家安全定罪是残酷的——也许是故意的——就在他根据之前的定罪获得释放的几个月前。”黄之锋向权力讲真话的勇气值得赞扬，但在香港，让他成为一个罪犯。今天的判决再次严峻地提醒人们，香港的国家安全法如何成为惩罚异议的工具，而不是真正保护国家安全的工具。 “国际社会不应接受继续将合法活动定罪为香港的新常态。各国政府必须继续施压，要求保护人权并释放那些仅仅因为行使权利而被监禁的人。国际特赦组织再次呼吁香港当局推翻黄之锋的国家安全定罪，并废除所有违反香港国际人权义务的立法。”背景 黄之锋今天根据北京实施的香港国家安全法（NSL）承认串谋外国势力罪名，被判处 10 年监禁。
根据第二次国家安全定罪，黄被指控在 2020 年 7 月至 2020 年 11 月期间与自我流亡的活动人士罗冠聪和“其他不明人士”合谋，要求外国或组织对香港或中国实施制裁、封锁或从事其他敌对活动。这位著名活动人士于 2024 年被判处四年零八个月的徒刑，这是《国家安全法》迄今为止最大规模的起诉，罪名是“串谋颠覆国家政权”。他是因参加 2020 年非官方“初选”而被监禁的 45 名反对派人士之一，联合国专家认为这些指控与受国际人权法保护的活动有关。此前的判决预计于 2027 年 1 月结束。自 2020 年以来，香港的人权状况急剧恶化，有 300 多人因违反《国家安全法》或殖民时代的“煽动叛乱”法而被捕。此外，地方当局于2024年推出的所谓“23条”立法进一步加深了镇压，压制了该市的反对声音。 《香港：残酷的黄之锋的判决，残酷地提醒人们香港对人权的蔑视》一文首先出现在国际特赦组织上。

【原文 English Original】
Responding to the 10-year sentence handed to Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong for “colluding with foreign forces”, Amnesty International’s Deputy Regional Director Sarah Brooks said: “The Hong Kong authorities’ persecution of Joshua Wong continues with this latest national security conviction, which cruelly – and perhaps deliberately – comes mere months before he would have been eligible for release under his previous conviction. “Joshua Wong’s bravery in speaking truth to power should be commended, but instead in Hong Kong it makes him a criminal. Today’s sentence is another grim reminder of how Hong Kong’s National Security Law has become a tool to punish dissent rather than to genuinely protect national security. “The international community should not accept the continued criminalization of legitimate activism as the new normal in Hong Kong. Governments must continue to press for the protection of human rights and the release of those imprisoned solely for exercising their rights. “Amnesty International reiterates its call on the Hong Kong authorities to overturn Joshua Wong’s national security convictions and to repeal all legislation that violates Hong Kong’s international human rights obligations.” Background Joshua Wong was today sentenced to 10 years in prison after pleading guilty to conspiring to collude with foreign forces under Hong Kong’s Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL). Under his second national security conviction, Wong was accused of conspiring with self-exiled activist Nathan Law and “other persons unknown” between July 2020 and November 2020 to request foreign countries or organizations to impose sanctions, blockades or engage in other hostile activities against Hong Kong or China. The prominent activist had been sentenced in 2024, in the largest mass prosecution under the NSL to date, to four years and eight months for “conspiracy to commit subversion”. He was one of 45 opposition figures jailed due to their participation in unofficial “primaries” in 2020, on charges which UN experts considered to relate to activities protected under international human rights law. This previous sentence is scheduled to end in January 2027. Hong Kong’s human rights situation has deteriorated dramatically since 2020, with more than 300 people arrested for violating the NSL or a colonial-era “sedition” law. In addition, the so-called Article 23 legislation introduced by the local authorities in 2024 has further deepened repression and silenced opposition voices in the city. The post Hong Kong: Cruel Joshua Wong sentence a grim reminder of city’s disdain for human rights appeared first on Amnesty International .

title: 台湾：支持美光工人罢工
source: 中国劳工论坛 China Worker
summary: 这场斗争也是全体工人的斗争 陈延年 国际社会主义道路（ISA）台湾 10月7日，台湾美光晶圆科技企业工会（桃园工会）正式发布罢工投票结果。在全体会员高达89.1%的高参与率下，工会以高达99.1%的压倒性同意率正式取得合法罢工权。这不仅是美光建厂以来的首次，更是台湾半导体与高科技产业史上的首例合法罢工授权事件，并已正式宣布于10月22日（周四）发动为期一天的首波实际罢工行动，以声援会员人数已增至11,000人（覆蓋率近90%）的台中工会。 美光正如许多跨国资本，只是与其他科技
content: 这场斗争也是全体工人的斗争 陈延年 国际社会主义道路（ISA）台湾 10月7日，台湾美光晶圆科技企业工会（桃园工会）正式发布罢工投票结果。在全体会员高达89.1%的高参与率下，工会以高达99.1%的压倒性同意率正式取得合法罢工权。这不仅是美光建厂以来的首次，更是台湾半导体与高科技产业史上的首例合法罢工授权事件，并已正式宣布于10月22日（周四）发动为期一天的首波实际罢工行动，以声援会员人数已增至11,000人（覆蓋率近90%）的台中工会。 美光正如许多跨国资本，只是与其他科技巨头比赛谁能从劳工身上榨取最多血汗。当前会发起罢工不是没有原因的。随着生成式AI爆发，美光在高频宽记忆体（HBM）与高阶DRAM等领域赚取了暴利，最新2026会计年度（FY2026）财报显示全年营收冲上1,332亿美元历史纪录，且2027年全年HBM高阶产能早已被客户预订一空。 基层劳工被压榨 然而，2023年记忆体寒冬期间，台湾厂区即便仍有获利，基层劳工却依然遭到美光总公司要求齐头式裁员10%并全面冻结奖金。如今面对公司的空前荣景，底薪与分红却被刻意压制。资方将高阶主管与基层员工的薪酬差距拉大到令人发指的地步：2025年美光全年净利暴增逾10倍达85亿美元，但黑箱的IPP绩效奖金制度却仅给出93.9%的达成率系数（「勿忘93.9」），台湾员工实际领取的绩效奖金仅约2.6个月薪资，而执行长的年度现金绩效奖励却高达32.4个月！ 在2025年限制型股票奖励（RSA）分配上，全球员工平均仅获约207股，执行长却得83,015股，差距高达400倍（2023年亏损裁员期间差距更达570倍）！而台湾员工在限制型股票单位（RSU）的覆蓋率过往更仅有约40%，远低于美国厂区的近100%。劳工多年付出的心血遭到资方高层无情地窃取。 美光的南韩竞争对手如三星电子与SK海力士，在面临强大工会罢工威胁后，皆已将年度营业利益的10.5%至12%（三星）与10%（SK海力士）明确化作为分润基础。反观台湾美光，资方却拒绝建立透明的「营业利益15%常态化按季分润制」，反而在9月11日未经协商片面宣布每人100万新台币的「一次性感谢金」，并以基层作业员约3万元的极低底薪为分母，包装出「整体薪酬最高68个月」的公关话术（月薪6万元者实领折算仅约25.45个月），实质新增奖酬仅占公司营业利益约4.4%，企图以此收买基层、瓦解罢工动能。 资方之所以敢如此傲慢，实际上是因为台湾长期缺乏足以迫使科技资本家低头的强大工会运动。台湾美光约15,000名员工仅占全球逾6万名人力约四分之一，却贡献了全球高达50%～60%以上的DRAM与先进记忆体产能。这一切丰厚利润与晶圆产出，明明都是工人血汗劳动与日夜轮班的结晶，如今管理层却向华尔街承诺在扣除资本支出后，将100%超额自由现金流全数用于扩大库藏股回购以回馈股东与推升股价，沦为华尔街与高层予取予求的禁脔。 「摸头妥协」 资方在先前的劳资协商中毫无诚意，多次将决策推托给10月8日至9日召开的美国总公司董事会；然而董事会结束已超过10天，资方仍未针对分润金额与制度提出任何具体对案，仅以「48周年餐食补助」与缺货的「PayEasy礼品」敷衍塞责。10月15日美光台中先进封装测试二厂（AATT2）启用时，美光全球营运长甚至完全避谈罢工争议。 然而，10月21日台湾美光与台中工会突袭发布联合声明，宣布双方已正式签署劳资协议，并撤回原订22日的调解程序。美光所谓的2027会计年度新薪酬制度，不仅将季度利润奖金强制拆分为「50%现金、50%须锁闭一年归属的股票」，更在奖金池计算中埋下陷阱：规定每季必须「先扣除／预留下一季资本支出所需资金」后，才计算员工利润奖金，且未透明公开获利提拨比例公式。这根本是把公司疯狂扩厂的财务压力，直接转嫁到员工的奖金池。当基层奖金被压缩的同时，美国高层和华尔街股东却靠着公司买回库藏股、拉抬股价，继续爽领巨额利润！而原先工会要求的今年度一次性大额现金补偿与四大诉求则全数落空。 这起未经民主程序、未公开协议文本、更未经会员大会投票表决的「摸头妥协」，引爆台中工会内部1.1万名基层会员的愤慨。基层劳工痛批：「四大诉求一个都没有达到怎么会妥协？成员对内容完全不知情，也没有带回来民主投票！」面对干部以「明天开奖就知道为什么够了」敷衍，会员已发起线上紧急连署，要求撤销原签约授权、完整公开最终文本，并依《工会法》门槛要求召开临时会员大会重新审议。 绝不接受背叛 更有甚者，台中工会干部在21日单独与资方签约撤回调解，不仅背弃了此前与桃园工会「双厂同进退、共同列席谈判」的盟约，更让已握有罢工权、准备在22日发动一日警告性罢工以声援台中的桃园工会陷入孤立。而美光台湾将桃园与台中登记为两家独立公司法人的壁垒，让资方有空间分流谈判，又遭到少数干部在保密条款下「先斩后奏」地代表签约，这些都暴露出资方借由分化个别厂场工会、以不透明协议试图瓦解劳动阶级团结的惯用伎俩。这场突如其来的妥协风波，再次血淋淋地证明资本家绝不会自动施舍，而官僚化的密室协商更只会出卖工人的血汗成果。■ 国际社会主义道路主张： 支持台中美光基层会员行使民主权利，坚决拒绝保密黑箱！声援台中厂会员发起的连署行动，要求立即公开劳资协议最终文本，并召开临时会员大会进行实质审议与民主投票；反对少数干部在密室中代表超过一万名成员签署协议。 支持桃园工会的罢工抗争，两厂工人应拒绝被各个击破！针对资方刻意利用法人壁垒与各厂协商时间差进行的分化，我们呼吁桃园工会继续捍卫基层权益，同时支援台中工会会员打破黑箱；工人的权利必须靠集体动员与公开透明的争取，拒绝打了折扣的摸头方案。 建设民主决策、积极斗争的工会组织！各厂工会干部必须受到全体会员民主授权与罢免权的严格监督。同时保护罢工工人与工会干部不被资方秋后算帐，阻止资方在AI泡沫破裂时要工人承担苦果。 动员群众集会，桃园与台中两厂工人应共同讨论并投票制定运动的下一步。并协调跨企业的工人共同行动，串联台积电等半导体产业劳工，打破资方的工会禁令组织团结斗争，不被老板们各个击破，共同对抗台湾高科技业普遍长工时与分红不透明的剥削。 建设群众斗争，打破台湾现有反民主亲资方的工会组织门槛、政治罢工禁令与跨企业联合罢工限制。支持国际工人发起协调斗争，连结美光全球各厂区以及南韩三星、SK海力士等的跨国科技工人，反对资方任何企图分化、差别对待不同国籍劳工的手段。 這篇文章 台湾：支持美光工人罢工 最早出現於 中国劳工论坛 China Worker 。

title: Analysis: China’s quarterly CO2 falls 3% in largest drop since Covid
zh_title: 分析：中国季度二氧化碳排放量下降 3%，创新冠疫情以来最大降幅
summary: 由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief 根据官方数据和商业数据进行的新分析显示，2026 年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降 3%，而石油使用量则同比下降 3%。
content:
由于霍尔木兹危机继续打击石油需求，煤炭使用量也下降，2026年第三季度中国二氧化碳（CO2）排放量下降了3.1%。这篇客座文章作者：Lauri Myllyvirta，能源与清洁空气研究中心首席分析师 这是自 2022 年新冠疫情封锁以来最大的季度减排量，意味着中国的二氧化碳排放量今年迄今已估计下降了 0.5%。 Carbon Brief基于官方数据和商业数据的新分析显示，2026年第三季度煤炭使用量同比下降3%，而石油使用量下降4%。主要驱动因素是电力行业煤炭消费下降、交通运输油消费持续大幅下降以及煤化工增速放缓。中国二氧化碳排放量的大幅下降延续了自2024年3月开始至今已持续两年多的“持平或下降”趋势，如下图所示。本分析的先前迭代中列出的数据源。中国二氧化碳排放的前景取决于不断增长的能源需求、清洁能源增长和政府对GDP放缓的反应之间的平衡。下降驱动因素 2026 年第三季度二氧化碳排放量下降的主要驱动因素包括煤炭发电量下降 3.3%，原因是需求增长放缓以及“浪费”的风能和太阳能发电量下降。
太阳能、风能和核能发电量同比增长110太瓦时（TWh），是总电力需求增长量的两倍多。这相当于德国同期总发电量。尽管中国继续以接近创纪录的速度建设新的煤电产能，但煤电产量和二氧化碳排放量仍出现下降。这意味着燃煤电厂的平均运行时间下降速度甚至超过总发电量下降速度，从而侵蚀了它们的利润。与此同时，运输石油消耗继续大幅下降，2026年第三季度同比下降9%。电动汽车(EV)继续扩大市场份额，9月份创下了乘用车销量的67%和重型卡车销量的50%的纪录。电动汽车的用电量增长了 53%，远远快于道路上电动汽车的数量，这表明现有车队的使用量比燃油汽车的使用量有所增加。其他方面，煤化工行业增长在2026年第三季度继续放缓。该行业一直是排放增长的主要来源，但煤炭价格高企削弱了盈利能力，而较高的产出价格损害了下游需求。最后，随着建筑量收缩加速，水泥和钢铁生产的二氧化碳排放量在第三季度继续下降。

【原文 English Original】
China’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions fell by 3.1% in the third quarter of 2026, as the Hormuz crisis continued to hit oil demand and coal use also dropped. This guest post is by: Lauri Myllyvirta, lead analyst at the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air This was the largest quarterly reduction since the 2022 Covid lockdowns and means that China’s CO2 emissions have now fallen by an estimated 0.5% in the year to date. The new analysis for Carbon Brief, based on official figures and commercial data, shows that coal use fell by 3% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, while oil was down 4%. The main drivers were a fall in power-sector coal consumption, a continued sharp reduction in transport oil consumption and slowing growth in the coal-to-chemical industry. The sharp decline in China’s CO2 emissions extends a “ flat or falling ” trend that began in March 2024 and has now lasted more than two years, as shown in the figure below. Data sources as listed in previous iterations of this analysis. The outlook for China’s CO2 emissions depends on the balance between rising energy demand, clean-energy growth and the government response to a GDP slowdown . Decline drivers Key drivers of the fall in CO2 in the third quarter of 2026 included a 3.3% drop in coal-power generation, after demand growth slowed and the amount of “ wasted ” wind and solar fell. Power generation from solar, wind and nuclear increased by 110 terawatt hours (TWh) year-on-year, more than twice as much as the growth in total electricity demand. This added clean-power generation equal to Germany’s total power output in the same time period. The fall in coal-power output and CO2 emissions came despite the fact that China continues to build new coal-power capacity at near-record rates . This means that average running hours for coal plants are falling even faster than total generation, eroding their profits. Meanwhile, transport oil consumption continued to fall sharply, down 9% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026. Electric vehicles (EVs) continued to gain market share, hitting a record 67% of passenger car sales and 50% of heavy trucks in September. The amount of electricity used by EVs grew by 53%, much faster than the number of EVs on the road, showing increased usage of the existing fleet in preference to fuelled vehicles. Elsewhere, growth in the coal-to-chemical industry continued to slow down in the third quarter of 2026. The sector has been a key source of emissions growth, but high coal prices have weakened profitability and higher output prices hurt downstream demand . This makes it likely that the growth in clean-power generation will exceed total energy demand growth this year, maintaining the structural fall in fossil-fuel use. Looking ahead, this balance also relies on progress in removing barriers to new solar and wind power being added to the grid, which result in some clean electricity being “ wasted ”. The recent slowdown in energy demand growth is partly – but not fully – explained by exceptionally mild weather in the third quarter. Another key factor is weaker GDP growth . Since reported GDP growth remains within target , however, there is reduced pressure for further stimulus policies. The focus of the economic stimulus announced to date is “six networks”, which includes the power grid and the transportation network. These networks are highly relevant for energy and emissions – and they are already covered by policies that emphasise “ green ” and zero-carbon solutions. content: – 29岁的黄之锋6年刑满之际，中共香港当局又在他即将获释之际，再次判处他10年有期徒刑。這真可谓数千年来，史无前例的国家犯罪。甚至比重判老人黎智英更加令人发指。所以，在推特上，这是继美国中期选举特朗普惨败、乌克兰反侵略战争之后，最引人关注的新闻。 我因此重发8年前《支持和呼吁将諾貝爾和平獎授予香港雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰》的采访。我以此祝福狱中的黄之锋，保重身体，大家会为你继续争取的 ————————– 2018年2月5日，流亡作家廖亦武接受香港本土媒體《眾新聞》的採訪，谈到雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰獲諾貝爾和平獎的可能 – 問：您覺得這次提名，對香港人及香港的民主運動，代表了什麼意義呢？ 答：2014年的香港雨傘運動的某一天，柏林下着雨，我正在參加2009年諾貝爾文學獎得主赫塔-穆勒的新書發佈會。越洋電話中突然傳來消息，北京的地下詩人王藏，因撐傘聲援香港佔中而被捕入獄，接着又有十幾位藝術家入獄。我將這連鎖反應告訴赫塔-米勒，我們一塊拍了那張撐傘比中指、高喊「北京獨裁者滾蛋」的照片。在那一刻，我覺得時光倒流，我想起1989天安門大屠殺，也是和黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰相仿佛的一批年輕人，佔領了天安門廣場，要求對話和民主。卻發生戒嚴和屠殺，成千上萬人倒在血泊中。我在那夜寫作了《大屠殺》： 權力永遠會勝利。永遠會一代又一代傳下去。 自由也會死灰復燃。一代又一代死灰復燃。像黎明到來之前那一丁點光亮…… 2014年香港雨傘運動是1989年天安門學潮的歷史延續，特別是在獨裁中國利用全球資本主義，公然挑戰全人類普世價值的當口，雙學三子被美國國會議員們提名角逐諾貝爾和平獎的消息，就特別振奮人心。這證明西方有良知的人們，在高度關注香港人的抗爭。雖然武裝到牙齒的強權令手無寸鐵的香港人「節節敗退」，但德國詩人里爾克說：「挺住意味着一切。」年輕人會贏得時間。如果他們真得獎了，時間的天秤就會倒過來，世界會因此而改變。 問： 您覺得在劉曉波去世後，及對中國對香港步步進逼下，中國政府會如何看待這次和平獎提名？ 答：中國政府的看法不重要，只有想從中國政府那兒撈取好處的人，才覺得這樣一個寡廉鮮恥的政府的看法重要，比如藝術明星艾未未，為了自由出入中國，而在劉曉波之死和六四死亡人數上混淆視聽，與中國政府如出一轍。 法國著名作家和記者法拉奇在傳世之作《人》中寫道：「我認為人類尊嚴最美好的紀念碑是伯羅奔尼薩斯半島上的那個東西。它不是一座偶像，也不是一面旗幟，而是三個希臘字母：OXI。意思是『不』。」「為什麼還要忍受痛苦，為什麼要鬥爭，為什麼要冒從山上被狂風刮到井底與魚為伍的風險呢？因為這是作為一個男人，一個女人，總之是作為一個人而不是作為一隻綿羊而生存的唯一方法。」 問：觀察過去的諾貝爾和平獎，少有第一次提名便獲獎。您認為，未來香港獲獎的機會高嗎，會否獲得國際的支持？諾貝爾和平獎委員會應如何看待這次提名？ 答：觀察是沒用的。劉曉波得獎之際，我曾寫了一篇文章，摘錄如後：「劉曉波對探監的劉霞説：『這個獎是給所有八九六四亡靈的。』接著他哭起來。我沒有哭，可這句話像石頭，壓了我許多天。是的是的，在中國異見者看來，諾貝爾奬至高無上，只有近3000名死難者的代表，才有資格獲得。 「所以這些年，劉曉波和我等等的重大議題之一，是提名『天安門母親』的發起者丁子霖教授為諾貝爾獎候選人，我們寫過若干文章，公開聯名推薦至少五次以上。丁子霖的兒子在六四凌晨被槍殺，風聲鶴唳中，她作為遇難者家屬，第一個打破沉默，向國際社會指控劊子手政府。接著的20餘年，丁子霖夫婦一直被軟禁，但他們根據一星半點線索，經過若乾地下渠道，逐個尋訪，竟然串聯了180多位六四難屬，形成影響深遠的『天安門母親』群體。大夥兒互相激勵，蒐集屠殺證據，記錄真相，在海外出版成冊，並年復一年上書當局，追究罪責，令獨裁者坐臥不安。 「劉曉波對我説：丁子霖的工作令人想起1986年諾貝爾和平獎得主埃利‧威塞爾，後者的寫作主題是納粹滅絕猶太人的記憶。頒獎辭中，『把個人關注化作對所有暴力、仇恨和壓迫的普遍譴責』，也適用於丁子霖。」 我們多年的努力沒有結果。劉曉波自己希望丁子霖得獎，結果很意外，他坐牢、得獎、被謀殺，成為一個燈塔般的道義巨子。 作為過來人，我希望黃之鋒等人堅韌不拔，香港、他們的故鄉的人們，也應該鼓勵他們堅韌不拔。香港社會的民主抗爭在世界上影響愈大，他們愈有可能得獎。特別是在目前，獨裁中國處於四處挑釁的高危時期，西方正紛紛檢討和調整過去多年對中國的綏靖主义失誤。在重新匯聚的歷史潮流中，香港是一個抵抗的典範，所以黃之鋒他們得獎的可能性，與世界大勢密切相關。

content:
圖像加註文字，2024年6月台北國際電腦展（COMPUTEX）期間，黃仁勳（中）被拍到與黃樂（左）一同出席某社交場合。
輝達（NVIDIA，英偉達）行政總裁黃仁勳近期承認對妻子不忠並公開道歉。這起私人緋聞迅速演變為一宗牽動美國國家安全與全球AI產業的爆炸性事件。
事件經多家媒體曝光後，輝達股價明顯波動，焦點集中於一名被指涉入中國間諜活動的女子黃樂（Alice Huang Le）。美國總統特朗普週一（11月9日）表示，他已致電黃仁勳，對方否認知情，稱「完全不知道黃樂是間諜」。特朗普稱相信黃仁勳的說法，讚譽他是「正直的人」，並透露聯邦調查局（FBI）已介入調查，他認為黃仁勳最終應能脫身。
中國外交部則堅決否認相關指控，稱有關說法是「捕風捉影、污蔑抹黑」。
在AI晶片出口管制與美中科技競爭白熱化的背景下，這名女子成為各方追問的焦點：她究竟是誰？
此文包含Google YouTube提供的内容。由於這些内容會使用曲奇或小甜餅等科技，我們在加載任何内容前會尋求您的認可。 您可能在給予許可前希望閲讀Google YouTube曲奇政策和隱私政策。希望閲讀上述内容，請點擊“接受並繼續”。
被媒體稱為「中國間諜」的黃樂（Alice Huang）是中國公民，現年約42歲，湖南人，曾赴香港浸會大學攻讀碩士，其後取得香港永久居民資格。
據《紐約時報》與《金融時報》報導，她在2023年3月至11月間出任新加坡數據中心公司Megaspeed的董事總經理，後來自稱行政總裁。該公司由中國遊戲公司第七大道分拆而來，大量採購輝達GPU，並將運算能力出租給阿里巴巴等中國企業，因此引起美方對規避出口管制的調查。
港媒《香港01》在香港、新加坡及內地查冊發現，今年中黃樂又註冊了數間香港公司，同時是「南京領行科技」（T3出行）的董事。該公司今年向港交所遞交上市申請，但遭拒絕。
黃仁勳與黃樂最早被媒體公開捕捉到同框，是2024年6月台北國際電腦展後在酒吧飲酒的照片。2025年5月，兩人再度於台北三六食府餐敘同場，被拍到搭肩交談與親吻臉頰的畫面。美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）的調查報導則稱，黃樂自2017年起曾持中國護照進入美國十次。
Play video, "'He's suffering': Trump answers BBC question about Nvidia's Jensen Huang", 節目全長 0,56
《金融時報》引述美方消息來源稱，美國情報單位評估認為，黃樂與黃仁勳發展出超出商業往來的私人關係，並透過通訊保持接觸；情報單位透過「去匿名化」（unmasking）程序，確認通訊對象為黃仁勳本人。
一份由國務卿魯比奧（Marco Rubio）督導起草的機密備忘錄指稱，中國國家安全部曾招募黃樂，任務包括蒐集黃仁勳及美國AI晶片的相關情報，並可能影響輝達爭取向中國開放最先進晶片的遊說。
黃樂已於2025年10月前離開Megaspeed。輝達董事會已啟動獨立調查，強調目前尚無證據顯示公司機密或美國國家安全受到損害。
需要指出的是，黃樂的國安背景與情報任務目前仍屬美方指控，尚未經法院認定，其部分履歷，包括曾任湖南衛視及中國央視記者的說法，也未獲完整證實。《華爾街日報》報導，兩名今年稍早與黃樂有聯繫的人士稱，黃樂當時身在中國，目前下落不明。黃仁勳在致輝達員工的信中坦承「對妻子不忠」，但沒有直接點名黃樂，也未承認對方涉及間諜活動。
Play video, "輝達調查黃仁勳涉與中國間諜外遇，婚外情風波升溫至國安爭議", 節目全長 7,19
中國多年來被指透過多種方式，對美國官員、議員及海外異議人士進行滲透與監視。廣為人知的一例是方芳（Christine Fang）案：這名中國籍女子被指以社交活動與政治捐獻接近多位美國政客，涉嫌為中國政府蒐集情報。近期公開的FBI檔案顯示，前眾議員斯沃韋爾（Eric Swalwell）向調查人員承認曾與方芳有過親密關係，但調查最終未發現足以起訴兩人的證據。
今年則出現更具體的監視指控。2026年10月4日，FBI在洛杉磯國際機場逮捕34歲華裔房產經紀張婉瑩，她被控於去年監視台灣總統賴清德旅居美國之子的住所與車輛，並透過微信向中方聯絡人回報。她於11月出庭時拒不認罪，案件仍在審理中。台灣總統府譴責此為「典型跨國鎮壓的野蠻行徑」。
在紐約，曾任紐約州州長高級幕僚的華裔女子孫雯（Linda Sun），2024年與丈夫被控充當中國未登記代理人，涉及阻撓台灣官員與州政府接觸並接受中方利益，案件仍在司法程序中。
圖像加註文字，黃仁勳愛妻（左一）愛家的媒體形象遭遇嚴重挑戰，兩人在今年四月出現。
事件爆發後，中國並未全面屏蔽對黃仁勳的討論，相關話題甚至登上微博熱搜。中國外交部嚴詞否認黃樂是情報人員，前《環球時報》總編輯胡錫進則連發多文為黃仁勳叫屈，稱「這不是普通緋聞，這是政治」，指是美國民主黨與建制派藉機打擊黃仁勳、進而牽制特朗普的手段。
胡錫進自稱情報學出身，稱中國情報界「從不專門使用美人計」，「從不要求女情報人員透過上床達成任務目標」，懷疑黃樂根本不是中國間諜，兩人更可能是在商場認識後產生感情。
台灣學者則有不同解讀。淡江大學助理教授、中共研究學者洪耀南曾任前總統蔡英文的特別助理及核心幕僚，他在個人臉書專欄分析稱，黃仁勳捲入間諜疑雲，恰恰說明「北京一直知道，該把人放在誰的身邊」。他認為，北京的路數不是倚賴訓練有素的職業間諜，而是動員擁有真實身分的留學生、藝人與商人，目標則從軍官、外交官一路擴大到政壇新秀與科技業領袖。
「黃樂若真是國安部的人，正好落在這兩條線的交點，」他說。
洪耀南又指出，台灣社會習慣把黃仁勳當成「台灣之光」，但現在該問的是：「半導體既然是國家安全的骨幹，企業領袖的人際往來與利益衝突就不能只算公司家務事：政府要過問，董事會要把關，媒體也不該只負責追星。」
無論真相如何，北京的反應本身已透露其外宣策略：一方面透過官方否認與胡錫進等有影響力的聲音，將事件框定為「美國內部政治鬥爭」與「誣陷」，避免陷入「中國間諜滲透成功」的敘事。另一方面，相較於其他敏感事件的嚴格審查，此次相對開放的輿論處理，顯示北京在AI與晶片領域或許仍希望維持與特朗普政府的對話空間，並把一宗私人緋聞轉化為地緣政治攻防的工具。

2026 年 11 月 10 日，在与可能弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 相关的程序性投票之前，一名孤独的抗议者在美国国会大厦前举着“弹劾赫格斯”的牌子。（乔纳森·恩斯特/路透社）
众议院周二晚上投票决定将针对国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的弹劾条款提交给众议院司法委员会，从而有效地驳回了罢免赫格塞斯内阁职务的努力。
众议院共和党人以 211 比 204 票否决了肯塔基州共和党众议员托马斯·马西提出的弹劾赫格斯塞斯的提议。马西指控赫格赛斯在处理加勒比和太平洋地区的缉毒行动和法外处决过程中疏忽大意，并进行了非法活动； 2月份未经国会批准袭击伊朗；对亚利桑那州民主党参议员马克·凯利（Mark Kelly）进行报复，因为这位资深议员根据非法命令向部队发表了言论；在未宣战的情况下俘获委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗；及其他操作。
文章称，“国防部长彼得·赫格斯的这种行为表明，如果允许他继续留任，他将仍然对宪法构成威胁，而且他的行为方式与他的职责和法治严重不相容。”
将这些条款发送给司法委员会的决定可能会将投票推迟到一月份，届时民主党将在国会占据多数席位。
截至周四，民主党在众议院赢得了 256 个席位，共和党赢得了 168 个席位，而在参议院，民主党至少拥有 54 个席位，而共和党则拥有 44 个席位。
如果众议院明年投票弹劾赫格塞斯，则任何条款都需要三分之二多数才能迫使赫格塞斯下台。
在周二早上投票前举行的一次罕见的新闻发布会上，赫格斯称马西为“心怀不满和失败的国会议员”，试图“损害这位总统、这个国家，以及最不负责任的捍卫国家的战士”。
赫格塞斯指出，唐纳德·特朗普总统曾两次被弹劾，但并未被定罪，他表示，他将“一周中的每一天都接管该公司”。
“这些决议是一场闹剧。他们嘲笑宪法。他们攻击指挥系统，并将执行合法命令的战士定为犯罪，”赫格塞斯说。
特朗普表示，他将支持国防部长，周一称他“做得非常好”。
如果这一努力成功，这将标志着美国国防部长的第二次弹劾和内阁成员的第三次弹劾。 2024 年，国土安全部部长亚历杭德罗·马约卡斯因总统乔·拜登在美墨边境的移民政策而被弹劾。参议院在审判前投票驳回了这些指控。
1876 年，战争部长威廉·贝尔纳普 (William Belknap) 在辞职后不久就因腐败指控而遭到弹劾。后来他在参议院被无罪释放。
退伍军人倡导非营利组织 Common Defense 于 10 月发布的一项调查发现，军人及其家属对他们认为的武装部队政治化感到不安。

House Republicans sidestep effort to impeach Hegseth

A lone protester holds an “Impeach Hegseth” sign on the grounds of the U.S. Capitol ahead of a procedural vote related to the potential impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Nov. 10, 2026. (Jonathan Ernst/Reuters)
The House voted Tuesday evening to send the proposed impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to the House Judiciary Committee, effectively quashing an effort to oust Hegseth from his cabinet post.
In a 211 to 204 vote, House Republicans sidestepped an effort proposed by Republican Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky to impeach Hegseth. Massie charged that Hegseth was negligent and conducted illegal activity in his handling of counternarcotics operations and extrajudicial killings in the Caribbean and Pacific; attacking Iran in February without congressional approval; retaliating against Sen. Mark Kelly, D-Ariz., for the veteran lawmaker’s statements to troops on illegal orders; capturing Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro without a declaration of war; and other operations.
“Secretary of Defense Peter Hegseth, by such conduct, has demonstrated that he will remain a threat to the Constitution if allowed to remain in office, and has acted in a manner grossly incompatible with his duties and the rule of law,” the articles stated.
The decision to send the articles to the Judiciary Committee likely delays the vote until January, when Democrats take over the majority in Congress.
As of Thursday, Democrats won 256 seats in the House to the Republicans’ 168, while in the Senate, Democrats have at least 54 seats to 44 Republican seats.
If the House votes to impeach Hegseth next year, a two-thirds majority would be needed on any of the articles to force Hegseth out of office.
In a rare news conference Tuesday morning before the vote, Hegseth called Massie a “disgruntled and defeated congressman” seeking to “do damage to this president, this country, and most irresponsibly, the warriors who defend it.”
Noting that President Donald Trump was impeached twice but not convicted, Hegseth said he would “take that company every day of the week.”
“These resolutions are a farce. They mock the Constitution. They attack the chain of command, and they criminalize the warfighters who execute lawful orders,” Hegseth said.
Trump has said he would stand by his defense secretary, saying Monday that he’s “done a very good job.”
If the effort had succeeded, it would have marked the second impeachment of a U.S. defense secretary and third of a cabinet member. In 2024, Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas was impeached over President Joe Biden’s immigration policies at the U.S.-Mexico border. The Senate voted to dismiss the charges before it went to trial.
Secretary of War William Belknap was impeached in 1876 on corruption charges shortly after he resigned. He was later acquitted in the Senate.
A survey released in October by the military-veterans advocacy non-profit Common Defense found that troops and family members are uncomfortable with what they see as the politicization of the armed forces.
According to the survey, conducted by Change Research, 54% of active-duty personnel surveyed disapproved of Hegseth, while 64% of military family members disapproved.
A majority of the group of 731 active-duty troops, veterans and military family members also believe decisions within the department were being made for political gain, and 53% of active-duty personnel said the politicization was making them want to leave the military sooner than anticipated.
Nearly half the active-duty personnel also said they oppose Operation Epic Fury, the United States’ operation against Iran.
Patricia Kime is a senior writer covering military and veterans health care, medicine and personnel issues.

content:
黄仁勋事件引发台湾安全担忧海峡时报
黄仁勋与中国间谍事件引发台湾安全担忧
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
2024 年 6 月，Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋与一位名叫 Alice Huang 的女士在台北的一家酒吧。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 11 日晚上 10:00
更新于 2026 年 11 月 11 日 11:29
11月8日，黄仁勋承认了恋情，但没有透露对方的名字。这一丑闻震惊了台湾，他在台湾像明星一样受到崇拜。
台湾方面称，与他有联系的女子黄爱丽(Alice Huang)持香港护照入境。她的许可证被吊销，官员正在审查移民检查。
此案引发了更广泛的安全担忧，因为全球 90% 以上的最先进半导体都是台湾生产的。英伟达已发起调查，黄仁勋在中国的芯片销售活动现在面临更多审查。
台北 — 2025 年 5 月，在台北的一家餐厅里，身着粉色衣服的涉嫌中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 倾身在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的脸颊上轻吻了一下。这一亲密行为被台湾媒体隔着玻璃捕捉到，当时他们在商务晚宴后在餐厅外等待采访他。
一年前，即 2024 年 6 月，这对夫妇被拍到与其他科技公司的高管并排坐在台北一家酒吧喝威士忌。
已婚并育有两个孩子的黄仁勋于 11 月 8 日承认有外遇，但他没有透露第三方的名字，现在这些照片和其他照片在网上疯传。
在台南出生的黄被视为摇滚明星一样受人尊敬的台湾，他背叛家人、甚至可能被中国间谍欺骗的消息被曝光，这是一个双重打击。
台湾人质疑黄爱丽是如何进入台湾的，因为大陆人必须申请特别许可才能进入台湾。
台湾移民署随后证实她使用的是香港护照。一般来说，香港护照持有者申请进入台湾的许可比较容易，而持有中国大陆护照的人则面临更严格的审查程序。
内政部长刘世芳11月11日表示，黄丽娟的许可证现已被吊销，这意味着她不可能再次进入台湾。
她对国会议员说：“如果我们知道她是间谍，我们就不会让她进入台湾。”她誓言要审查移民程序。
刘还表示，台湾“国家安全部门正在积极调查此事”。
台湾当局严肃对待这一违规行为并不奇怪。
在台湾，芯片产业是拉动经济增长的引擎，预计2026年将突破11%。
虽然美国科技公司是人工智能应用所依赖的高端半导体的首席设计师，但制造这些半导体的却是少数台湾公司。
全球 90% 以上最先进的半导体都在台湾生产，而该市场由台积电主导——台积电是台湾最有价值的公司，也是 Nvidia 备受追捧的芯片的主要生产商。
但这不仅仅是损害台湾经济。
台湾半导体产业被一些人誉为“硅盾”。
中国声称台湾是自己的领土，并且没有放弃使用武力实现统一。
保护驱动人工智能的关键技术，从而保护美国和全球经济，是人们经常提到的原因之一，如果中国试图武力占领台湾，美国将向台湾提供援助。

Jensen Huang affair with alleged Chinese spy sparks security concerns in Taiwan
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with a woman identified as Alice Huang at a bar in Taipei in June 2024.
Published Nov 11, 2026, 10:00 PM
Updated Nov 11, 2026, 11:29 PM
Jensen Huang admitted an affair on Nov 8, but did not name the other person. The scandal has shocked Taiwan, where he is admired like a star.
Taiwan says the woman linked to him, Alice Huang, entered on a Hong Kong passport. Her permit was revoked, and officials are reviewing immigration checks.
The case has raised wider security fears because Taiwan makes over 90% of the world’s most advanced semiconductors. Nvidia has launched an investigation, and Huang’s China chip sales push now faces more scrutiny.
TAIPEI – Dressed in pink, alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang leaned in to give Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang a peck on his cheek at a restaurant in Taipei in May 2025. This intimate behaviour was captured through the glass by Taiwanese media, who were waiting outside to interview him after his business dinner.
A year earlier, in June 2024, the couple were photographed seated side by side drinking whisky at a Taipei bar with executives from other tech companies.
Now these and other images are going viral after Jensen Huang, who is married with two children, admitted to having an affair on Nov 8, though he did not name the third party.
In Taiwan, where Tainan-born Huang is revered like a rock star, the revelation that he betrayed his family and may even have been duped by a Chinese spy is a double whammy.
Taiwanese are questioning how Alice Huang even entered Taiwan, as mainland Chinese must apply for special permission to do so.
Taiwan’s National Immigration Agency has since confirmed that she used a Hong Kong passport. It is generally easier for Hong Kong passport holders to apply for permits to enter Taiwan, while those holding mainland Chinese passports face stricter vetting procedures.
Alice Huang has now had her permit revoked, meaning it is impossible for her to enter Taiwan again, Interior Minister Liu Shyh-fang said on Nov 11.
“If we had known she was a spy, we would not have let her enter Taiwan,” she told lawmakers in Parliament, vowing to review immigration procedures.
Liu also said Taiwan’s “national security units are actively investigating the matter”.
It is not surprising that the Taiwanese authorities are taking this breach seriously.
In Taiwan, the chip industry is the engine that is driving economic growth, projected to top 11% in 2026.
While US tech firms are the chief designers of the high-end semiconductors that AI applications rely on, a handful of Taiwanese companies make them.
Taiwan manufactures more than 90% of the world’s most advanced semiconductors, and that market is dominated by TSMC – Taiwan’s most valuable company and the primary producer of Nvidia’s highly sought-after chips.
But it is not just about hurting the Taiwanese economy.
Taiwan’s semiconductor industry is hailed by some as a “silicon shield”.
China claims Taiwan as its own territory and has not renounced the use of force for reunification.
Protecting the key technologies that drive AI, and therefore the US and global economy, is one oft-cited reason that the US will come to Taiwan’s aid if China ever tries to take Taiwan by force.
A threat to Taiwan’s status as the world’s paramount chipmaker is thus also a national security risk.
It has not yet been proven that Alice Huang was indeed a spy, but she did work at Singapore-based Megaspeed – a company under investigation for bypassing US export controls and possibly smuggling Nvidia chips to China.
Why the Jensen Huang affair spells trouble for South-east Asia
Nvidia scandal: Is Jensen Huang’s affair chipping away at the stock’s valuation?
China has dismissed the accusations of espionage as “groundless smears”.
Nvidia’s board of directors has launched an investigation to review the allegations and the company’s security measures, and Jensen Huang has been asked to attend a closed-door congressional briefing later in November.
On Nov 8, the Nvidia CEO wrote a note of apology to his staff, saying that he was “unfaithful” and had hurt his wife and children.
He assured colleagues that he is fully committed to Nvidia and will work to earn back their confidence. He also acknowledged the national security concerns that his affair raised.
“I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American,” he wrote.
With the revelation of the affair, Jensen Huang’s lobbying to sell Nvidia chips to China has come under renewed scrutiny.
He had earlier argued that US export controls would force China to become self-sufficient, and advocated selling chips to China so that it remains reliant on US technology. This line will be a much harder sell after this scandal.
What confidential information, if any, was Alice Huang privy to, and what influence did she have on Jensen Huang – a multi-billionaire pivotal to the AI industry, who also had the ear of US President Donald Trump?
It is hard to say as investigations are ongoing, but she has certainly punctured Jensen Huang’s aura.
Before the scandal broke, the Nvidia CEO, who moved to the US as a child, was mobbed at his jaunts to Taiwan’s night markets.
The tech mogul was cheekily known as “Huang Papa” (Daddy Huang) – the “godfather of AI”, responsible for the AI boom that is powering Taiwan’s tech stocks and lining the pockets of investors.
This wholesome image is now taking a hit as AI-generated memes on his infidelity go viral, while Taiwanese tabloids analyse his star sign (he is an Aquarius) and claim it was inevitable that he would cheat on his wife.
One article, for instance, quoted a well-known Taiwanese fortune-teller’s warning that Aquarius men must be vigilant against “honey traps”.
Even his signature black leather jackets have become the butt of jokes, with netizens saying that the jackets – a symbol of rebellion – were a “red flag” and that they “confessed before he did”.
It is hard to imagine how anything he says about AI now can carry the same weight as before.

How did someone as smart as Jensen Huang do something so foolish?

参议院银行委员会成员、北卡罗来纳州民主党人凯文·克莱默(Kevin Cramer)周三加倍呼吁黄先生辞职，民主党众议院监督小组的一位重要成员和众议院共和党人也纷纷提出要求。
“出于他自己的良心考虑，他应该辞职，”克莱默在回应黄与一名所谓的中国间谍有染的消息时告诉 CNBC，因为他共同创立的芯片制造商获得了美国政府的许可，可以向中国出售其技术。
黄领导的一家公司是人工智能热潮的主要受益者，他周日承认与一名女性有染，新闻媒体报道称，美国情报机构断定该女性是一名中国间谍。这一消息在华盛顿引起了轩然大波，立法者现在担心美国人工智能的主导地位可能面临风险。

克莱默发表此番言论之际，三位众议院议员要求黄在 11 月 18 日在委员会作证。

The Jensen Huang affair is turning Capitol Hill into a pressure cooker, with some lawmakers calling for the country's most important tech CEO to resign amid the scandal.
The situation may give Congress reason to advance a suite of bills in this year's National Defense Authorization Act to tighten export controls on advanced AI chips.

Members of Congress are calling on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to resign, and momentum is building to subpoena the executive, whose company is a leader in advanced artificial intelligence chips.
Senate banking committee member Kevin Cramer, R-N.D., doubled down Wednesday on his call for Huang to resign, and a key Democratic House oversight panel member and House Republican piled on.
"As a matter of his own conscience, he should resign," Cramer told CNBC, in response to revelations that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy as the chipmaker he co-founded was given permission from the U.S. government to sell its technology to China.
Huang, who leads a company that's been a chief beneficiary of the artificial intelligence boom, on Sunday admitted to having an affair with a woman whom news outlets have reported U.S. intelligence concluded was a Chinese spy. The revelation is sending shockwaves through Washington, with lawmakers now fearing that U.S. AI dominance could be at risk.

"What bothers me at the end of it is what we don't know is what she knows about him that can be utilized," Cramer said, referring to Alice Huang and Jensen Huang, who are not related. "This is a guy that's right now so vulnerable to extortion, blackmail. I just don't think, as a national security matter, we can run the risk."
Cramer's comments come on the deadline set by a trio of House lawmakers who requested Huang to testify before their committees on Nov. 18.
GOP Reps. Brian Mast, chair of the House Foreign Affairs Committee; John Moolenaar, chair of the Permanent Select Committee on China; and Rick Crawford, who leads the House intelligence panel, called for Huang to appear in a Nov. 4 letter. Congress members in the majority party also have subpoena power, should they choose to use it.
Mast and Moolenaar told reporters on Wednesday afternoon that they had not yet heard from Huang and that they were giving him until the end of the day to respond.
Asked whether the committees were considering subpoenaing Huang if he doesn't agree to appear, Mast said "yes."
Moolenaar, when asked the same question, said "all three committees have subpoena power, and I know all three committees have a very serious interest in getting to the bottom of this and having transparency around this."
"We are going to continue to pursue this," Moolenaar said.
The lawmakers are far from alone in their criticism, concern and outright shock over the affair. And the scrutiny is only expected to intensify with Democrats poised to take over both chambers of Congress in January. Huang has been close with President Donald Trump during the president's second term, traveling on Air Force One to China in May.
"Jensen Huang should resign from Nvidia," Rep. Suhas Subramanyam, D-Va., a member of the House Oversight Committee, told CNBC. Subramanyam is the top Democrat on the panel's Subcommittee on Military and Foreign Affairs.
"I didn't agree with his sentiment that there's no downside to exporting chips to China," he said. "But I never thought that he might be having an affair with a Chinese spy who was helping smuggle chips into China at an alarming rate."

Rep. Don Bacon, R-Neb., who is retiring from Congress after sometimes bucking Trump, also said the CEO should step down.
"From the little I know, yes." Bacon told CNBC in response to whether Huang should resign. "I mean, he allowed himself to get compromised by the Chinese government. Not good."
Huang was notably opposed to strict export controls on AI chips to China, which ruffled feathers with China hawks on Capitol Hill.
Democrats are widely expected to launch myriad investigations into the White House and industry when they assume control of both chambers of Congress in January. Nvidia is now likely to be at the center of those probes.
"There's two parts to this investigation that [need] to happen somewhere immediately," Subramanyam said. "One is what was going on with Nvidia and China, and two is why the administration did nothing about it even though they appeared to have known, and what the administration knew, and what influence the money from Nvidia and Jensen Huang had on this administration, essentially staying silent."
Rep. Jay Obernolte, R-Calif., co-chair of the House AI task force, said Tuesday he hopes that the Huang scandal can avoid becoming a distraction in talks about imposing export controls on advanced AI chips.
The situation may give Congress additional ammunition as it tries to pass a suite of bills in this year's National Defense Authorization Act to tighten export controls on advanced AI chips.
Congress has still not passed the annual defense bill, which is a top priority for lawmakers in the lame-duck session.
Those bills include the AI Overwatch Act, the MATCH Act and the Chip Security Act — all of which are aimed at preventing U.S. chip technology from falling into adversarial hands.
Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Jim Banks, R-Ind., in a statement following the revelation of Huang's affair, urged their colleagues to include the AI Overwatch Act. Warren, the incoming Senate banking committee chair, sponsored the bill in the Senate with Banks.
"Huang's confirmation of a relationship with a suspected spy for China's intelligence service makes these national security concerns even more urgent and raises important questions NVIDIA must answer about the extent to which these activities were related," the senators said. "It is time for Congress to take decisive action to pass key bills like the AI Overwatch Act in the NDAA that will cut off pathways through which China accesses advanced chips."
And Subramanyam warned that what Nvidia does now — and whether Huang remains atop the company — could affect its relationship with Washington and whether lawmakers crack down.
"If Nvidia finds out that he knew about what was going on and does nothing about it, then Nvidia is making a choice and us as regulators and as watchdogs need to defend the American people," he said.

中新社台北11月11日电 总统府周三表示，宏碁集团创始人兼名誉董事长施振荣被任命为台湾特使，出席在中国深圳举行的2026年亚太经合组织(APEC)领导人非正式会议。
总统府发言人郭雅慧表示，赖清德总统之所以选择石先生，是看中他的国际视野和行业专长，希望他能将台湾在经贸问题上的观点和经验带到峰会上。
据一份新闻稿称，郭指出，施代表台湾出席了 2007 年在悉尼举行的 APEC 峰会，熟悉人工智能、数字经济和技术创新等关键议程项目。
峰会将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日举行，随后将举行相关活动，包括将于 11 月 14 日至 18 日举行的高官总结会议和 APEC 工商领导人峰会。
郭援引APEC成员平等参与的共识，敦促北京履行书面保证，履行东道主职责，确保台湾代表团能够平等、有尊严和安全地参加所有会议。
郭说，台湾根据1991年的成员备忘录，继续以正式成员的平等地位参与APEC事务，符合APEC的既定惯例，没有提及所谓的“一个中国原则”。
她的言论旨在反驳北京方面重申的台湾参与应在“一个中国”原则下处理的主张。
施启程出发前，赖智和施启明将于周四上午10时30分在总统府举行的台湾APEC代表团记者招待会上发表讲话。
一位消息人士告诉中新社，赖智德为施正恩此行设定了三个目标：扩大台湾在国际舞台上的话语权，凸显台湾在全球半导体供应链中不可或缺的作用，并重申其对地区和平与繁荣的承诺。
由于北京的反对，台湾总统没有出席APEC领导人非正式会议，但任命了一名特使代表台湾。

Acer founder Stan Shih named Taiwan's envoy to 2026 APEC summit

Acer founder Stan Shih. CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 11 (CNA) Acer Group founder and Honorary Chairman Stan Shih (施振榮) has been named Taiwan's envoy to the 2026 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China, the Presidential Office said on Wednesday.
President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) chose Shih for his international perspective and industry expertise, hoping he would bring Taiwan's views and experience on economic and trade issues to the summit, Presidential Office spokesperson Karen Kuo (郭雅慧) said.
Kuo noted that Shih represented Taiwan at the 2007 APEC summit in Sydney and was familiar with key agenda items, including artificial intelligence, the digital economy, and technological innovation, according to a press release.
The summit will take place Nov. 18-19, preceded by related events, including the Concluding Senior Officials' Meeting and the APEC CEO Summit, which will be held during Nov. 14-18.
Citing APEC members' consensus on equal participation, Kuo urged Beijing to honor its written assurances and fulfill its duties as host by ensuring Taiwan's delegation could participate in all meetings on an equal, dignified, and secure basis.
Taiwan has continued to participate in APEC affairs on an equal footing as a full member under the 1991 membership memorandum, in line with established APEC practice and without reference to the so-called "one China principle," Kuo said.
Her remarks aimed to rebut Beijing's renewed assertion that Taiwan's participation should be handled under the "one China" principle.
Before Shih's departure, Lai and Shih will deliver remarks at a press conference for Taiwan's APEC delegation at the Presidential Office at 10:30 a.m. Thursday.
A source told CNA that Lai had set three goals for Shih's trip: to amplify Taiwan's voice on the international stage, highlight its indispensable role in the global semiconductor supply chain, and reaffirm its commitment to regional peace and prosperity.
Due to Beijing's objections, Taiwan's president does not attend the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, but appoints an envoy to represent Taiwan.
