未来德国联邦国防军将不再使用任何中国型号无人机进行训练图像来源: Juri Rescheto/DW
（德国之声中文网）德国国防部一名发言人周二（11月11日）向《明镜》周刊表示，未来德国联邦国防军“将不再使用任何中国型号无人机，现有系统也将由德国本土或欧洲产品取代”。
《明镜》周刊还披露，德国联邦国防军同时针对中国汽车实施了大范围限制措施，禁止其进入军营及其他军事设施。
报道称，最近几周，德国联邦国防军已下令停止使用此前采购的中国商用无人机，包括大疆创新(DJI)的产品。作出这一决定的原因是当局对安全问题存有重大疑虑。
德国军方担心，这些小型无人机可能会将军事演习数据、军营和训练场影像，甚至德国武器系统的相关信息，传送给中国情报机构。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
据《明镜》周刊报道，德国联邦国防军过去几年采购的中国小型无人机，许多是由地方指挥官通过简化程序直接购买。目前，这些设备正被尽快停用。
除了中国无人机外，德国联邦国防军也计划将中国汽车排除在军事设施之外。
报道称，德国军方内部目前流传着一份具体清单，涉及比亚迪（BYD）、吉利（Geely）、蔚来（NIO）等中国汽车制造商的多个车型。这些车辆今后将不得进入被划定为安全区域的军事设施。
拥有相关车辆的德国军人今后必须将汽车停放在营区外，再步行进入军营。
德国军方担忧，中国汽车所配备的传感器和摄像头可能记录敏感信息，并将相关数据传送给中国安全部门。

content:
宏碁的创办人施振荣将带领台湾代表团参加APEC会议图像来源: Sam Yeh/AFP
（德国之声中文网）台湾总统府周三（11月11日）表示，电脑制造商宏碁的创办人施振荣将作为领袖代表，出席下周在中国举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会。台湾同时要求北京履行书面保证，确保台湾能够平等参与。
亚太经合组织是台湾参加的少数几个国际组织之一。中国声称台湾是其领土。中国是今年的东道主，领导人峰会将于下周在南部城市深圳举行。
然而，台北与北京的关系极为紧张。中国拒绝与台湾总统赖清德对话，称他是“分裂分子”，中国军队每天都在台湾周边活动。
台湾总统府发言人郭雅慧在宣布施振荣的委任时声明说，台湾一直依照平等原则参与APEC的各项活动。
她强调，平等参与是APEC长期以来的惯例，与所谓的“一中原则”无关。一中原则指的是北京的立场，即台湾海峡两岸同属一个国家。
郭雅慧说，APEC各经济体过去已多次达成“全员平等参与”的共识。
她表示，台湾期盼中国履行主办经济体的责任及相关书面保证，确保台湾代表团能在平等、尊严及安全的前提下，参与本届APEC各项会议。
中国国台办当天早些时候表示，中国“一贯按照一个中国原则和APEC有关谅解备忘录的规定及惯例”处理台湾参会事宜。只要按照上述做法，台湾可以参会。
国台办发言人张晗在提及台湾时，使用的是中国官方用语“台湾地区”。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
台湾的民选政府不接受北京的主权主张，主张只有台湾人民才能决定自己的未来。两岸政府互不正式承认。
台湾的劳动部长和财政部长今年已经到中国出席过APEC会议，没有发生意外。
但台湾外交部长林佳龙上周表示，中国并未遵循惯例派特使亲自递交邀请函，而是以电子邮件寄送。林佳龙表示，台湾已经在第一时间向中国表达抗议。
为避免政治问题，台湾通常派前官员或企业高管担任APEC领袖代表。他们一般会利用这一机会，与美国、日本等友好国家代表团的高级成员交谈。
美国总统特朗普预计将在深圳与中国国家主席习近平举行今年的第三次会晤。
施振荣曾于2007年担任台湾领袖代表出席澳大利亚APEC峰会。

北京香山论坛多国代表对军用人工智能的潜在风险深表担忧。在美中两国准备举行高层会晤之际，武器自主化正急剧压缩决策时间，大国在此类技术管控上的分歧再度引发广泛讨论。

content:
涉嫌英伟达丑闻中心的中国间谍仍然神秘
涉嫌英伟达丑闻中心的中国间谍仍然神秘
- 2026 年 11 月 12 日 - 10:04 全部、世界
照片显示的是 2024 年 6 月 7 日在台湾台北发布的 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋（中右）与一名经路透社消息来源确认为 Alice Huang（中左）的女性。（路透社/共同社）
北京 - 卷入美国芯片巨头英伟达丑闻的一名涉嫌中国间谍的背景仍然是个谜，有报道称她曾在中国国营媒体和主要金融机构工作。
主要商业新闻媒体财新称，据称与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染的爱丽丝黄的中文名字是黄乐。她今年42岁左右，已婚。
她的一位熟人称，这位女士是湖南人，曾担任英伟达客户、新加坡数据中心提供商 Megaspeed International 的高级管理人员，她的“笑容给人留下了深刻的印象”。据报道，她很随和，也很健谈。
Alice Huang 在香港一所大学攻读媒体管理硕士学位。财新网称，毕业后，这名女子告诉她的朋友，她曾在湖南电视台和中央电视台担任记者，并补充说，没有找到任何文件证实她的就业记录。
西方媒体称，黄爱丽曾在汇丰银行私人银行部门和中国主要经纪公司中信证券工作。 2023年，她加入了Megaspeed，该公司涉嫌将先进的Nvidia芯片走私到中国。
周一，中国外交部发言人郭家琨对有关中国间谍的指控作出强烈反应，称该指控“毫无根据，旨在抹黑中国”。
中国执政党共产党下属的小报《环球时报》前主编胡锡进在社交媒体帖子中显然为黄爱丽辩护，该报在网上拥有约 2500 万粉丝。
“如果黄乐是一名间谍，她就是历史上最成功的间谍之一。如果她不是，那么她就遭受了女性所面临的最激烈、最复杂的错误指控之一。我倾向于相信后者才是真相，”胡说。
与此同时，台湾内政部长刘世芳周三表示，黄丽娟的签证已被撤销，阻止她重新进入台湾。
刘向议员表示，有关部门正在密切关注此案，并已确认该女子曾到过台湾，但目前在海外。
刘说：“如果知道她是间谍，很可能不会允许她入境。”他补充说，政府将对入境前筛查、访客监控和离境后违规处罚程序进行全面审查。

Alleged Chinese spy at center of Nvidia scandal remains mysterious
Alleged Chinese spy at center of Nvidia scandal remains mysterious
- Nov 12, 2026 - 10:04 All,World
Photo shows Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (center R) with a woman confirmed by a Reuters source to be Alice Huang (center L) in Taipei, Taiwan released on June 7, 2024. (REUTERS/Kyodo)
BEIJING - The background of an alleged Chinese spy at the center of a scandal engulfing U.S. chip giant Nvidia remains a mystery, with reports indicating she formerly worked for Chinese state-run media and major financial institutions.
Major business news outlet Caixin said the Chinese name of Alice Huang, who allegedly had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, is Huang Le. She is about 42 years old and married.
One of her acquaintances said the woman, who served as a senior executive of Singapore-based data center provider Megaspeed International, an Nvidia customer, is a native of Hunan Province whose "smile left a striking impression." She is easygoing and a good talker, according to the report.
Alice Huang studied for a master's degree in media management at a university in Hong Kong. After graduation, the woman told her friends she had worked as a reporter for Hunan Television and China Central Television, Caixin said, adding no documents have been found to confirm her employment records.
Western media have said Alice Huang worked at HSBC's private banking division and CITIC Securities, a major Chinese brokerage firm. In 2023, she joined Megaspeed, which is suspected to have smuggled advanced Nvidia chips into China.
On Monday, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun sharply reacted to the Chinese spy allegation, saying it is "purely unsubstantiated and directed at smearing China."
Hu Xijin, a former editor-in-chief of The Global Times, a tabloid affiliated with China's ruling Communist Party, who has some 25 million followers online, apparently defended Alice Huang in a social media post.
"If Huang Le is a spy, she ranks among the most successful spies in history. If she is not, then she has been subjected to one of the most intense and complex instances of wrongful accusation ever faced by a woman. I am inclined to believe the latter is the truth," Hu said.
Meanwhile, Taiwan's Interior Minister Liu Shyh-fang said Wednesday that Alice Huang's visa had been revoked, preventing her from reentering Taiwan.
Relevant authorities are closely monitoring the case and have confirmed that the woman visited Taiwan but is currently overseas, Liu told lawmakers.
"If it had been known that she was a spy, she most likely would not have been permitted entry," Liu said, adding the government would conduct a comprehensive review of its procedures for pre-entry screening, monitoring of visitors and penalties for violations after departure.

香港 - 早期迹象表明，尽管有折扣，中国最大的网上购物活动仍难以说服焦虑的消费者增加消费。
双十一是一项可与美国黑色星期五和网络星期一相媲美的大型折扣活动，集中时间为 11 月 11 日。但它提前几周开始，被视为整体经济的晴雨表。
零售数据平台Syntun表示，截至10月31日，累计销售额总计略高于1万亿元人民币（1,540亿美元），与去年同期基本持平。
零售商主要通过延长节日来增加销售额。 2025 年双十一销售额达到近 1.7 万亿元人民币（2,540 亿美元）的历史新高。

【原文 English Original】
China's Singles' Day shopping festival struggles to shake off weak consumer spending
China's Singles' Day shopping festival struggles to shake off weak consumer spending
- Nov 12, 2026 - 12:00 All,World
Women walk past a shop offering the Singles' Day sale promotion in Beijing on Oct. 28, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)
A woman walks past an advertisement for the Singles' Day sale promotion in Beijing on Oct. 30, 2026. (AP Photo/Ng Han Guan)
Workers of a delivery company sort out customers' parcels piled up at a pickup point ahead of the Singles' Day sale in Beijing on Oct. 28, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)
A worker sets up a board for a McLaren sports car promotion at a mall in Beijing on Oct. 30, 2026. (AP Photo/Ng Han Guan)
Workers setup promotion boards for new housing properties at a popular shopping district in Beijing on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026. (AP Photo/Andy Wong)
HONG KONG - Early signs suggest China ’s biggest online shopping event is struggling to persuade anxious consumers to spend more, despite discounts.
The Singles’ Day festival, a major discount campaign comparable to Black Friday and Cyber Monday in the U.S., centers on Nov. 11. But it begins weeks earlier and is seen as a barometer of the broader economy.
Retail data platform Syntun said cumulative sales as of Oct. 31 totaled just over 1 trillion yuan ($154 billion), broadly in line with the same period last year.
Retailers have increased sales mainly by extending the festival. Total Singles’ Day sales in 2025 reached a record of almost 1.7 trillion yuan ($254 billion).
Consumer demand in China remains subdued, however, as a prolonged property downturn and other pressures weigh on confidence.
“Optimism over a recovery in domestic demand has faded,” said Max Zenglein, Asia Pacific senior economist at The Conference Board. “Improvements in sentiment have repeatedly proved short-lived.”
E-commerce giants such as Alibaba have turned to artificial intelligence to encourage frugal shoppers to spend more. Alibaba integrated its Qwen AI into its Taobao and Tmall platforms to help shoppers place orders and find products.
Plans offering AI tokens are also being prominently promoted during Singles’ Day for the first time. This month, a livestream by Li Jiaqi, dubbed the “Lipstick King” for his huge lipstick sales, sold plans covering roughly 2 trillion tokens within half an hour, according to Chinese media.
Singles’ Day originated as “Bachelors’ Day,” a celebration of being single. The nationwide shopping festival began in 2009 and now targets everyone.
While China’s broader economy continues to grow at a relatively robust pace, expanding 4.6% from a year earlier in January-September, much of that momentum came from a boom in exports. Retail sales of consumer goods rose just 1.1% over the same period.
China’s vast domestic market has struggled as a yearslong real estate downturn
has left households feeling less wealthy. Home prices have fallen roughly 20% or more from their 2021 peak, with smaller cities and the resale market seeing steeper declines.
Although home prices appear to be stabilizing in larger cities, many homeowners remain concerned they could fall further, said Andy Rothman, founder and CEO of the advisory firm Sinology.
In the southern furniture manufacturing hub of Foshan, 24-year-old Gabby Liang said she was feeling cautious.
“I’ve been buying much less online, especially when it comes to non-essential items,” she said. “During the Singles’ Day festival last year, I bought quite a bit of skincare products. But this year I expect to buy fewer.”
Other shoppers are also reining in spending.
“I’m perhaps not as keen on pursuing famous or high-end brands as I used to be,” said Beijing resident Kong Min, referring to this year’s Singles’ Day.
Middle-class Chinese consumers have lost confidence, and many festival discounts are less generous than they once were, said Shaun Rein, managing director of China Market Research Group in Shanghai.
More shoppers are experiencing “discount fatigue,” said Yaling Jiang, founder of market research company ApertureChina. With discounts available year-round, Singles’ Day may be losing its power to boost spending, she said.
“Looking at what Singles’ Day originally was: a shopping festival where people used to expect the largest discounts of the year,” she said. “That is not true any more after it was extended to multiple platforms, then to a monthlong thing.”
Liang, who works in furniture sales, said extras such as cameras and game consoles were off her shopping list this year.
“We’re undergoing a consumption downgrade,” she said. “Even the amount that we earn has somehow been downgraded.”
Domestic demand remains weak as exports soar
Business has stalled as Chinese shoppers tighten their belts, Liang said, despite rising exports to markets such as the Middle East and Africa.
An oversupply of goods, from cars and TVs to shoes and other electronics, has intensified competition in China’s crowded domestic market, pushing manufacturers to expand overseas.
Exports overall surged 35% from a year earlier in October, driven by high-tech products such as semiconductors and electric vehicles. China is on track to surpass last year’s record trade surplus of $1.2 trillion.
Domestic demand for big-ticket items, including cars and some luxury goods, has been particularly weak.
Passenger car sales in China have fallen for most of this year, dropping almost 25% in January-September, according to industry data. The decline partly reflects cuts to government subsidies.
That contrasts sharply with a 71% jump in passenger car exports over the same period.
Luxury spending has also weakened. LVMH, whose brands include Louis Vuitton, Dior and Fendi, and Kering, which owns Gucci, Balenciaga and Saint Laurent, both reported softer demand in China in recent months.
Chinese leaders have pledged for years to accelerate growth in domestic demand. But strong exports have reduced the urgency of introducing policies to stimulate spending at home, analysts said.
“As long as China continues to make progress on its industrial and technological ambitions, policymakers have little incentive to fundamentally rebalance the economy toward household demand,” Zenglein said.
Bright spots remain as status symbols shift
Not all retail categories are struggling. Health, lifestyle and experiences are increasingly becoming status symbols for Chinese consumers.
“It’s not a simple case of big-ticket items falling,” said Jacob Cooke, CEO of Beijing-based consultancy WPIC Marketing + Technologies. Health-related products are selling relatively well, he said.
According to WPIC data, online sales of imported fish oil rose nearly 43% from a year earlier in the 12 months through September. Sales of other supplements aimed at improving sleep or supporting joint and bone health grew between 28% and 37%.
Cooke expects some growth in this year’s Singles’ Day sales.
ApertureChina’s Jiang described this year’s defining consumer trend as “just living life,” with people moving away from grand gestures and focusing on “the bare necessities and internal fulfillment.”
Many families are holding back as youth unemployment hovers around 18% and income growth lags. Yet China’s household savings remain vast. With a population of 1.4 billion, the country has enormous spending potential, even as consumer preferences and spending patterns shift.
Zenglein, the Conference Board economist, sees growing divergence in Chinese consumption, with pockets of stronger demand amid subdued overall sentiment.
“It’s still enough to make a living, but there’s just not much extra to splurge,” said Liang, the furniture sales worker in Foshan.

七国集团部长重申支持乌克兰，谴责中国军事援助
七国集团部长重申支持乌克兰，谴责中国军事援助
- 2026年11月11日 - 23:09 全部,日本,世界
日本外相茂木敏充（远右）、七国集团部长和乌克兰外长安德里·西比哈（右二）于 2026 年 11 月 10 日在巴黎举行的七国集团外长会议上合影。（泳池照片/美联社/共同社）
巴黎 - 七国集团工业化国家外长周三在巴黎会谈后发表联合声明，重申支持乌克兰应对俄罗斯袭击，并批评中国向俄罗斯提供武器，使战争得以继续。
对东欧国家表现出团结之际，人们对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普转向克里姆林宫的担忧挥之不去。
部长们在周二结束的为期两天的会议后发表的声明中表示：“我们重申坚定不移地支持乌克兰及其勇敢的人民，因为他们捍卫了领土完整、主权、自由和独立。”会议参加者包括英国、加拿大、法国、德国、意大利、日本和美国以及欧盟。
“我们重申支持美国领导的持续努力，通过直接和认真的谈判促进和平。我们重申了确保全面、全面和互惠停火的重要性，”声明补充道。
部长们还表示，他们“谴责朝鲜和伊朗向俄罗斯提供军事援助，以及中国提供武器、军事训练和军民两用部件，这使得战争得以继续。”
他们说：“我们明确表示打算继续对这些国家采取行动。”
在印度-太平洋地区，七国集团成员表示，中国在台湾以东海域日益咄咄逼人的活动“威胁到地区稳定、航行自由和国际航运安全”。
联合声明称：“我们强调维护台海和平稳定的重要性。”
共产党领导的大陆声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并发誓要将这个自治的民主岛屿置于其控制之下，必要时可以使用武力。

G7 ministers reaffirm Ukraine support, condemn China's military aid
G7 ministers reaffirm Ukraine support, condemn China's military aid
- Nov 11, 2026 - 23:09 All,Japan,World
Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi (far R), fellow Group of Seven ministers and Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha (2nd from R) pose for a photo during a G7 foreign ministers meeting in Paris on Nov. 10, 2026. (Pool Photo/AP/Kyodo)
PARIS - Foreign ministers of the Group of Seven industrialized nations reaffirmed their support for Ukraine amid Russian attacks and criticized China for providing Russia with weapons that enable the war to continue in a joint declaration issued Wednesday following their talks in Paris.
The show of unity toward the Eastern European country came amid lingering concerns that U.S. President Donald Trump is pivoting toward the Kremlin.
"We reaffirmed our unwavering support to Ukraine and its courageous people as they defend their territorial integrity, sovereignty, freedom, and independence," the ministers said in the declaration following the two-day gathering that ended Tuesday and involved Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United States, as well as the European Union.
"We reiterated our support to ongoing U.S.-led efforts to facilitate peace through direct and serious negotiations. We reaffirmed the importance of securing a full, comprehensive, and reciprocal ceasefire," it added.
The ministers also said they "condemned the provision of military assistance to Russia by North Korea and Iran, and the provision of weapons, military training and dual-use components by China, which enables the continuation of the war."
"We made clear our intention to continue to take action against these countries," they said.
On the Indo-Pacific region, the G7 members said China's increasingly assertive activities in the waters east of Taiwan "threaten regional stability, freedom of navigation and the safety of international shipping."
"We stressed the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait," the joint declaration said.
The Communist-led mainland, which claims Taiwan as part of its territory, has vowed to bring the self-ruled democratic island under its control, by force if necessary.

summary: 部长：香港扩大保险人才库应对全球风险中国劳工公告 星期四, 12 11 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港扩大保险人才库，应对全球风险：香港财经事务局局长陈茂波表示，香港部长正在扩大其保险人才库，目前已拥有超过 12,000 名持牌中介机构和 22,000 名培训计划参与者。他强调了地缘政治、气候变化、人工智能和人口老龄化带来的全球风险，并强调香港没有任何一项监管措施正在加紧努力扩大金融服务范围。
content:
部长：香港扩大保险人才库应对全球风险中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港扩大保险人才库应对全球风险：部长
财经事务局局长陈茂波表示，香港正在扩大保险人才库，目前已拥有超过 12,000 名持牌中介机构和 22,000 名培训计划参与者。他强调了地缘政治、气候变化、人工智能和人口老龄化带来的全球风险，并强调没有单一的监管措施
财经事务及库务局局长陈茂波11月12日在国际保险监管人协会年会上表示，香港正在加紧努力扩大保险人才库，目前香港有超过12万名持牌保险中介人。
陈茂波表示，「保险从业员培训提升计划」自十年前推出，至今已有约22,000名从业员参与。他表示，在香港人才名单的“专业保险专业人士”和“精算师”类别下，当局已收到并批准了超过100份申请，反映了对香港作为国际风险管理中心的前景的信心。
陈在演讲中强调，世界正面临前所未有的相互交织的风险，地缘政治变化影响供应链和金融市场，气候相关风险加剧，人工智能重塑保险公司承保、定价和服务客户​​的方式，人口老龄化改变保障和长期储蓄需求。他说，这些风险不分国界，没有任何一个监管机构、市场或行业能够单独应对这些风险。
陈说，作为超级联系人，香港在健全的监管框架下汇集了保险公司、再保险公司和资本市场，与中国内地和国际社会有着密切的联系。他补充说，这些优势使该市能够帮助保险业应对新出现的风险。
陈茂波表示，政府将继续加强香港作为区域风险管理中心的角色，吸引更多专业自保保险公司设立业务、扩大保险相关证券市场以及培育行业人才。这将有助于亚洲和中国大陆企业向海外扩张。
陈还呼吁拓宽金融资源渠道，通过巨灾债券等保险相关证券来解决损失。他表示，香港已将“保险相关证券资助计划”延长至2028年，以促进市场发展和参与，并希望建立一个生态系统，让保险公司、投资者和服务提供商能够开发具有全球影响力的风险转移解决方案。

Hong Kong expands insurance talent pool, addresses global risks: minister | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong expands insurance talent pool, addresses global risks: minister
Hong Kong is expanding its insurance talent pool with over 12,000 licensed intermediaries and 22,000 participants in a training scheme, Secretary for Financial Services Paul Chan said. He highlighted global risks from geopolitics, climate change, AI and ageing populations, stressing no single regula
Hong Kong is stepping up efforts to expand its insurance talent pool, with more than 120,000 licensed insurance intermediaries currently in the city, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Paul Chan said at the annual conference of the International Association of Insurance Supervisors on 12 November.
Chan noted that the “Insurance Practitioner Training Enhancement Scheme”, launched a decade ago, has so far seen around 22,000 industry practitioners take part. Under the “Specialist Insurance Professionals” and “Actuary” categories of the city’s talent list, authorities have received and approved over 100 applications, reflecting confidence in Hong Kong’s prospects as an international risk management centre, he said.
In his speech, Chan highlighted that the world is facing an unprecedented degree of interwoven risks, with geopolitical shifts affecting supply chains and financial markets, climate-related risks intensifying, artificial intelligence reshaping how insurers underwrite, price and serve customers, and ageing populations changing protection and long-term savings needs. These risks, he said, know no borders, and no single regulator, market or industry can tackle them alone.
As a super-connector, Hong Kong brings together insurers, reinsurers and capital markets under a robust regulatory framework, with close ties to mainland China and the international community, Chan said. These advantages, he added, enable the city to help the insurance industry respond to emerging risks.
The government will continue to strengthen Hong Kong’s role as a regional risk management centre by attracting more specialised captive insurers to set up operations, expanding the insurance-linked securities market, and nurturing industry talent, Chan said. This will help Asian and mainland Chinese enterprises expand overseas.
Chan also called for broadening financial resource channels to address losses through insurance-linked securities such as catastrophe bonds. Hong Kong has extended its “Insurance-linked Securities Grant Scheme” until 2028 to promote market development and participation, he said, expressing hope of building an ecosystem where insurers, investors and service providers can develop risk-transfer solutions with global impact.

title: 時間線：黃仁勳出軌與黃樂間諜疑雲
summary: 2025年5月22日，在台灣頂級科技展台北國際電腦展（Computex）期間，與數據中心公司Megaspeed的前高管黃樂（Alice Huang，又譯黃愛麗，右）與英偉達（Nvidia）首席執行官兼聯合創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang，左背對鏡頭穿黑衣者）出席在台北一家餐廳舉行的晚宴。(Various Sources/AFP) 【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者林燕報導）美國頂級芯片企業英偉達（Nvidia，也稱輝達）首席執行員黃仁勳承認出軌，媒體爆料該女
content:
2025年5月22日，在台灣頂級科技展台北國際電腦展（Computex）期間，與數據中心公司Megaspeed的前高管黃樂（Alice Huang，又譯黃愛麗，右）與英偉達（Nvidia）首席執行官兼聯合創辦人黃仁勳（Jensen Huang，左背對鏡頭穿黑衣者）出席在台北一家餐廳舉行的晚宴。(Various Sources/AFP)
【大紀元2026年11月12日訊】（大紀元記者林燕報導）美國頂級芯片企業英偉達（Nvidia，也稱輝達）首席執行員黃仁勳承認出軌，媒體爆料該女子為中國公民，係新加坡註冊公司超速國際（Megaspeed）的前主管黃樂。
更多報導稱，美國情報機構將黃樂視為受中共國家安全部招募的情報人員。這一事件迅速成為全球媒體頭條，並引起外界對中共威脅美國國家安全的擔憂。
以下為根據多家媒體報導整理的黃仁勳出軌與黃樂間諜事件的時間線。
時間事件摘要約1984年黃樂（Alice Huang，又名黃小樂）出生於湖南，中國公民。約2006年前 後黃樂赴香港浸會大學修讀媒體管理碩士，其後取得香港永久居民資格及香港特區護照。2015年前黃樂自稱曾任職央視、湖南衛視、滙豐私人銀行及中信證券，累積媒體與金融業經驗；部分履歷其後遭質疑。2015年第七大道成立新加坡分支機構「7Road International Pte Ltd」，即超速國際的前身。2015年起黃樂投身私募股權投資，先後擔任上海和熙投資執行董事兼合夥人、上海韻禧投資董事。2015年後黃樂建立上海、浙江商業網絡；相關網絡參與騰訊數據中心建設，並投資中國電科旗下網絡安全企業。2019年8月黃樂透過多間英屬維爾京群島公司，參與以10億元人民幣向第七大道出售中國遊戲公司的交易，涉及丈夫康偉。2023年3月黃樂旗下「Huang Le Limited」收購第七大道新加坡分支，將其更名為「超速國際」（Megaspeed International），並出任董事總經理。2023年11月黃樂將超速國際股份轉予新加坡「SwiftData Pte Ltd」，辭任董事，由陳勇邦接任；其後仍參與採購與集資。2023年12月黃樂與黃仁勳及多名英偉達同事在新加坡意大利餐廳會面。四天後，超速國際成為英偉達雲端合作夥伴。
時間事件摘要2024年6月阿里巴巴新加坡子公司Apex Enterprise Solutions向超速國際馬來西亞子公司 Speedmatrix 提供抵押貸款。2024年6月臺北國際電腦展後，黃樂與黃仁勳及多名業界人士在台北酒吧聚會；領英照片顯示兩人相鄰而坐。2024年6月至2026年2月據貿易記錄與媒體調查，超速國際馬來西亞關聯企業購入至少48億美元運算設備，用於東南亞數據中心及向阿里巴巴出租算力。2024年內超速國際資產負債表規模由3,300萬美元增至約30億美元，增幅逾90倍。2024年11月黃樂獲委任為網約車平台T3出行（南京領行科技）董事。2024年底美國商務部官員視察超速國際馬來西亞園區，發現大量高階設備尚未拆封，懷疑涉及非法轉運。2025年初黃樂與丈夫康偉向中國投資者推介數億美元的東南亞數據中心計劃，聲稱取得英偉達GPU「完全沒有問題」。2025年起《海峽時報》報導，超速國際近乎停止運作，並聘請外部法律顧問展開內部調查。2025年5月22日黃樂出席黃仁勳在台北「三六食府」舉辦的晚宴；台灣媒體拍到她親吻黃仁勳臉頰，並在其受訪時站於身後。2025年，具體時間不詳黃樂離開超速國際；此前已辭任董事，但仍以高層的身分參與晶片採購與集資。約2025年10月前後據後續報導，川普已聽取黃仁勳與黃樂關係的機密簡報，但當時決定暫不採取行動。
時間事件摘要2026年中國新年前黃樂丈夫、和熙投資創辦人康偉涉嫌操縱上市股票，遭上海警方採取刑事強制措施。2026年春季據後續報導，盧比奧監督起草機密備忘錄，依據對黃樂的電子監控，警告黃仁勳與疑似中共間諜關係密切。2026年4月T3出行向香港交易所提交上市申請。2026年5月訪華前據報，盧比奧向持有高級別安全許可的政府決策官員分發相關機密備忘錄。2026年5月沽空機構 Culper Research 發表英偉達研究報告，質疑黃仁勳與黃樂關係過密，並引述員工對兩人往來的說法。2026年5月12日上午川普看到黃仁勳未加入訪華代表團的報導後，親自致電邀請其同行。2026年5月12日晚間黃仁勳赴阿拉斯加，在空軍一號停靠安克雷奇加油時登機，隨川普前往北京。2026年7月至8月黃樂在香港註冊成立Stag Bay Technology Limited、Aspen Creek Limited等新公司。2026年9月中國證監會叫停T3出行上市程序，並調查股份代持問題。2026年內美國商務部將超速國際案件轉交司法部跟進；新加坡政府亦已展開調查。
時間事件摘要2026年10月29日《紐約時報》披露，美方曾對黃樂進行至少一年電子監控，並認定她為中國情報部門工作的資產。報導稱，美方在監控中截獲黃樂與一名美國公民的密切通訊，經「揭露身分」程序確認該公民為黃仁勳。報導稱，美方擔心黃樂利用與黃仁勳等業界高層的關係，收集資訊並了解其對美國AI及出口政策的影響力。黃仁勳接受彭博社訪問，稱與黃樂往來均屬正常業務接觸，美國政府從未向他通報過相關懷疑。英偉達否認黃仁勳與黃樂的異常關係及非法轉運指控，稱已清點超速國際獲得的GPU，客戶亦無法取得敏感機密。2026年11月6日至7日《紐約時報》與《金融時報》報導，美方認定黃樂受僱於中共國家安全部，負責收集情報並試圖影響黃仁勳。《金融時報》引述知情人士的話稱，美方情報及備忘錄指兩人存在戀愛關係，與此前「一般客戶往來」說法不符。2026年11月8日黃仁勳承認婚外情，並向全體員工發出題為「致我們公司的一封信」的內部電郵。董事會宣布進行獨立調查，由獨立董事委員會監督，並聘請外部獨立法律顧問協助。董事會稱目前無理由相信國家安全或公司機密受損，重申支持黃仁勳；公司表示他將繼續擔任行政總裁。英偉達回應BBC，稱事前不知美方情報機構對超速國際的疑慮，但知道其曾因涉嫌轉運芯片接受調查。川普公開支持黃仁勳留任，稱不後悔此前未採取行動，並表示仍願邀其參加即將舉行的亞洲之行。盧比奧拒絕評論，僅稱事件屬「企業內部事務」。2026年11月9日川普透露聯邦調查局已展開調查；聯邦調查局拒絕評論。川普稱已致電黃仁勳；黃仁勳表示完全不知道黃樂是間諜，川普表示相信其說法。2026年11月11日彭博社報導，黃樂現在人在北京，中共安全部門知道她的行蹤。中共外交部發言人之前拒絕回答黃樂身在何處。
